### [1] [A Cone-Constrained Bilinear Decomposition for Total Scaled-Gradient Variation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00036)
*Haibin Su,Chunlin Wu,Huibin Chang,Zhifang Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文针对总缩放梯度变分(TSGV)正则化器因高度非凸非线性带来的计算难题，提出一种定制的双线性分解方法，将非线性加权梯度解耦，转化为锥或球面约束下的等价优化问题，并采用交替最小化(AMM)结合majorization-minimization策略求解，保证能量单调递减且无需步长调节。论文在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz框架下建立了全局收敛性，并通过高斯去噪和NLOS成像实验验证了该方法在高噪声水平下PSNR和SSIM达到或优于代表性变分方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TSGV正则化器虽能很好保留图像边缘和角点，但其高度非凸非线性的特性导致现有方法面临参数敏感或缺乏收敛保证的严重计算挑战，需要一种既能保持边缘角点保留能力又具备稳定收敛性的求解方法。

Method: 提出定制的双线性分解将TSGV中的非线性加权梯度解耦，根据缩放函数的不同将原问题转化为锥约束或球面约束的等价优化问题；采用交替最小化方法(AMM)配合majorization-minimization策略求解，无需步长调节即可保证能量单调递减；并通过分析约束在图像奇异点附近的渐近行为提供边缘保留特性的几何解释；在Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz框架下证明全局收敛性。

Result: 在Gaussian去噪和NLOS成像的广泛数值实验中，该方法在高噪声水平下取得与代表性变分方法竞争或更优的PSNR和SSIM，并改善了稠密与稀疏扫描下的结构重建质量。

Conclusion: 提出的双线性分解与AMM求解策略有效解决了TSGV正则化器的计算难题，为边缘角点保留的图像复原提供了兼具理论收敛保证和优异实际性能的新方法，尤其在NLOS成像等复杂场景中展现出优势。

Abstract: The total scaled-gradient variation (TSGV) regularizer, derived from sparse modeling of piecewise-linear structures, has been shown to preserve edges and corners in image restoration. However, its highly nonconvex and nonlinear nature poses severe computational challenges, as existing methods often suffer from parameter sensitivity or lack convergence guarantees. To overcome this, we propose a tailored bilinear decomposition that decouples the nonlinear weighted gradient in the TSGV regularizer. This approach yields an equivalent optimization problem governed by cone or sphere constraints, depending on the chosen scaling function. In particular, the cone constraint plays a central role in characterizing edge- and corner-preserving behavior. We solve this reformulation using the alternating minimization method (AMM) equipped with a majorization--minimization strategy, ensuring a monotonic decrease in energy without step-size tuning. Furthermore, we provide a geometric interpretation of the edge-preserving properties of these constraints by analyzing their asymptotic behavior near image singularities. We establish the global convergence of the proposed method to a critical point within the Kurdyka--Łojasiewicz framework. Extensive numerical experiments on Gaussian denoising and non-line-of-sight (NLOS) imaging show that the proposed method achieves PSNR and SSIM competitive with or superior to representative variational methods, especially at high noise levels, and improves the structural reconstruction under dense and sparse scanning.

</details>


### [2] [Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00111)
*Xin Zhou,Zongchuang Zhao,Zhibo Yang,Mingsheng Li,Humen Zhong,Shuai Bai,Du Chu,Ruizhe Chen,Zhaohai Li,Jun Tang,Qiuyue Wang,Mingkun Yang,Jiazhao Zhang,Dayiheng Liu,Dingkang Liang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Qwen-Drive-1.0是一个面向自动驾驶的视觉语言基础模型，在保留预训练VLM架构的基础上，通过外部鸟瞰图(BEV)感知头实现3D目标检测、语义占用预测和BEV地图分割，并借助Planning Expert生成未来自车轨迹，采用分阶段训练策略在驾驶监督与通用视觉语言数据间取得平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将视觉语言基础模型应用于自动驾驶，需要在统一的框架中整合3D感知、视觉问答与运动规划能力，同时保持模型原有的通用视觉理解与指令跟随能力。

Method: 1) 保留预训练VLM架构，集成3D感知、VQA与运动规划于统一框架；2) 引入外部BEV感知头，联合完成3D目标检测、语义占用预测和BEV地图分割，作为3D信息探针并提供可检视的界面；3) 设计Planning Expert模块，基于共享VLM表征生成自车未来轨迹；4) 采用分阶段训练策略，将驾驶监督与通用视觉语言数据结合。

Result: 实验表明模型在3D感知和驾驶场景理解上表现优异，同时大部分保留了通用视觉语言能力；在开环、伪闭环和闭环等多种评估设置下展现出极具竞争力的运动规划性能。

Conclusion: Qwen-Drive-1.0验证了在不牺牲通用能力的前提下，通过统一框架实现自动驾驶多任务学习的可行性，是该方向迈出的初始一步。

Abstract: We present Qwen-Drive-1.0, an initial step towards a vision-language foundation model for autonomous driving. Qwen-Drive-1.0 retains the architecture of the pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and integrates 3D perception, visual question answering, and motion planning within a unified framework. An external bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception head jointly performs 3D object detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and BEV map segmentation. It serves as a probe of the 3D information accessible from the shared representations and provides an explicit, inspectable interface to 3D scene structure. A Planning Expert conditions on shared VLM representations to generate future ego trajectories. A staged training recipe combines driving supervision with general-purpose vision-language data to acquire driving-specific competence while helping preserve broad visual understanding and instruction-following capabilities. Experiments demonstrate strong 3D perception and driving scene understanding while largely preserving general vision-language capability. Comprehensive evaluations across open-loop, pseudo-closed-loop, and closed-loop settings further show highly competitive motion-planning performance.

</details>


### [3] [ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00188)
*Xionghao Wu,Yijun Yang,Shiyang Zhou,Haoze Sun,Jianhui Liu,Songsong Yu,Jiyao Zhang,Wenbo Li,Bo Wang,Guoqing Ma,Lin Song,Renjie Liao,Shenghe Zheng,Wei Tang,Xiaojuan Qi,Yanwei Li,Yuan Zhang,Zhuotao Tian,Haoyang Huang,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ZimaBlue是一个从大规模视频中学习通用世界动作模型（WAM）的可扩展框架。它通过三阶段训练课程（因果具身视频预训练、视频-动作中间训练、目标机器人微调）将大规模无动作标签的具身视频转化为有效的机器人控制策略，并采用异步Slow-Fast双系统架构实现30Hz的实时动作预测。在真实机器人零样本评估中，从仅用目标机器人数据扩展到12万小时具身视频，成功率从36.1%提升至77.8%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操控面临根本性的规模化挑战：鲁棒泛化需要广泛的身体经验，但带动作标签的机器人轨迹采集昂贵且多样性有限。第一人称视频提供了更可扩展的具身体验来源，但关键问题是如何将这些丰富但无动作标签的经验转化为有效的机器人控制。

Method: ZimaBlue采用三阶段训练课程：(1)在大规模人类和机器人第一人称视频上进行因果具身视频预训练；(2)通过统一动作表示在异构机器人轨迹上进行视频-动作中间训练，将学到的视觉动力学落地到机器人动作空间；(3)针对目标机器人进行专门化微调。此外采用异步Slow-Fast双系统架构，高容量Slow世界模型提供可泛化的时空表示，轻量Fast分支实现30Hz实时动作预测。

Result: 在真实机器人零样本评估中，将训练数据从仅目标机器人数据扩展到120,000小时以上具身视频，成功率从36.1%提升到77.8%。ZimaBlue在多个基准上表现优异，在未见任务上的性能提升尤为显著。

Conclusion: ZimaBlue证明了大规模无动作标签的具身视频可以有效地转化为通用机器人控制能力，显著提升真实机器人零样本操作的成功率，特别在泛化到未见任务方面表现突出，为机器人学习的数据规模化提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effective robot control. We introduce ZimaBlue, a scalable framework for learning generalizable World Action Models (WAMs) from large-scale video. ZimaBlue follows a three-stage training curriculum: it first performs causal embodied video pre-training on large-scale human and robot egocentric videos, then grounds the learned visual dynamics in heterogeneous robot trajectories through video-action mid-training with a unified action representation, and finally specializes the model to a target robot for deployment. To make generative WAMs practical for real-time control, ZimaBluefurther adopts an asynchronous Slow-Fast dual-system architecture, where a high-capacity Slow world model provides generalizable spatiotemporal representations and a lightweight Fast branch enables 30 Hz action prediction on NVIDIA RTX 4090. On real-robot zero-shot evaluations, scaling from target-robot data alone to over 120,000 hours of embodied video improves success from 36.1% to 77.8%. ZimaBlue further delivers strong performance across multiple benchmarks, with particularly pronounced gains on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [4] [A Lagrangian View of Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00198)
*Peyman Milanfar*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种自下而上的力学推导方法，从拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角出发，通过分析连续去噪器的局部泰勒展开，推导出最优单步生成所需的目标身份守恒不变性条件，进而得到拟线性平流偏微分方程。通过特征线法求解该PDE，可解析地得到Flow Matching的直线轨迹，为显式时间生成模型的几何本质提供了新解释。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的显式时间生成模型（如Flow Matching和Rectified Flow）通常通过最优传输和连续性方程以自上而下的欧拉（宏观）方式进行推导，缺乏粒子层面的微观理解。作者希望提供一种替代性的自下而上力学推导，从拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角建立更直观的理论基础，并解释直线流为何能够支持大步长以及蒸馏为何有效。

Method: 1) 采用拉格朗日（粒子中心）视角而非标准的欧拉方法；2) 对连续去噪器进行局部泰勒展开分析；3) 提出"目标身份守恒"这一严格不变性条件作为最优单步生成的前提；4) 将该条件转化为拟线性平流PDE；5) 通过特征线法（Method of Characteristics）解析求解该PDE。

Result: 1) 通过特征线法求解所得PDE，可解析地得到与Flow Matching一致的直线轨迹；2) 识别出去噪器的Jacobian是轨迹曲率的主要来源；3) 为直线流为何能够支持大步长提供了直接数学解释；4) 解释了为何经验模型需要蒸馏来展平相交的特征线。

Conclusion: 本文从拉格朗日粒子视角为显式时间生成模型提供了新的力学推导基础，建立了目标身份守恒条件与直线生成轨迹之间的理论联系。该几何视角不仅统一了Flow Matching的理论来源，还阐明了Jacobian与轨迹曲率的关系，为理解蒸馏的必要性及未来设计更高效的生成模型提供了理论指导。

Abstract: Modern explicit-time generative models, such as Flow Matching [Lipman et al., 2023] and Rectified Flow [Liu et al., 2023], are typically derived top-down via Optimal Transport and the continuity equation. This standard Eulerian approach focuses on the macroscopic transport of probability mass. In this paper, we present an alternative, bottom-up mechanical derivation grounded in a Lagrangian (particle-centric) perspective. By analyzing the local Taylor expansion of a continuous denoiser, we motivate a strict invariance condition required for optimal, singlestep generation: the conservation of target identity. Enforcing this condition yields a governing quasi-linear advection Partial Differential Equation (PDE). We demonstrate that solving this PDE via the Method of Characteristics analytically yields the straight-line trajectories of Flow Matching. This geometric perspective isolates the Jacobian of the denoiser as the primary source of trajectory curvature, providing a direct mathematical explanation for why straight-line flows enable massive step sizes, and why empirical models require distillation to flatten intersecting characteristics.

</details>


### [5] [Distributed Implicit Harm: A Compositional Safety Blind Spot in MLLM-Based Video Moderation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00206)
*Ruotong Wang,Zihao Zhu,Siwei Lyu,Xin Tao,Baoyuan Wu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在视频审核中存在的"组合安全盲区"：由各组件单独看都无害的视频，组合在一起可传达有害含义（称为分布式隐式危害DIH）。作者提出多智能体合成框架生成超9000个带推理标注的DIH视频，并对30多个MLLM进行基准测试，发现包括顶级前沿模型在内均存在显著缺陷，无法识别组件组合后涌现的危害。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在视频审核场景下存在安全盲区：有害视频由看似无害的组件组合而成，这类视频缺乏组合危害标注，难以通过局部视觉线索、关键词或单模态信号检索，因此不在现有安全数据集中，导致该问题长期未被研究。作者希望通过系统性研究填补这一gap。

Method: 提出多智能体合成框架，将独立无害的组件组合成有害场景，生成带显式推理标注的多样化DIH视频数据集（超9000个，涵盖纯视觉和音视频设定）。研究两种代表性DIH类型：时间分布危害（DIH-T，跨视觉片段）和跨模态危害（DIH-M，音视频流之间）。

Result: 对30多个MLLMs（涵盖前沿专有模型和主流开源系统）的基准测试显示，模型在检测DIH-T和DIH-M上均存在一致且显著的缺陷。即使是最强的前沿模型也常常能正确评估单个组件，却无法识别组合后涌现的有害含义。在社交媒体采集的真实世界DIH视频上观察到相同失败模式。

Conclusion: DIH是视频审核中一个实际存在且未被充分探索的挑战。当前的MLLMs虽然在组件级判断上表现良好，但在理解组件组合所涌现的危害方面存在系统性缺陷，需要新的方法和数据来应对这一安全问题。

Abstract: Despite their growing use in video moderation, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibit a compositional safety blind spot: videos composed of seemingly benign components can convey harmful meaning when interpreted as a whole. We refer to this phenomenon as Distributed Implicit Harm (DIH), where harm arises from relations among components distributed along a decomposition axis of the video, rather than from any single explicit cue. Among many possible axes, we study two representative cases: temporally distributed harm across visual segments (DIH-T) and cross-modal harm between audio and visual streams (DIH-M). Studying and mitigating DIH at scale requires data that is difficult to collect: such videos lack compositional harm annotations, evade retrieval based on local visual cues, keywords, or single-modality signals, and are consequently absent from existing safety datasets. To bridge this gap, we develop a multi-agent synthesis framework that composes individually benign components into harmful scenarios and generates diverse DIH videos with explicit reasoning annotations, yielding a dataset of over 9,000 videos spanning visual-only and audio-visual settings. Benchmarking over 30 MLLMs spanning frontier proprietary models and leading open-source systems reveals substantial and consistent deficits in detecting both DIH-T and DIH-M. Notably, this failure persists even among the strongest frontier models: they often correctly assess individual components in isolation but fail to recognize the harmful meaning that emerges from their composition. We further evaluate these models on a manually collected set of real-world DIH videos from social media and observe the same failure mode, highlighting DIH as a practical and underexplored challenge for video moderation.

</details>


### [6] [Beyond Language Priors: Diagnosing and Fixing Visual-Origin Hallucinations in Multimodal LLM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00231)
*Peiyang Xu,Xiaopei Zhu,Jun Zhu,Xiaolin Hu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文挑战了多模态大语言模型(MLLM)目标幻觉主要由语言先验导致的观点，提出并证实了视觉来源幻觉这一被忽视的原因。通过定量分析发现幻觉样本存在图像-文本相似度更低和注意力模式反转的现象。据此提出对抗性对比微调(ACFT)方法，使用最小定向对抗扰动构造正负样本对进行对比微调，仅用COCO数据集0.9%的数据且零推理开销即在多个基准上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究将MLLM目标幻觉主要归因于语言先验（如过度依赖文本共现统计），本文认为存在被忽视的互补性原因：视觉特征提取错误及图像-文本嵌入错位导致的视觉来源幻觉，需要通过定量证据揭示这一未充分探索的机制。

Method: 1) 通过余弦相似度分析和Smooth Grad-CAM熵测量进行诊断，发现幻觉样本图像-文本相似度系统性更低且注意力模式反转。2) 提出ACFT方法：采用对抗幻觉属性翻转(AHAF)过程，施加最小定向对抗扰动翻转图像的幻觉属性，构造完美对齐的正负样本对，用于对比微调。AHAF同时用作诊断探针。

Result: ACFT仅需COCO数据集0.9%的数据，零推理开销，在POPE、MME及四个描述级幻觉基准上达到SOTA，适用于LLaVA、MiniGPT-4和Qwen2.5-VL等多种模型。

Conclusion: 本文证实视觉来源幻觉是MLLM幻觉的重要成因，MLLM视觉表征紧邻幻觉决策边界，ACFT通过精准对抗样本构造和对比微调可高效缓解该问题，为幻觉治理提供了低成本的新路径。

Abstract: Existing research on object hallucination in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) predominantly attributes the problem to language priors such as over-reliance on textual co-occurrence statistics. We challenge this view by presenting quantitative evidence for a complementary, under-explored cause: visual-origin hallucination, where hallucinations arise from incorrect visual feature extraction and misalignment between image and text embeddings. Through cosine similarity analysis and Smooth Grad-CAM entropy measurements, we show that hallucinated samples exhibit systematically lower image-text similarity (average 0.158 vs. -0.122) and inverted attention patterns, where attention is dispersed when the target object is present but wrongly concentrated when it is absent. Guided by this diagnosis, we propose Adversarial Contrastive Fine-Tuning (ACFT). ACFT uses an Adversarial Hallucination Attribute Flipping (AHAF) procedure, involving minimal, targeted adversarial perturbations that flip an image's hallucination attribute, to construct perfectly aligned positive-negative pairs, which are then used for contrastive fine-tuning. AHAF simultaneously serves as a diagnostic probe, revealing that MLLM visual representations lie dangerously close to hallucination decision boundaries. Requiring only 0.9% of the COCO dataset and adding zero inference overhead, ACFT achieves state-of-the-art performance on POPE, MME, and four description-level hallucination benchmarks across LLaVA, MiniGPT-4, and Qwen2.5-VL. Code is available at https://github.com/zxp555/ACFT_MM

</details>


### [7] [Beyond Blind Compliance: Benchmarking Task Verification in OCR Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00232)
*Yue Zhou,Yuan Wu,Yi Chang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出VeriOCRBench基准，用于评估多模态大语言模型在OCR场景中的"任务验证"能力——即在回答问题前判断图像前提、文本前提和问题是否共同构成可执行任务。包含1,800个人工验证样本（1,600个陷阱注入的无效任务和200个无陷阱对照），对15个主流MLLM的评估揭示了持续存在的盲目遵从、诊断失败和提示诱导的过度拒绝现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MLLM在OCR-中心文档理解和视觉推理基准上表现优异，但这些评测隐含假设每个任务都是有效且可回答的。真实OCR场景中这一假设常被打破：问题可能依赖模糊文本、遮挡证据、不存在的视觉目标、矛盾前提或缺失变量。现有基准缺乏对这类不可执行任务的系统性评测，导致模型可靠性差距被忽视。

Method: 构建VeriOCRBench：从8个OCR相关数据集提取源图像，覆盖8个真实世界图像域，通过"视觉原子事实(VAF)锚定"流程生成1,600个陷阱注入的无效任务（涵盖8种陷阱类型、4个验证维度：视觉、上下文、事实和逻辑），外加200个无陷阱对照以衡量过度拒绝。全部样本经人工审计。在此基础上设计了任务验证、根因诊断和过度拒绝的解耦评估框架。

Result: 对15个领先MLLM的系统评估揭示了：（1）持续存在的"盲目遵从"——模型对无效任务仍直接作答；（2）诊断失败——难以识别任务不可执行的根因；（3）提示诱导的过度拒绝——对有效任务的误拒。这些发现暴露了当前OCR推理系统中关键的可靠性差距。

Abstract: Vision Transformers provide strong visual representations but typically rely on slowly updated parameters, limiting their ability to organize newly acquired information across different memory timescales. A causal read-before-write lifecycle ensures that the current outcome cannot influence the prediction it supervises. Method: 1) 将长手势分解为结构化原语；2) 学习因果VAE将其编码为时间上有序的潜变量token（每个仅依赖过去）；3) 在因果潜空间中进行条件扩散，条件包括语音信号、运动历史、初始姿态参考和物体几何；4) 时间有序的潜变量公式支持显式时间控制，可实现手势补间（in-betweening）和手势补全（completion）；5) 引入针对该任务的新评估指标；6) 创建SceneGes合成3D数据集。

Abstract: Generating co-speech gestures that are temporally coherent, semantically aligned with speech, and grounded with surrounding objects remains challenging. Prior speech-driven gesture models emphasize audio-gesture alignment but do not explicitly account for posture constraints or surrounding objects, failing to capture the inherent correlation between body gestures and the physical space. We present Puppeteer, a posture-aware, object-grounded co-speech gesture diffusion model operating in a causal latent space. We decompose long gestures into structured primitives and learn a causal variational autoencoder that encodes them into temporally ordered latent tokens, each depending only on the past. We then perform conditional diffusion directly in the causal latent space, conditioning on speech signals, motion history, an initial posture reference, and object geometry to synthesize physically consistent gestures. To better assess co-speech gesture synthesis beyond existing measures, we introduce new evaluation metrics tailored to this task. We also created SceneGes, the first curated synthetic 3D dataset of embodied co-speech gestures and corresponding 3D objects, enabling object-grounded gesture generation. Experiments show that Puppeteer generates more diverse and temporally synchronized gestures than prior methods, while enabling object-grounded gesture synthesis.

</details>

Abstract: We present FoldingAgent, an agentic framework for inferring explicit parametric folding programs directly from origami demonstration videos. Motivation: Hough 空间 H=S¹×R 通过点 (θ,ρ) 对表示方向-偏移组合，但 (θ,ρ) 与 (θ+π,-ρ) 表示同一条无向直线，因此 H 双重覆盖了无向直线空间 H/Z₂（即莫比乌斯带）。soft-argmax 作为概率加权平均需要全局线性空间，但在覆盖空间 H 上操作会将几何上相邻的直线撕裂。因此需要一个 Z₂-不变的线性空间嵌入，使 soft-argmax 具有良定义。

Abstract: From horizon detection to fibre structures in X-ray imaging, many vision tasks recover lines via peak detection in Hough space $H=S^1\times\mathbb{R}$, the domain of orientation-offset pairs $(θ,ρ)$. Differentiable pipelines extract coordinates via \emph{soft-argmax}, a probability-weighted average that is only meaningful in a globally linear space. However, $(θ,ρ)$ and $(θ+π,-ρ)$ describe the same undirected line, so $H$ double-covers the space of undirected lines $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$: a Möbius strip, obtained by identifying each pair under $\mathbb{Z}_2$ action. Soft-argmax operates on the cover $H$, but since $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$ admits no linear structure, it tears geometrically adjacent lines apart. Thus we need a $\mathbb{Z}_2$-invariant embedding of lines into a linear space, on which soft-argmax is well-defined. We achieve this by parametrising lines via unit-norm homogeneous vectors $\ell=(1+ρ^2)^{-1/2}(\cosθ,\sinθ,-ρ)^{\top}\in\mathbb{R}^3$ and applying the Veronese map $v_2(\ell)=\ell\ell^{\top}$ that satisfies $v_2(\ell)=v_2(-\ell)$. This descends continuously to an embedding of the quotient $H/\mathbb{Z}_2$ into the linear space $\mathrm{Sym}^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$, where the antipodal ambiguity vanishes. Line extraction becomes a barycentre in $\mathrm{Sym}^2(\mathbb{R}^3)$, projected back via its leading eigenvector. </details>

Abstract: Modern image generation and editing systems can produce photorealistic, prompt-aligned images, but still often render familiar objects at implausible relative sizes. Abstract: Current 4D generation paradigms are often bottlenecked by a sequential decoupling design: video is generated first, followed by 3D reconstruction, leading to high interaction latency. This limits applications in interactive real-time scenarios. To this end, we propose \textbf{Streaming4D}, a tightly coupled synchronous pipeline that integrates block-wise autoregressive video generation with incremental 3D reconstruction. Unlike traditional frame-by-frame emission and delayed geometry recovery, Streaming4D generates temporal video blocks and immediately triggers reconstruction for each completed block, enabling parallel execution between synthesis and geometric updates.   <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Much of the literature on structured image recognition has disproportionately focused on the comparison of classification algorithms. Rather than investigating which classifier performs best, this paper instead asks: what should a classifier know before it ever makes a prediction? In structured vision problems such as gesture recognition, facial expression categorization, and medical image analysis, discriminative information lies less in individual pixels and more in spatial relationships between semantic parts. Raw pixel spaces are high-dimensional, sensitive to nuisance variation, and often obfuscate the geometric structures that make visual tasks interpretable. Landmark extraction provides one form of dimension reduction, but it does not by itself determine the information preserved. This paper studies the post-landmark feature map as the central object of analysis and proposes a systematic framework for constructing and interpreting landmark-derived representations as an, informed, feature-based ``dimension reduction'' step. Using static hand gesture recognition as a case study, we evaluate coordinate, distance, angle, and hybrid representations through perturbation and ablation experiments. The results show that visually variable data exposes substantial gaps between raw coordinate features and their geometrically invariant counterparts, while hybrid representations achieve the strongest overall performance by combining complementary geometric components. These findings frame feature construction as a fundamental modeling decision and ultimately suggests that the question of what representation should a classifier learn from is one worth asking. </details>

Abstract: Physically Plausible Video Generation (PPVG) seeks to synthesize videos consistent with physical principles, yet remains challenging due to underspecified natural language conditioning. Second, reliance on image-specific textual prompts (requiring additional external models such as CLIP during inference) results in deployment constraints. Furthermore, we introduce a Consensus-knowledge Directional Alignment (CDA) loss, which models the initial state and the ideal target across samples as `complex background' and `bright target', respectively, thereby constructing a clear and unified directional optimization trajectory for the model. Abstract: Flow Matching provides an efficient generative prior for image restoration by learning continuous transport between source and data distributions. However, existing methods typically incorporate measurement constraints through local corrections. Such corrections may disrupt the source-clean endpoint coupling implicitly encoded by the pretrained flow, making the corrected endpoint pair incompatible with the current state. To address this issue, we propose ReBridge-Flow, a posterior bridge re-coupling method. Specifically, given the current state, ReBridge-Flow first decodes the corresponding local source and clean endpoints. It then incorporates measurement information through clean-side anchoring and synchronously re-couples the source endpoint, yielding a measurement-aware endpoint pair with improved local bridge compatibility. The re-coupled endpoints further define a posterior-informed transport direction for advancing the sampling process. We also introduce the Posterior Bridge Defect, which jointly characterizes measurement error, deviation from the flow prior, and bridge mismatch, and leads to explicit updates for clean-side anchoring and source-side re-coupling. Extensive experiments on multiple natural and medical image restoration tasks demonstrate that ReBridge-Flow effectively alleviates bridge mismatch and improves the structural consistency of restored images.

Abstract: Remote sensing visual models have continuously advanced various interpretation tasks. However, the research process behind model improvement still heavily relies on manual expertise, requiring extensive trial-and-error iterations in model design, data processing, and performance diagnosis. Existing agent-based approaches mainly focus on task execution and workflow orchestration, while lacking the capability of autonomous research iteration for continuous performance optimization. To address this issue, we propose RingMoClaw, an experience-inspired self-evolving multi-agent framework for remote sensing visual interpretation. RingMoClaw integrates a research branch, a quality-control branch, and a dual-stream dynamic experience bus to establish a closed-loop optimization process covering strategy generation, experiment execution, independent review, and experience accumulation. The heterogeneous Critic mechanism provides stage-wise diagnosis and feedback, while the dual-stream experience bus incorporates external knowledge and internal experimental experience to guide strategy evolution and eliminate ineffective searches. Extensive experiments on four remote sensing downstream tasks, including object detection, scene classification, semantic segmentation, and change detection, demonstrate the effectiveness and generalization of RingMoClaw. Compared with the corresponding baseline models, RingMoClaw improves performance by 1.84\% mAP$_{50}$ on object detection and achieves consistent gains across the other three tasks, while reducing the required evolution steps by over 40\% compared with existing research automation frameworks. These results suggest that RingMoClaw offers a feasible route from task execution toward continuous research driven model evolution in remote sensing.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Scene text recognition is reported as 89--97% accurate on the six standard benchmarks, and the problem is widely treated as saturated. We present an alternative reading. When the same test images are stratified jointly by ground-truth word rarity and character n-gram novelty against a reference corpus, accuracy at the rare-word x rare-trigram corner of the resulting 5x5 grid drops 10--18 pt below the q3/q3 centre across nine English specialised recognisers, and the same direction (corner below centre) holds on all 13 of 13 (language, model) pairs we test across four writing systems (Latin, Han, Han+kana, Arabic). A 6x vision-backbone scale-up (CLIP4STR-Base 158M -> CLIP4STR-Huge 1.0B, OpenCLIP ViT-H/14 LAION-2B) leads every benchmark in aggregate accuracy yet leaves the stress corner unchanged (86.9 -> 86.5, within paired-bootstrap noise). Four converging probes--layer-wise probing, confidence-when-wrong, attention re-balancing, and a cross-script commit-vs-abstain error split--localise the failure to the autoregressive decoder's lexical prior. We then ask how much of the gap existing techniques recover. Of 16 non-architectural mitigations, the largest mean q5/q5 gain is +1.3 pt and none clears the paired-bootstrap noise floor; the only intervention that does is the architectural shift from autoregressive to CTC decoding (SVTRv2, +2.5 pt, p=0.02, n=474). A confidence-routed AR-CTC ensemble adds a directionally consistent +0.6 pt that stays within noise, and its dominant learned coefficient is each model's own minimum-softmax confidence--independently echoing the mechanism above. No configuration we test improves both the compositional corner and aggregate accuracy. The rare-input long tail thus points to architectural change rather than added capacity.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力权重是否忠实反映模型推理在NLP领域已被广泛探讨，但在视觉语言模型中这一问题的研究几乎空白。该论文旨在填补这一空白。

Abstract: Whether attention weights faithfully reflect model reasoning has been actively debated in NLP, yet this question remains largely unexplored for the visual modality in Vision-Language Models (VLMs). We address this gap through causal perturbation analysis on current VLMs, evaluating both the comprehensiveness and sufficiency gap of attention-ranked visual tokens. Our analysis reveals that visual attention faithfulness is heterogeneous, manifesting in three distinct processing modes: Faithful-Sufficient, where top-$k$ attention tokens are both necessary and sufficient for prediction; Faithful-Distributed, where they are necessary but broader visual context remains required; and Non-Focal, where no localized attention region is individually necessary while visual information remains an essential trigger for prediction. Furthermore, human-annotated ground-truth regions satisfy comprehensiveness in only $\sim 60$% of cases compared with model attention rankings, revealing systematic divergence between model visual reliance and human intuition. We demonstrate these patterns across both general VQA on VQAv2 and document tasks on VRDU and ChartQA, showing that visual attention faithfulness varies systematically with processing demands and model architectures rather than being uniformly faithful or unfaithful.

Rather than indicating that VLM use alone was sufficient for superior performance, the results suggest that top-performing methods benefited from structured report representations, hierarchical diagnostic decomposition, and effective multimodal grounding. We identify key limitations, including instability in quantitative attribute estimation (e.g., numeric hallucination) and a tendency toward diagnostic overspecification, with some errors resembling known diagnostic pitfalls in routine pathology. We name this phenomenon the Visual Insensitivity Gap and quantify it with a per-sample Visual Sensitivity Index (VSI). The gap is a property of samples, not of models: VSI ranks correlate across models (grand-mean Spearman rho=+0.40, permutation p<10^-3), so the same samples are flagged insensitive by VLMs sharing no architectural detail beyond a contrastively pretrained vision tower. Abstract: While feed-forward 3D reconstruction (3R) offers efficient end-to-end modeling, its application in large-scale UAV mapping is hindered by the prohibitive memory cost of Transformer attention. Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have demonstrated strong performance in visual question answering with natural images. Using this pipeline, we construct SciGram, a dataset of over 194K diagrams and 1.4M visual instructions across life, earth, and physical sciences. Despite relying on noisy web data and synthetic annotations, models fine-tuned on SciGram achieve substantial improvements on diagram-centric benchmarks, including TQA, ScienceQA, and AI2D, outperforming or matching state-of-the-art VLMs while using fewer training instances. Furthermore, augmenting existing models such as LLaVA OneVision with SciGram establishes new state-of-the-art performance on diagram question answering. Our results highlight the effectiveness of terminology-grounded instruction generation as a general strategy for improving vision-language reasoning in scientific domains. To support future research in scientific diagram understanding, we release both the SciGram dataset and models.

Abstract: Collaborative perception shares information among multiple agents to obtain a comprehensive scene representation, enhancing the perceptual capability of individual agents. To mitigate transmission delays, we employ a Kalman-filter based tracker and a motion forecasting model to derive the current predictions from historical perception results. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CERF achieves performance comparable to mainstream intermediate-collaboration methods while reducing communication overhead by 95% across various downstream tasks. Furthermore, CERF enables seamless integration of unknown heterogeneous agents into the existing collaborative framework without additional retraining costs. ### [62] [ASSERT: Adaptive Stochastic Sampling for Robust Diffusion Models on Analog Compute-in-Memory Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00955)
*Yuannuo Feng,Yizhe Chen,Wenshuai Yao,Yuxin Xie,Ngai Wong,Wenyong Zhou,Wang Kang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了扩散模型在模拟存内计算（CIM）硬件上的推理噪声鲁棒性问题。作者基于多个物理CIM芯片的实测数据构建并验证了噪声模型，发现扩散模型早期高噪声去噪阶段对硬件噪声最为敏感，并通过一阶轨迹分析揭示了固定硬件映射导致的预测误差相关传播是根本原因。据此提出ASSERT——一种无需训练的高效采样器，在早期注入更高随机性并平滑过渡到确定性去噪，通过改变激活轨迹降低其与持久空间误差的对齐程度，在不改变模型参数和网络评估次数的情况下，最高可将FID降低2.58倍（高分辨率数据集）和7.68倍（CIFAR-10步数研究）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在图像生成上效果优异，但迭代去噪计算成本高昂。模拟存内计算（CIM）可加速矩阵向量乘法，但空间记忆变异会扰动权重并在采样过程中累积。与常规神经网络不同，扩散模型对硬件噪声的时序敏感性尚未被充分探索，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 首先利用多个物理CIM芯片的测量数据校准并验证扩散推理噪声模型；然后通过一阶轨迹分析解释不同去噪阶段对噪声的脆弱性差异；基于分析提出ASSERT采样器，在早期去噪阶段注入较高随机性，随后平滑过渡到确定性DDIM去噪，以改变激活轨迹方向，降低与固定空间错误模式的对齐程度。

Result: ASSERT无需训练、不改变模型参数或网络评估次数。在高分辨率数据集上相比确定性DDIM最高降低FID达2.58倍；在CIFAR-10步数研究中FID降低达7.68倍，展示了显著鲁棒性提升。

Conclusion: 扩散模型对硬件噪声的敏感性存在明显的阶段差异，早期去噪阶段是关键脆弱点。固定硬件映射导致的系统预测误差在去噪轨迹中反复传播是根本原因。通过在早期注入随机性、破坏轨迹与持久硬件误差的校准，可在无需训练的前提下大幅提升扩散模型在CIM硬件上的生成质量，为硬件感知的扩散推理设计提供了新思路。

Abstract: Diffusion models achieve strong image generation quality but incur high iterative denoising costs. Analog compute-in-memory (CIM) can accelerate matrix-vector multiplications, yet spatial memory variations perturb weights and accumulate during sampling. Unlike conventional neural networks, diffusion models' temporal sensitivity to hardware noise remains underexplored. We investigate diffusion inference using a noise model calibrated and validated against measurements collected from multiple physical CIM chips. Our results show that the early, high-noise denoising stage is substantially more vulnerable than the final refinement stage. A first-order trajectory analysis attributes this behavior to the repeated propagation of correlated prediction errors induced by a fixed hardware mapping. Based on this observation, we propose ASSERT, a training-free sampler that uses higher stochasticity early and smoothly transitions to deterministic denoising. The injected stochasticity changes subsequent activation trajectories and thereby reduces their alignment with persistent spatial errors. Across the evaluated settings, ASSERT achieves up to 2.58$\times$ lower FID than deterministic DDIM on high-resolution datasets and 7.68$\times$ lower FID in the CIFAR-10 step-count study, without changing model parameters or the number of network evaluations.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有物体移除方法存在关键缺陷：从图像中移除物体不等于简单地填充其掩码，因为接触阴影和投射阴影通常落在用户提供的实例掩码M_obj之外。冻结的Fill模型只编辑掩码区域，无法处理物体在附近表面上的光度足迹。有监督方法需要成对的清洁图像数据，而训练自由的方法虽然冻结预训练权重，但仍将M_obj视为全部可编辑区域，且用CLIP或DINO能量引导采样，无法预测被遮挡的场景内容。

Method: PredErase采用双管齐下的策略：(1) 接触带扩展——将M_obj扩展为M_flux以在支撑平面上暴露局部残差，决定Fill模型可在哪些像素区域重写；(2) I-JEPA引导——利用预训练用于掩码token预测的I-JEPA在表示空间中提供上下文条件下的孔洞目标，通过稀疏投影梯度使解码的Fill完成结果在实例内部与该目标对齐，而打包支撑区域外的坐标保持锁定。

Conclusion: PredErase证明了在不进行任何训练的前提下，冻结的Fill模型（FLUX.2）与自监督表示模型（I-JEPA）可以协同完成"物体+其光影效果"的联合擦除，打破了Fill模型无法处理掩码外光度足迹的限制。该方法的核心洞见是分离"改写像素的位置"与"孔洞应有的结构"，属于对现有预训练模型的智能编排而非训练增强。

Abstract: Removing an object is not the same as filling its mask. Under instance-only masks on RemovalBench, RORD-Val, and DEFACTO-Val, PredErase improves the native FLUX.2 backbone. Supervised removers remain stronger on several full-image appearance metrics; the supported claim is training-free object-and-effect editing of frozen Fill, not replacement of paired-data erasers.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Abstract: Mixed-format medical visual question answering (VQA) requires stable option selection and machine-readable free-text output.   <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: 通过条件流匹配与多阶段训练策略，可实现仅需极少量配对数据即可训练统一的跨场强MRI翻译模型，兼顾覆盖广度、模型效率和翻译质量。

Abstract: Magnetic resonance images of the same subject look markedly different across field strengths, which complicates the comparison and pooling of data across sites. We phrase the problem as a conditional flow matching path: because the source and target volumes are spatially registered, we learn a velocity field that carries the source slice directly to the target slice, rather than starting from noise. To learn this mapping from only three paired subjects, the unified model is trained in three stages: a degradation-bridge pretraining that distills a restoration prior from the abundant unpaired retrospective cohort, a cross-field finetuning over all directed pairs on the paired cohort, and an adversarial refinement that sharpens the output. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有SAR到EO图像翻译的潜在扩散方法通常继承预训练的自编码器，未考虑不同编码器在SAR条件和EO目标上的重建保真度差异。编码器选择是基础设计决策，但现有方法大多依赖在自然图像上预训练的编码器。

Method: 1) 通过联合SAR-EO重建审计选择最合适编码器；2) 在选定潜在空间中从零训练较小的Conditional DiT；3) 使用双流SAR条件化和联合特征精炼；4) 训练期间将中间噪声EO特征与冻结视觉基础模型提取的干净目标EO特征对齐（仅训练时使用，无推理开销）。

Abstract: SAR-to-EO image translation aims to generate electro-optical (EO) imagery from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) observations. Existing latent diffusion approaches typically inherit a predetermined autoencoder, although reconstruction fidelity can vary substantially across codecs and modalities. Because the latent codec affects the round-trip preservation of both SAR conditions and EO targets, codec selection constitutes a fundamental design choice; nevertheless, existing methods largely rely on codecs pretrained on natural images. To remedy this, we introduce ReFlowSET, a conditional latent flow-matching framework that selects its codec through a joint SAR--EO reconstruction audit. Rather than inheriting a heavyweight pretrained generator, ReFlowSET trains a substantially smaller conditional DiT from scratch in the selected latent space, using dual-stream SAR conditioning followed by joint feature refinement. To provide semantic guidance for this from-scratch training, intermediate noisy-EO features are aligned with clean target-EO representations extracted by a frozen vision foundation model. This alignment is used only during training and introduces no additional inference cost. Experiments on QXS-SAROPT and SAR2Opt demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across diverse perceptual fidelity and distributional metrics. Code and pretrained weights are publicly available at https://github.com/KAIST-VICLab/ReFlowSET.

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有虚拟染色方法严重依赖严格配对且精确配准的训练数据，在常规病理实践中难以获取且成本高昂，限制了其实际应用。

Method: 提出半监督虚拟染色框架：1) 利用Hessian矩阵提取源图像的形态结构线索，约束生成输出保持组织形态；2) 引入病理现实性约束，引导输出具备靶标染色的合理特征，防止结构监督退化为简单轮廓增强或颜色变换。两者共同抑制结构和外观漂移，稳定半监督染色翻译。

Result: 在Ki67和HER2的H&E-to-IHC翻译以及FFPE-to-H&E翻译任务上，实验证明该方法在图像质量、形态保持、鲁棒性和下游诊断性能方面均取得一致改进。

Abstract: Virtual staining aims to computationally generate target-stained histopathological images while reducing the cost and time associated with conventional staining procedures. However, existing methods rely predominantly on strictly paired and accurately registered training data, which are difficult and expensive to obtain in routine practice. To reduce this dependence, we propose a stable semi-supervised virtual staining framework that jointly exploits both limited paired data and abundant unpaired source images. Directly incorporating unpaired images is challenging because their generated results lack corresponding targets for supervision, potentially leading to unrealistic staining, morphological degradation, or even training collapse. To obtain reliable supervision from these images, Hessian-derived morphology preservation extracts structural cues from each source image and constrains the generated output to retain tissue morphology. Histopathological realism constraints further guide the output toward plausible target-stain characteristics, preventing the source-derived structural supervision from degenerating into contour enhancement or simple color transformation. Together, the two components suppress structural and appearance drift, stabilize semi-supervised stain translation, and promote the preservation of diagnostically relevant information. Extensive experiments on H&E-to-IHC translation for Ki67 and HER2, as well as FFPE-to-H&E translation, demonstrate consistent improvements in image quality, morphology preservation, robustness, and downstream diagnostic performance. </details>


### [68] [EvoGS: Modeling Deformation Evolution for Dynamic Gaussian Splatting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00994)
*Wei Dong,Shahram Shirani,Jun Chen,Han Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EvoGS是一个基于3DGS的动态场景重建框架，将高斯变形建模为时间演化过程，通过持久化变形状态、外推未来状态并用MLP观察值校正，配合变形感知的稠密化策略，提升动态新视角合成质量，尤其在大幅或突然运动场景中表现稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于MLP的动态3DGS方法在每个时间戳独立估计高斯变形，对大幅度或突发的运动不够鲁棒，缺乏对时间连续性和历史信息的利用。

Method: 1) 为每个高斯维持持久变形状态，从历史状态外推未来状态；2) 使用MLP派生观测值进行校正，并通过时间残差记忆和演化统计量（如变形速度、轨迹偏差）自适应加权；3) 引入变形感知稠密化，沿校正后的变形方向进行克隆与分裂操作，并用不确定性感知策略抑制历史变形不稳定高斯的稠密化。

Result: EvoGS在动态新视角合成质量上取得改进，并在多个基准数据集上达到具有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 将变形建模为时间演化过程而非独立估计，能够更好地利用时序信息，显著提升动态场景重建在复杂运动条件下的鲁棒性和质量。

Abstract: Recent extensions of 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enable real-time novel view synthesis in dynamic scenes by learning time-conditioned Gaussian deformations. However, existing MLP-based methods typically estimate deformations independently at each timestamp, making them less robust to large or abrupt motions. To address this issue, we propose \textbf{EvoGS}, a 3DGS-based dynamic reconstruction framework that models Gaussian deformation as a temporal evolution process. EvoGS maintains persistent deformation states for each Gaussian, extrapolates future states from historical deformation states, and corrects the predictions with MLP-derived observations. The correction is adaptively weighted using a temporal residual memory and evolution statistics such as deformation velocity and trajectory deviation. To further improve reconstruction quality, EvoGS introduces deformation-aware densification. Clone and split operations are performed along corrected deformation directions, while an uncertainty-aware strategy suppresses densification for Gaussians with unstable deformation histories. Experiments show that EvoGS improves dynamic novel view synthesis quality and achieves competitive performance across benchmarks.

</details>

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于四元数约束的连续归一化流（CNF）方法，用于从单张2D图像进行概率性3D人体姿态估计，直接生成SMPL参数而非仅预测3D关键点，在多个基准数据集上取得领先效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从单张2D图像恢复3D数字人是病态问题（深度信息丢失）。现有概率性3D姿态估计方法多基于生成模型预测3D关键点，但常产生不合理的姿态，难以应用到动画等下游任务。SMPL-based方法具有更好的扩展性和人体先验，但关节旋转的非加性特性使其生成过程建模复杂。

Method: 提出四元数约束的连续归一化流（Quaternion-constrained Continuous Normalizing Flows），以2D姿态估计为条件，直接在SMPL参数空间建模3D人体的概率分布。四元数约束解决了其他旋转表示（如欧拉角、旋转矩阵）在流模型中的局限性。

Result: 在Human3.6M上达到最先进水平，尤其在模糊（多解）场景下表现突出；在具有挑战性的3DPW和EMDB基准上取得与现有方法相当的姿态估计精度。

Conclusion: 四元数流相较于其他旋转表示方法具有显著优势，验证了在SMPL参数空间使用CNF进行概率性3D人体重建的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Recovering 3D digital humans from a single 2D image is an ill-posed computer vision problem due to the loss of depth information. Probabilistic 3D human pose estimation compensates for this by estimating a set of 3D hypotheses from a prior distribution via generative models. However, most prior work focuses only on 3D keypoints, which often leads to implausible poses that are difficult to apply to downstream tasks, e.g. animation or digital humans. SMPL-based methods are more scalable thanks to the explicit body priors, but it requires more complex modeling of the generation process due to the non-additive nature of the joint rotations. In this work, we propose a novel approach for probabilistic 3D humans using quaternion-constrained continuous normalizing flows conditioned on 2D pose estimations. Our proposed quaternion flows show significant advantages over approaches using other rotation representations. Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art results of our method on Human3.6M, particularly in ambiguous settings, and comparable pose estimation accuracy on challenging 3DPW and EMDB benchmarks.

</details>


### [70] [Does This Moment Justify the Recommendation? Counterfactual Behavior-Grounded Evidence Retrieval for Personalized Video Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00996)
*Xin Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出反事实行为驱动的证据检索任务（CBGER），区分"个性化证据发生在何处"与"证据是否存在"，并引入CBGER-10K数据集与CBGER框架来解耦片段级定位与视频级证据估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的个性化视频推荐在视频级别预测用户偏好，时间视频定位则定位查询相关的时刻，但强的定位能力并不能证明检索到的片段对该用户构成有效推荐证据。两者之间缺少对"证据存在性"与"证据位置"的分离评估。

Method: 提出CBGER-10K数据集，包含5,000对受控事实-反事实样本对（3,026位用户），每对仅替换行为支持的片段，同时保留用户、时间位置和困难干扰项。提出CBGER框架，解耦片段级定位与视频级证据估计，并通过结构化反事实监督同时学习两者。

Result: CBGER在五个自适应基线（个性化高亮与时间定位基线）上取得0.4432 MRR、0.6977 Pair Accuracy与0.6987 Intervention Consistency。与QD-DETR相比，MRR提升不显著，但Pair Accuracy提升了11.03个百分点。

Abstract: Personalized video recommendation predicts user preference at the video level, while temporal video grounding localizes query-relevant moments. However, strong localization does not establish whether the retrieved moment constitutes valid evidence for recommending the video to a particular user. We study counterfactual behavior-grounded evidence retrieval, which separates where personalized evidence occurs from whether such evidence exists and evaluates whether model predictions respond consistently when that evidence is replaced. We introduce CBGER-10K, containing 5,000 controlled factual--counterfactual pairs for 3,026 users, where each pair replaces only the focal behavior-supported segment while preserving the user, temporal position, and hard distractors. We further propose CBGER, a compact framework that decouples segment-level localization from video-level evidence estimation and learns both through structured counterfactual supervision. CBGER achieves $0.4432$ MRR, $0.6977$ Pair Accuracy, and $0.6987$ Intervention Consistency across five adapted personalized-highlight and temporal-grounding baselines. Notably, compared with QD-DETR, its MRR improvement is not statistically significant, while Pair Accuracy improves by $11.03$ points. These results show that accurate temporal localization does not necessarily imply reliable personalized evidence existence, motivating explicit evaluation of Whether alongside Where.

</details>


### [71] [SinkPruner: Sink-Free Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01004)
*Shiyu Li,Zi-Yuan Hu,Shijia Huang,Yanyang Li,Yiwu Zhong,Liwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: SinkPruner 是一个无需训练的视觉token剪枝框架，针对多模态大语言模型推理中高范数离群token（异常大特征范数的token）的冗余问题，通过视觉净化器和文本引导剪枝器实现高效的token缩减，在12个图像语言和4个视频语言基准上验证了有效性，89%的token缩减下仍保持96.5%（LLaVA-1.5）和91.8%（Qwen2.5-VL）的原始性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态大语言模型在处理长视觉token序列时计算开销巨大。现有的视觉token剪枝方法（基于视觉中心或文本引导）忽视了高范数离群token的存在——这些token在特征和空间维度上高度冗余，却常被现有方法误认为是信息丰富的线索而保留，导致次优的剪枝决策。

Method: SinkPruner采用由粗到细的两模块设计：(1) 视觉净化器（visual sanitizer）——过滤高范数冗余token，缓解注意力汇聚（attention sink）和注意力分散（attention dispersion）问题；(2) 文本引导剪枝器（text-guided pruner）——进一步保留与文本查询语义对齐的token。该框架无需训练，可直接应用于现有MLLM推理。

Result: 在12个图像语言和4个视频语言基准上的大量实验表明框架的有效性、效率和泛化性。在89%的token缩减率下，SinkPruner分别保留了LLaVA-1.5原始性能的96.5%和Qwen2.5-VL的91.8%。此外，视觉净化器展现出良好的可迁移性，能够增强现有剪枝方法的性能。

Conclusion: SinkPruner揭示了高范数离群token在MLLM剪枝中的冗余本质，通过视觉净化与文本引导的协同剪枝，实现了无需训练的、高效且泛化能力强的视觉token缩减方案，并为现有剪枝方法提供了可增强的模块化组件。

Abstract: Despite their strong multimodal understanding ability, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) incur substantial computational overhead when processing long visual token sequences. To reduce inference costs, recent studies have explored visual token pruning through vision-centric or text-guided strategies. However, these methods often overlook high-norm outlier tokens, i.e., tokens with abnormally large feature norms, leading to suboptimal pruning decisions. In this work, we show that such high-norm outlier tokens are highly redundant in both feature and spatial dimensions, yet are often mistakenly preserved as informative cues by existing methods.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose SinkPruner, a training-free visual token pruning framework for efficient MLLM inference. SinkPruner follows a coarse-to-fine design with two key modules: a visual sanitizer that filters high-norm redundancies and alleviates attention sink and attention dispersion, and a text-guided pruner that further retains tokens semantically aligned with the text query.
  Extensive experiments on twelve image-language and four video-language benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness, efficiency, and generalizability of our framework. Notably, SinkPruner preserves 96.5% (91.8%) of the original performance of LLaVA-1.5 (Qwen2.5-VL) under an 89% token reduction. Experiments further indicate that our visual sanitizer exhibits promising transferability in enhancing the performance of existing pruning methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LaVi-Lab/SinkPruner.

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高质量（HQ）预训练人脸识别模型在低信噪比（SNR）的低质量（LQ）图像上精度显著下降；而直接在LQ数据上微调HQ预训练模型虽然能提升LQ识别性能，却会损害HQ泛化能力，这种权衡在现代多数据集、多质量水平的评测环境中更加突出。此外，大规模模型还面临LQ训练数据稀缺的问题。

Method: 提出统一框架，由三部分组成：(1) 局部概率边际（LPM）——直接从模型的判别景观中估计每个样本的难度；(2) 嵌套注意力模块（NAM）——一种新的低秩适配器，在选定Transformer层内嵌入自注意力机制；(3) 质量门控协议（QGP）——利用现成的图像质量估计器在测试时调节适配器的贡献，使单一模型能覆盖完整质量范围而不牺牲HQ性能。

Result: 在监控场景（TinyFace、SurvFace）和标准人脸识别基准（IJB-B、IJB-C）上的实验表明，该方法在识别（identification）和验证（verification）任务上均取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 提出的统一框架有效解决了低质量与高质量人脸识别之间的性能权衡问题，通过质量门控机制实现单一模型对完整质量谱系的适配，兼顾了LQ识别能力与HQ泛化能力。

Abstract: Low-quality face recognition (LQFR) remains challenging due to the difficulty of matching degraded query (probe) images against low-quality (LQ) enrollment (gallery) imagery and the scarcity of training data for large-scale models. While recent face recognition (FR) models perform well on high-quality (HQ) imagery, their accuracy drops significantly on LQ images with extremely low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Moreover, fine-tuning HQ-pretrained models on LQ data often improves LQ recognition at the expense of HQ generalization. This trade-off becomes more pronounced in modern evaluation settings spanning multiple datasets with varying image quality levels. To address these limitations, we propose a unified framework that combines three main components: (1) Local Probability Margin (LPM), which estimates per-sample difficulty directly from the model's discriminative landscape; (2) Nested Attention Module (NAM), a new low-rank adapter module that embeds a self-attention mechanism within selected transformer layers; and (3) Quality Gating Protocol (QGP), where an off-the-shelf image quality estimator modulates the adapter contribution at test time, enabling a single model to handle the full quality spectrum without sacrificing HQ performance. Experiments on surveillance (TinyFace, SurvFace) and standard (IJB-B, IJB-C) face recognition benchmarks demonstrate consistent gains in both identification and verification. Code and models will be released at github.com/candllq/nam.

</details>

*Ruslan Rozumnyi,Matěj Suchánek,Tomáš Vojíř,Klára Janoušková,Jiří Matas*

TL;DR: 本文提出Fi-ImageNet-1k，一个从ImageNet-1k验证集中利用标注错误构建的OOD数据集。通过专家人工审核并借助MLLM、VLM和反向图像搜索，筛选出655张不属于任何ImageNet-1k类别的图像（来自522个类别）。该数据集比现有OOD基准更具挑战性，在FPR@95指标上比NINCO难3.8倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有OOD检测基准中的OOD图像通常以临时或随意方式定义和收集，缺乏严谨性。作者观察到ID标注数据集本身包含天然OOD图像（即标注错误），这为构建更真实、更具挑战性的OOD基准提供了机会。

Method: 利用ReImageNet重新标注工作中被判定不属于任何ImageNet-1k类别的验证图像。每张图像由专家人工标注者审核，借助MLLM、VLM和反向图像搜索的证据支持，与所有视觉相似的ID类别对比。仅保留能够被分配到ImageNet-1k标签空间之外特定类别的图像。

Result: 最终得到Fi-ImageNet-1k数据集，包含655张来自522个类别的图像。所有评估的分类器与OOD检测器组合在FPR@95指标上均无法达到51%以下的假阳性率。相比NINCO数据集，在FPR@95指标上难3.8倍。

Conclusion: Fi-ImageNet-1k是比现有常见OOD基准更具挑战性的数据集，揭示了当前最先进的监督OOD检测方法在该真实困难场景下仍存在显著性能差距，为该领域的未来研究提出了更高标准。

Abstract: Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection predicts whether a test image belongs to none of the predefined classes. To evaluate this task, benchmarks need images from outside the in-distribution (ID) data; typically, these are defined or collected in an ad hoc fashion. Since no ground truth is perfect, ID-labeled datasets themselves contain a natural source of OOD images. We exploit such annotation errors and present Fi-ImageNet-1k, an OOD dataset built from ImageNet-1k validation images that the recent ReImageNet reannotation effort assigned to no ImageNet-1k class. Each image was examined by expert human annotators supported by evidence from MLLMs, VLMs, and reverse image search, comparing it against all visually similar ID classes. We keep only images that could be assigned a specific class outside the ImageNet-1k label space.
  The resulting Fi-ImageNet-1k, with 655 images from 522 classes, is substantially more challenging than any commonly used OOD dataset. No evaluated combination of classifier and OOD detector achieves a false positive rate below 51% at 95% true positive rate (FPR@95). Compared to the recent NINCO, our dataset is 3.8x more challenging in the FPR@95 metric for state-of-the-art supervised OOD detection methods.

</details>


### [74] [ViTAMINS: An Empirical Study of Training Self-Supervised Vision Transformers with Synthetic Hard Negatives](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01041)
*Nikos Giakoumoglou,Andreas Floros,Kleanthis-Marios Papadopoulos,Tania Stathaki*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ViTAMINS通过将合成硬负样本集成到无监督视觉Transformer预训练中，显著提升表征质量。在ImageNet及多种下游任务上全面验证，表现超越现有方法且资源效率更高（ViT-B超过V-JEPA的ViT-L），甚至产生表征包含显式语义信息的涌现特性，分类性能提升高达11.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战当前视觉预训练领域的主导范式——生成式方法和自蒸馏方法被认为优于对比学习。作者希望通过简单修改现有对比学习框架（引入合成硬负样本），证明对比学习仍然是一种更简单但强大的替代方案。

Abstract: We introduce ViTAMINS, a method that integrates synthetic hard negatives into unsupervised vision transformer pretraining to improve representation quality. Our approach is thoroughly benchmarked on ImageNet and transfer learning, image retrieval, copy detection, and image, video segmentation tasks. Notably, our proposed negatives give rise to emergent properties, where learned representations contain explicit information about the semantic content of an image and serve as excellent classifiers (up to +11.3% over baselines). ViTAMINS achieves these benefits through simple modifications to existing contrastive frameworks and outperforms competing methods while being more resource efficient, e.g., our ViT-B surpasses V-JEPA with ViT-L. Our findings motivate reconsidering contrastive learning as a simpler yet powerful alternative to dominant generative and self-distillation approaches.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在处理动态3D空间推理时依赖视觉-运动相关性的虚假线索，而非真正理解物理运动；在大位移场景下空间推理能力严重退化，缺乏显式的物理监督来实现空间认知。

Method: 提出Dyn-3D基准：利用反事实3D渲染严格解耦视觉变化与真实运动学属性；提出TempoVista框架：采用Kinematic-GSPO算法，将度量级物理真值嵌入策略优化中，使视觉表征显式锚定于3D空间。

Result: 实验表明该方法在运动估计和鲁棒空间推理方面均取得显著提升，验证了将相机动力学作为几何校准信号的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过显式物理监督和反事实基准评估，VLMs能够超越轨迹先验的过拟合，真正实现对3D物理运动的理解与推理。

Abstract: As Vision-Language Models (VLMs) tackle dynamic 3D spatial reasoning, ego-motion perception becomes essential to resolve monocular scale ambiguity. However, current models often overfit to smooth trajectory priors rather than genuinely understanding physical motion. Consequently, their spatial reasoning degrades severely under large displacements, a phenomenon we term Kinematic Collapse. This failure stems from spurious visual-motion correlations in natural videos and a lack of explicit physical supervision. To evaluate this, we introduce Dyn-3D, a benchmark using counterfactual 3D rendering to rigorously decouple visual changes from true kinematic properties. Furthermore, we propose the TempoVista framework, featuring the Kinematic-GSPO algorithm. By embedding metric physical ground truth into policy optimization, TempoVista explicitly grounds visual representations in 3D space. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly improves both motion estimation and robust spatial reasoning by utilizing camera dynamics as an effective geometric calibration signal.

</details>

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本引导图像融合方法依赖浅层语义-视觉交互和有限的注意力机制，难以稳健处理复杂退化情况，也无法充分利用文本引导信息。

Method: 提出迭代式文本引导融合框架，包含三个核心模块：(1) 最深层交叉注意力(Cross-Attention)；(2) 多尺度交叉门控融合(Cross-Gate Fusion)；(3) 阶段特定文本条件调制(stage-specific text-conditioned modulation)。通过将池化后的文本嵌入反复注入层次化解码器和细化阶段，实现退化感知的全局语义条件控制，同时保留可见光和红外模态的互补信息。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法在多项信息保持和感知质量指标上均有提升，但在部分数据集上呈现出指标相关的权衡特性。

Conclusion: 通过多阶段、迭代式的文本条件注入，可以有效增强图像融合过程中的语义引导能力，验证了深层跨模态交互在复杂融合任务中的有效性，但也暴露出不同评估指标间存在一定冲突。

Abstract: Text-guided image fusion has recently emerged as an effective paradigm for integrating multi-modal information while enabling flexible and task-oriented fusion control. However, existing text-guided fusion methods often rely on shallow semantic-visual interaction and limited attention mechanisms, which restrict their ability to robustly handle complex degradations and fully exploit textual guidance. In this paper, we propose an iterative text-guided image fusion framework that incorporates text-conditioned feature interaction across multiple fusion and refinement stages. The proposed method integrates deepest-level Cross-Attention, multi-scale Cross-Gate Fusion, and stage-specific text-conditioned modulation, allowing the global text embedding to condition hierarchical feature fusion and residual refinement. By repeatedly injecting the pooled text embedding across hierarchical decoder and refinement stages, the proposed framework provides degradation-aware global semantic conditioning while preserving complementary information from the visible and infrared modalities. Experiments on several benchmark datasets show that the proposed method improves several information-preservation and perceptual-quality metrics, while exhibiting metric-dependent trade-offs on some datasets.

</details>


### [77] [P-PatchDiff: Progressive Patch Diffusion Models for Low-light Image Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01123)
*Ruoyu Guo,Haonan Zhong,Maurice Pagnucco,Yang Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出P-PatchDiff，一种可扩展的渐进式补丁扩散框架，用于低光图像增强。它在去噪过程中动态调整补丁大小，实现从局部到全局视角的渐进过渡，并引入Multi-Patch Alignment策略，通过全局亮度代理归一化不同补丁尺度的特征，从而在不增加过多计算成本的前提下捕获图像级亮度上下文，确保局部增强补丁在全图中的视觉连贯性。实验表明该方法可处理400×600到4K分辨率的图像，比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，内存占用低于9GB。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于补丁扩散模型的低光图像增强方法通常依赖小而固定的补丁（如64×64），无法捕获图像级亮度上下文；而扩大感受野虽能改善亮度与色彩估计，但计算成本大幅上升。此外，低光图像各区域亮度不均，局部增强补丁拼接成全图时需保持视觉连贯性，这些限制促使本文探索可扩展且连贯的方案。

Method: 提出P-PatchDiff渐进式补丁扩散框架，在去噪过程中动态调整补丁尺寸，实现从局部到全局视野的渐进过渡；同时引入Multi-Patch Alignment策略，利用估计的全局亮度代理对不同补丁尺度的特征进行归一化，使模型能够感知多尺度信息，聚焦于可扩展性与全图亮度连贯性而非逐像素重建精度。

Result: 实验证明P-PatchDiff能有效增强从400×600到4K分辨率范围的图像，比现有补丁扩散模型快80倍，且内存使用低于9GB，兼顾了高效性与亮度感知能力。

Conclusion: P-PatchDiff通过动态补丁缩放与多补丁对齐策略，在效率与亮度上下文捕获之间取得了良好平衡，为低光图像增强提供了一种可扩展到高分辨率的解决方案，并已开源代码供社区使用。

Abstract: Recent advancements in low-light image enhancement have leveraged diffusion models for their strong ability to generate perceptually realistic, detailed images. Patch diffusion models further offer a promising solution to size-agnostic image restoration while improving efficiency. However, existing methods typically rely on small, fixed patches (e.g., 64$\times$64) that cannot capture image-level brightness context, whereas enlarging the receptive field improves brightness and colour estimation but substantially increases computational cost. Moreover, low-light images often exhibit uneven brightness across regions, making it necessary to ensure that locally enhanced patches remain visually coherent when combined into the full image. To address these limitations, we propose P-PatchDiff, a scalable progressive patch diffusion framework for low-light image enhancement that dynamically adjusts patch size throughout the denoising process, enabling a gradual shift from local to global views. A Multi-Patch Alignment strategy is also introduced to normalise features across varying patch scales using an estimated global brightness proxy. Rather than pursuing pixel-level reconstruction accuracy, P-PatchDiff focuses on scalability and coherent brightness across the whole image, allowing the model to perceive multi-scale information and better enhance regions with varying brightness. We empirically demonstrate that P-PatchDiff effectively enhances images ranging from 400 $\times$ 600 to 4K and is 80$\times$ faster than existing patch diffusion models while using less than 9GB of memory. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/P-PatchDiff.

</details>


### [78] [Different Changes Require Different Reasoning: Change-Type-Specialized Experts for Robust Change Captioning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01136)
*Jiyoung Park,InJae Oh,Jung Uk Kim*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MEDIC框架，通过显式建模变化类别并采用类型专用记忆专家来实现变化描述的类别感知，在多个数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 变化描述任务中，不同类型的变化（如颜色变化、物体添加）具有不同的视觉线索和推理需求，但现有方法忽略了这些类别差异，采用统一处理方式导致描述不够精准。

Method: 提出MEDIC框架：(1) 引入变化类型感知，显式建模变化类别；(2) 使用类型专用记忆专家，动态检索与输入相关的类型视觉模式；(3) 通过软路由将输入分配到各类型专家，并学习每个类别的专用表示，从而生成更精确、类型感知的变化描述。

Result: 在多个多样且具挑战性的数据集上，MEDIC一致性地优于现有方法，验证了其有效性。

Conclusion: 显式建模变化类型并利用类型专用专家可以有效提升变化描述的准确性和精细度，代码已开源。

Abstract: Change captioning is the task of generating natural language descriptions that explain the changes between a pair of images. Although different change types (e.g., color shifts, object additions) exhibit distinct visual cues and require specialized reasoning processes, existing methods often overlook these distinctions. To address this limitation, we propose Multi-Expert Diagnosis for Image Change (MEDIC), a novel framework that introduces change-type awareness by explicitly modeling change categories. MEDIC employs type-specialized memory experts that dynamically retrieve type-relevant visual patterns conditioned on the input. This design enables each expert to capture diverse variations within its change type while focusing on the most informative visual cues. By softly routing inputs across type-specialized experts and learning dedicated representations for each change category, MEDIC generates more precise and type-aware change descriptions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed MEDIC consistently outperforms existing methods across diverse and challenging datasets. The code is available at \href{https://github.com/VisualAIKHU/MEDIC}{GitHub}.

</details>


### [79] [Revisiting Face Recognition for Monozygotic Twins: The Celeb Twins Test Set](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01141)
*Michael Zang,Haiyu Wu,Mrinal Sharma,Kevin W. Bowyer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个新的双胞胎人脸识别测试集CTTS（Celeb Twins Test Set），包含80对名人双胞胎的网络图片对，并带有皮肤标记和镜像不对称等元数据。研究发现当前深度CNN人脸匹配器在该测试集上准确率仅约76%，且并未利用皮肤标记或不对称性特征。文章还探讨了使用生成式AI工具创建虚拟同卵双胞胎图像以扩充训练数据的可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同卵双胞胎具有几乎相同的外貌，是人脸识别中最具挑战性的场景之一。过往研究指出皮肤标记和镜像不对称性可能有助于提升双胞胎识别准确率，但缺乏带有此类元数据的测试集来验证这一假设。作者因此构建了CTTS测试集，并考察现有匹配器在这类难例上的表现。

Method: 1) 构建CTTS测试集：从网络抓取80对名人双胞胎的图像对，组织方式参照LFW、CALFW等主流人脸验证测试集，并为每对双胞胎标注区分性皮肤标记和可能的镜像不对称元数据。2) 使用当前深度CNN人脸匹配器对CTTS进行同人/不同人分类评估。3) 分析匹配器是否利用了皮肤标记或不对称性特征。4) 讨论利用Grok、ChatGPT、Gemini等生成式AI工具生成想象的同卵双胞胎图像以扩充训练集的可行性。

Result: 当前深度CNN人脸匹配器在CTTS上可实现超过76%的验证准确率，但明显低于在LFW等常规测试集上的表现。实验分析表明，现有匹配器并未有效利用皮肤标记或镜像不对称性信息，作者讨论了其中的可能原因（如训练数据中此类特征信号不足、CNN倾向于学习全局外观特征等）。

Conclusion: CTTS为双胞胎人脸识别研究提供了一个带丰富元数据的基准测试集。现有深度匹配器在双胞胎识别上仍有较大提升空间，且未充分利用皮肤标记和不对称性等线索。生成式AI工具可能为扩充双胞胎训练数据提供新的方向，但其可行性仍需进一步验证。

Abstract: Past literature on face recognition for monozygotic (("identical") twins points to facial marks and mirror asymmetry as possible directions for improved accuracy of twins recognition. The Celeb Twins Test Set (CTTS) contains web-scraped image pairs for 80 sets of celebrity twins. It is the only twins test set with meta-data for twins with distinguishing skin marks and possible mirror asymmetry. CTTS is organized in the manner of face verification test sets such as LFW, CALFW, CPLFW, CFP-FP, and AgeDB-30. Current deep CNN matchers can achieve over 76% accuracy in classifying CTTS same-person / different-person image pairs. We show that current matchers do not make use of skin marks, or asymmetry, and discuss reasons for this. Finally, we discuss the feasibility of using generative AI tools such as Grok, ChatGPT and Gemini to create images of imagined monozygotic twins as a means to increase representation of twins in face recognition training sets.

</details>


### [80] [StainPresetNet: Stain Preset Network for Fast Multi-to-Multi Stain Normalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01146)
*Hongtao Kang,Die Luo,Li Chen,Jing Cai,Junbo Hu,Xiuli Liu,Shenghua Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出StainPresetNet框架，结合结构保留与数据集级颜色映射，通过预设参考图像引导像素级归一化，支持多方向适配且无需重新训练，在计算效率上较深度学习方案降低90%开销，同时提升分类器泛化性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统染色归一化方法虽然风格灵活，但依赖单一或有限参考图像导致颜色映射提取不准确；现有深度学习方法虽能实现精确的数据集级颜色映射，却面临计算效率低、产生伪影以及固定归一化方向需要重新训练模型等问题。作者旨在克服这些局限。

Method: 提出StainPresetNet框架，结合结构保留机制与数据集级颜色映射，采用预设参考图像引导的像素级归一化实现，通过简单替换参考图像即可灵活调整归一化方向，无需模型重训练。

Result: 在细胞病理学和组织病理学数据集上的评估表明：相比传统方法取得更优的颜色映射精度；有效提升诊断任务中分类器的泛化能力；相比现有深度学习方法计算开销降低90%。

Conclusion: StainPresetNet通过预设引导机制解决了当前深度学习染色归一化方法的方向固定性问题，实现了高效、灵活且精确的颜色归一化，为计算病理诊断系统提供了实用的预处理方案。

Abstract: Stain normalization reduces color variations caused by variations in staining protocols and imaging conditions, thereby enhancing computer-aided diagnostic system performance. Traditional methods derive mapping relationships from individual or limited reference images through pixel-wise transformation, offering style flexibility but suffering from inaccurate color mapping extraction. While existing deep-learning-based approaches achieve accurate dataset-wide color mapping through complex neural networks, they face challenges including computational inefficiency, artifact generation, and fixed normalization directions requiring model retraining for directional changes. To address these limitations, we propose StainPresetNet - a novel framework that combines structural preservation with dataset-level color mapping while maintaining computational efficiency. Our method implements pixel-wise normalization guided by preset reference images, enabling multi-directional adaptability without retraining. Evaluations on cytopathology and histopathology datasets demonstrate that StainPresetNet achieves superior color mapping accuracy compared to conventional methods, effectively improves classifier generalization in diagnostic tasks, and reduces computational overhead by 90\% versus existing deep learning approaches. The proposed preset-guided mechanism facilitates flexible adjustment of normalization directions through simple reference image replacement, overcoming the directional rigidity of current deep-learning-based solutions.

</details>


### [81] [On the Design Fundamentals of Pixel Text Representation Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01147)
*Chaohao Yuan,Ruifeng Yuan,Zhuoxu Huang,Yu Rong,Hong Cheng,Hou Pong Chan,Chenghao Xiao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出Pixel Linguist II，一种原生分辨率视觉编码器，通过系统性对照实验识别出四个关键设计原则（可变图像分辨率和渲染字体大小、自然图像-文本对、布局感知渲染、两阶段多语言课程），在280M训练样本上训练，在英文、跨语言和多语言Visual STS及ViDoRe基准上取得SOTA结果，并在MLLM下游评估和80%视觉token压缩场景下表现稳健。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有像素文本编码器存在固定分辨率预训练、视觉捷径学习、弱视觉定位和多语言视觉文本理解不足等缺陷，需要探索更稳健的视觉文本表示学习的基本设计原则。

Method: 通过系统化受控消融实验识别四个关键组件：(1)可变图像分辨率和渲染字体大小以提供高分辨率文档泛化的空间代理；(2)自然图像-文本对保证grounding并防止纯文本坍缩；(3)布局感知渲染以防止像素级别捷径；(4)两阶段多语言课程实现有效的跨语言对齐。将这些原则整合进可扩展训练方案，采用实时渲染、统一对比grounding和多语言课程，在280M训练样本上训练Pixel Linguist II。

Result: Pixel Linguist II在英文、跨语言和多语言Visual STS及ViDoRe基准上创下新的SOTA结果，同时提升MLLM下游评估性能。在80%视觉token压缩下仍保持稳健性，展示了光学上下文压缩的巨大潜力。

Conclusion: 通过系统地研究视觉文本表示学习的设计原则，作者证明了原生分辨率、自然图像文本对、布局感知渲染和多语言课程训练这四个因素的整合可以显著提升像素级文本理解能力，并为多语言视觉文本编码和光学上下文压缩开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Text-rich visual inputs require models that can read, retrieve, and compress language directly in pixel space, yet existing pixel-text encoders struggle with fixed resolution pretraining, visual shortcut learning, weak visual grounding, and multilingual visual text understanding. In this work, we investigate the fundamental design principles required for robust visual text representation learning. Through systematic controlled ablations, we identify four critical components: variable image resolutions and rendered font sizes provide spatial proxies for high-resolution document generalization; natural image-text pairs are indispensable for grounding and prevent text-only collapse; layout-aware rendering helps prevent pixel-level shortcuts; and a two-stage multilingual curriculum enables effective cross-lingual alignment. By integrating these principles into a scalable training recipe, we train Pixel Linguist II, a native-resolution vision encoder trained with on-the-fly rendering, unified contrastive grounding, and a multilingual curriculum over 280M training examples. Pixel Linguist II sets new state-of-the-art results on English, cross-lingual, and multilingual Visual STS and ViDoRe, while also enabling better MLLM downstream evaluation. Notably, Pixel Linguist II remains robust under 80\% visual token compression, showing great promise for optical context compression. Our code and resources are available at https://github.com/Pixel-Linguist/Pixel-Linguist-II.

</details>


### [82] [Dotting the Eye: An Intent-Driven Image Retouching Agent for Visual Focus Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01148)
*Chujie Qin,Zilong Zhang,Zewei Chang,Chunle Guo,Ruixing Wang,Tao Hu,Ming-Ming Cheng,Chongyi Li*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出EyeControl，一个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）驱动的智能体系统，通过扩散模型执行图像修图，实现视觉焦点增强。用户只需少量点击或粗略笔画即可引导注意力到目标区域，系统通过意图解析、注意力对齐和操作一致性约束实现自然且符合意图的修图效果，并贡献了ControlArt-Bench评估数据集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统图像修图仅关注整体视觉质量的颜色调整，但实际场景中修图也需强调视觉焦点以引导观看者注意力。焦点导向修图需要全局与局部调整的精细协调来操控感知显著性并保持视觉自然性，这对专业知识和经验要求极高。现有的弱用户意图（如少量点击）难以捕捉精确的编辑区域和色调操作意图。

Method: 1) 系统先利用MLLM解析用户意图和图像内容，推断视觉焦点区域并生成结构化的意图引导。2) 扩散修图执行器被设计为对目标区域有更强响应，显式将其注意力图与设计的伪意图图对齐。3) 引入操作一致性约束以协调全局与局部调整，保证修图自然连贯。4) 构建ControlArt-Bench高质量图像视觉焦点增强评估数据集。

Result: 大量实验表明EyeControl在意图对齐和感知质量上均优于现有方法，能产生更具吸引力的视觉焦点增强修图效果。

Conclusion: EyeControl成功实现了在弱用户意图条件下自动化的视觉焦点引导修图，验证了将MLLM意图理解与扩散修图执行器结合的有效性，为焦点导向图像编辑提供了新思路。

Abstract: Image retouching is commonly formulated as enhancing overall visual quality through color adjustment, but in practice, it also serves to emphasize visual focus by guiding viewers' attention toward a specific subject or region. Achieving such focus-oriented retouching is inherently challenging, as it requires well-coordinated global and local adjustments to manipulate perceptual saliency while maintaining visual naturalness. This intricate process typically demands substantial professional expertise. In this study, we propose EyeControl, a MLLM-driven agent with a diffusion-based retouching executor that enables visual focus enhancement under weak user intent. With only a few clicks or coarse strokes, EyeControl directs visual attention to the intended region, effectively "dotting the eye" of the image. The core idea is to explicitly link the weak user intention with the target editing region and the corresponding tonal adjustment operations during retouching. To achieve this, the system first interprets the intent and image content to infer the visual focus and generate structured intent guidance for the retouching executor. Second, the retouching executor is encouraged to respond more strongly to the target region, explicitly aligning its attention map with a designed pseudo-intent map. We also introduce an operation-consistency constraint to improve coordination between global and local adjustments, achieving more natural and coherent retouching. Additionally, we contribute ControlArt-Bench, a high-quality evaluation dataset for visual focus enhancement. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that EyeControl yields perceptually appealing results with stronger intent alignment. Code can be found in https://github.com/DragonisCV/EyeControl.

</details>


### [83] [Monocular Depth Estimation from a Single Image: Progress and Opportunities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01172)
*Muxin Liu,Xiaoyang Lyu,Yang-Tian Sun,Yi-Hua Huang,Ziyi Yang,Peng Dai,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于单目深度估计的综合性综述，系统梳理了该领域从早期学习方法到基础模型时代的演变历程，涵盖问题定义、数据集、方法分类、应用场景及未来挑战。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单目深度估计是计算机视觉中的基础挑战，支撑着3D重建、机器人、自动驾驶和增强现实等广泛应用。该领域已历经十年发展并进入基础模型时代，需要一个系统性的综述来梳理知识脉络、对比方法优劣并指明未来方向。

Method: 该综述采用系统性梳理的研究方法：首先界定问题框架（区分相对深度与度量深度），然后介绍常用数据集（室内/室外/合成数据），接着按时间线回顾基础模型时代之前的重大进展，再重点分类介绍基础模型时代的方法（判别式与生成式范式），并通过定量基准与定性示例对比代表性模型，最后扩展到视频深度估计和应用集成。

Result: 综述梳理了单目深度估计从传统学习方法到基础模型（如DINOv3）驱动方法的完整演进，对比了判别式与生成式两大范式的代表性模型，并探讨了向视频深度估计的自然扩展以及在视觉SLAM、内容生成和机器人感知等实际应用中的集成。

Conclusion: 该领域正处于基础模型时代，大规模预训练和合成数据发挥着关键作用。文章最后指出仍有开放挑战和值得探索的研究方向亟待解决，为该领域的未来研究提供了指引。

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has long stood as a fundamental challenge in computer vision, enabling a wide range of applications including 3D reconstruction, robotics, autonomous driving, and augmented reality. This survey traces the field's evolution from early learning-based methods to the emergence of transformative foundation models. We begin by framing the problem, distinguishing between relative and metric depth estimation, and highlighting the key challenges that have shaped a decade of research. We then present common problem formulations and introduce the most widely used datasets, covering indoor, outdoor, and synthetic data. Following this, we review major advances prior to the foundation model era, distilling core insights from influential methods that contributed to improvements in accuracy, efficiency, and robustness. The survey then turns to the recent surge of foundation-model-based approaches, categorizing them into discriminative and generative paradigms and emphasizing the critical roles of large-scale pretraining (e.g., DINOv3) and synthetic data. We compare representative models using both quantitative benchmarks and qualitative examples, and discuss natural extensions to video-based depth estimation. Further, to illustrate real-world impact, we highlight the integration of depth estimation into applications such as visual SLAM, content generation, and robot perception. Finally, we outline open challenges and promising research directions as the field advances further into the era of foundation models.

</details>


### [84] [Compressing AI Traffic: Standardized Neural Network Coding of Visual-Token Representations in Split Vision-Language Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01200)
*Reza Heidari,Hamed R. Tavakoli,Juho Kannala*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了视觉语言模型（VLM）在跨计算节点部署时，视觉token嵌入作为"AI流量"的压缩问题。作者在Qwen3-VL-8B视频问答流水线的完整视觉接口上插入ISO/IEC 15938-17神经网络编码（NNC）标准编解码器，发现即使传输张量被压缩98%（BF16），下游任务精度仍保持稳定，直到极限压缩才崩溃。该鲁棒性源于任务仅依赖粗粒度结构和相对几何关系，而非精确浮点值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当VLM的视觉编码器和语言解码器运行在不同计算节点时，中间视觉token嵌入成为通信负载而非内部激活。作者将此类机器消费的中间张量称为"AI流量"，提出关键问题：能否用标准化、免训练编解码器对其进行高效压缩？这源于分布式推理场景中对降低通信开销的迫切需求。

Method: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct视频问答流水线的完整视觉接口上（包括主视觉token表征和DeepStack特征流），插入ISO/IEC 15938-17 NNC标准往返编解码，同时保持权重、提示和生成过程不变，并在宽码率范围内扫描量化参数（QP）。评估采用封闭式Video-MME精度和开放式MLVU生成（LLM裁判评判），并分析压缩后张量的重建误差与奇异值特性。

Result: 封闭式Video-MME精度在传输BF16张量压缩高达98%时仍接近未压缩参考值，之后才崩溃；开放式MLVU生成在LLM裁判下呈现相同的平台-崩溃曲线。解码张量高度离散化，具有显著的逐行相对L2误差，奇异值衰减比源张量更陡峭，表明并非近无损重建。

Conclusion: 下游推理依赖于粗粒度结构和相对几何关系而非精确浮点值，这论证了AI流量编解码器应采用率-任务（rate-task）优化而非传统的率-失真（rate-distortion）优化范式，为该领域提出新的优化方向。

Abstract: When the visual encoder and the language decoder of a vision-language model (VLM) run on different compute nodes, the intermediate visual-token embeddings become a communicated payload rather than an internal activation. We call such machine-consumed intermediate tensors AI traffic and ask how far they can be compressed with a standardized, training-free codec. We insert ISO/IEC 15938-17 Neural Network Coding (NNC) round trips on the complete visual interface of a Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct video question answering pipeline, comprising the main visual-token representation and the DeepStack feature streams, while leaving weights, prompts, and generation untouched, and sweep the quantization parameter (QP) over a wide rate range. Closed-ended Video-MME accuracy remains close to the uncompressed reference up to a 98% reduction of the transmitted BF16 tensor and only then collapses; open-ended MLVU generation shows the same plateau-and-collapse profile under an LLM judge. This robustness is not due to near-lossless reconstruction: the decoded tensor is heavily discretized, carries substantial row-wise relative L2 error, and has a visibly steeper singular-value decay than its source. Downstream reasoning therefore depends on coarse structure and relative geometry rather than exact floating-point values, which argues for rate-task rather than rate-distortion optimization of AI traffic codecs.

</details>


### [85] [S$^2$Prune: Spatially Structured Visual Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01224)
*Yuanyuan Jia,Shunpu Tang,Qianqian Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出S²Prune，一种训练免费的视觉token剪枝方法，通过区域划分保证空间覆盖、利用Laplacian变化分配token密度、并以第一解码块的Early Representation Change选择代表性token。在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上以576→32个token仍保留79.3%的全模型性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉token剪枝方法基于重要性或冗余度选择token，但作者观察到这些标准在输入间产生稳定的空间偏差，且并不总是优于简单的Uniform Grid采样，说明广泛的空间覆盖比看似"聪明"的选择更重要。

Method: 三步训练免费剪枝流程：(1) 将图像划分为区域并为每个区域分配至少一个token以保留空间覆盖；(2) 根据Laplacian变化（局部梯度/结构丰富度）将剩余token预算分配到各区域；(3) 利用第一解码块计算的Early Representation Change(ERC)在每个区域内选择代表性token。

Result: 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct等多种设置和两种MLLM架构上评估，S²Prune在训练免费剪枝方法中取得最高平均准确率；仅用576个原始视觉token中的32个即可保留79.3%的全模型性能。

Conclusion: 通过平衡空间覆盖与局部结构密度，S²Prune验证了剪枝不应只看token重要性，空间均匀性保护是维持MLLM性能的关键因素。代码已开源。

Abstract: Visual token pruning reduces the inference overhead of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) by retaining only a subset of visual tokens. Existing methods usually select tokens based on importance or redundancy. However, we observe that these criteria produce stable spatial biases across inputs and do not always outperform simple Uniform Grid sampling, highlighting the value of broad spatial coverage. Motivated by this, we propose S$^2$Prune, a training-free pruning method that preserves spatial coverage while adapting token density to local image structure. We first divide the image into regions and assign at least one token to each region to preserve coverage. The remaining token budget is then distributed according to Laplacian variation, giving more tokens to regions with richer structure. We then use Early Representation Change (ERC), computed from the first decoder block, to select representative tokens within each region. We evaluate S$^2$Prune across diverse settings and two MLLM architectures. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, it achieves the highest average accuracy among the evaluated training-free pruning methods. With only 32 of the original 576 visual tokens, it still retains 79.3% of the full-model performance. Code is available at https://github.com/yuanyuanjia71-spec/S2Prune.

</details>


### [86] [One Prompt Is Enough: Watermark Laundering Through Foundation Image Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01249)
*Jidong Yang,Qi Li,Wei Zong,Yang-Wai Chow,Willy Susilo,Huaike Yu,Chunpeng Wang,Suo Gao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文揭示并形式化了"水印清洗"（watermark laundering）这一新型威胁：攻击者只需将带不可见水印的图像提交给基础图像模型进行单次重建提示，即可获得视觉上忠实但水印无法解码的输出。作者在六个OpenAI/Google编辑模型、三种水印方案和1800个重建输出上评估，发现重建路径本身即可破坏水印载荷，无需明确的移除攻击提示，并提出将基础模型重建作为不可见水印评测的缺失鲁棒性条件。
