Method: 基于500条MedQA条目构建基准，每条改写为四种风格（教科书、患者、临床笔记、口语），标注医学专科，并与MedMCQA和MMLU-medical两个语料库进行跨数据集评估。探测四个开源LLM（2-8B）的隐藏状态。

Result: 真值方向对写作风格高度稳健（平均Δregister≈0.10 AUROC）和对医学专科稳健（Δspecialty≈0.03），但跨语料库退化不均：MMLU-medical下降0.12，MedMCQA下降0.21（约为风格差异的两倍）。注册结果通过第二生成器复现，并延续到人类撰写的患者问题。

Conclusion: 真值方向在医学领域内大体稳定，但在某些语料库转移下失效；问题格式无法解释这种失效，表明线性探针捕捉的信号部分绑定于数据集结构，而非仅依赖医学知识本身。

Abstract: Linear classifiers trained on hidden states of a large language model (LLM), linear probes, can flag factual errors from a single forward pass. Geometrically, that implies that true and false statements separate along a stable direction in hidden state space, i.e., the truth direction. Prior work disagrees on whether this generalises across input shifts, but the disagreement is hard to interpret because cross-dataset probe transfer experiments confound several kinds of input change at once. We isolate three such variables in medical question-answering (QA): writing style (register), domain (medical specialty), and corpus (dataset). We build a benchmark using 500 MedQA entries, each rewritten into four styles (textbook, patient, clinical note, colloquial), annotated with clinical specialty, and grouped with two other exam corpora, MedMCQA and MMLU-medical, for cross-dataset evaluation. Probing four open-weight LLMs (2--8B), we find that the truth direction is largely robust to writing style (mean $Δ_\text{register} \approx 0.10$ AUROC on held-out facts) and to medical specialty ($Δ_\text{specialty} \approx 0.03$), but degrades unevenly across corpora: by $0.12$ AUROC on MMLU-medical and by $0.21$ on MedMCQA, roughly twice the register gap. The register result replicates with a second generator and carries over to human-written patient questions. The truth direction is therefore largely stable within the medical domain but breaks under some corpus shifts, and question format does not explain the break, which suggests that the signal a linear probe recovers is partly bound to dataset structure rather than to medical knowledge alone.

</details>


### [227] [How Correct Is Your Answer? A Semantic Correctness Framework for Open QA Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01369)
*Elitsa Yotkova,Violeta Kastreva,Petar Velkov,Hristo Boyanov,Dimitar Dimitrov,Ivan Koychev,Preslav Nakov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文针对开放域问答的可靠性评估问题，提出了一个语义正确性分类体系（八个有序类别）、两个基准数据集（CAP-Correctness 和 CAP-Statements），以及一个基于双向NLI的参考指标CAP，用于更精细地区分不同质量级别的自由形式答案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放域问答的答案评估是当前LLM正确性衡量的瓶颈。与选择题不同，自由形式答案可能以多种表面形式正确，也可能以不同方式失败（如不完整、矛盾、过度生成、认可虚假前提）。现有的基于判断和基于相似度的指标往往无法区分这些细微差异。

Method: 本文提出三个可复用贡献：(1) 一个语义正确性分类体系，将开放域答案分为八个有序类别，区分冗长但正确的答案与包含幻觉内容的答案；(2) CAP-Correctness基准（8.8k示例）和CAP-Statements数据集（11k示例，用于将QA对转换为声明句以支持NLI训练和基于语句的评估）；(3) CAP指标，一种基于引用的度量，使用双向NLI对问题条件下的语句进行评分。

Result: 在单调性协议（测试指标是否尊重分类体系预期排序）的评估下，CAP指标优于既有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过引入有序分类体系和专用数据集及指标，本文为开放域问答的正确性评估提供了更细致和可靠的解决方案，有助于更准确地衡量LLM的回答质量。

Abstract: Reliable evaluation of open-ended question answering remains a bottleneck for measuring answer correctness of modern LLMs. Unlike multiple-choice tasks, free-form answers may be correct in many surface forms and may fail in qualitatively different ways, including incompleteness, contradiction, overgeneration, and endorsement of false premises. Existing judgment-based and similarity-based metrics often collapse these distinctions. We address this gap with three reusable contributions. First, we introduce a semantic correctness taxonomy that assigns open-ended answers to eight ordered classes, separating verbose-but-correct answers from those contaminated by hallucinated content. Second, we release CAP-Correctness, an 8.8k-example benchmark spanning widely used QA datasets, and CAP-Statements, an 11k-example dataset for converting question-answer pairs into declarative statements for natural language inference (NLI) training and statement-based evaluation. Third, we introduce CAP (Context-Aware Precision), a reference-based metric that scores question-conditioned statements using bidirectional NLI. Under a monotonicity protocol testing whether metrics respect the taxonomy's intended ordering, CAP outperforms established baselines.

</details>


### [228] [Behaviorally Effective LoRA Writes Are Sparse and Structured](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01374)
*Haruto Sato,Yuki Tanaka,Ren Nakamura,Aoi Kobayashi,Mei Ito*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文直接研究低秩适配（LoRA）写入中真正承载行为的部分，发现行为有效的LoRA写入是稀疏、结构化且远比原始低秩参数化所暗示的更集中。通过Learned-Basis LoRA（学习基连续化方案）暴露这种结构，实验表明有用的写入信号集中在极少数模块方向中。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA固定了更新的秩（rank），但并未识别训练写入中哪些部分真正承载行为。现有方法对写入的结构和有效性缺乏直接理解，作者希望直接回答"LoRA写入中哪些部分真正有效"这一问题。

Method: 提出Learned-Basis LoRA（学习基连续化方案）：先热身一个无约束适配器，将其学习到的写入列转换为模块级正交基，冻结该基，然后在约束参数化内继续训练。通过14次精确切换验证、同状态连续化实验、无重训练投影测试、局部与全局top-k延续测试以及单方向消融实验来揭示写入结构。

Result: 跨14次从无约束到约束形式的精确切换，保持精度不变，重构写入矩阵相对Frobenius误差不超过0.25%。在GSM8K、MathQA和AQuA上，逐模块top-k延续在k∈{2,4}处达到最优（12个种子级案例全部如此）。全局排名测试表明学习到的top-16和top-32子集优于随机子集。单方向消融揭示了一组稀疏的late q_proj、o_proj和down_proj组件具有超常行为影响。

Conclusion: 行为有效的LoRA写入是稀疏且结构化的，写入几何（write geometry）是一个因果状态变量——同一训练检查点在不同写入子空间下会发展出不同的行为。有用的写入信号集中在学习到的写入空间内，并从随机或冻结激活PCA控制中大量消失。

Abstract: Low-rank adaptation fixes the rank of the update, but it does not identify which parts of a trained
  write actually carry behavior. We study that question directly and show that behaviorally effective
  LoRA writes are sparse, structured, and far more concentrated than the raw low-rank parameterization
  suggests.
  We use Learned-Basis LoRA, a learned-basis continuation recipe, to expose that structure. The recipe
  warms up an unconstrained adapter, converts its learned write columns into a module-wise orthonormal
  basis, freezes that basis, and continues training inside the constrained parameterization. Across 14
  exact switches from unconstrained to constrained form, held-out accuracy is unchanged at the
  conversion step and reconstructed write matrices differ by at most 0.25% relative Frobenius error.
  Same-state continuation then shows that the same trained checkpoint develops differently under
  different write subspaces, establishing write geometry as a causal state variable. A no-retraining
  projection test shows that useful write signal stays inside the learned write space and largely
  disappears from random or frozen-activation PCA controls.
  The concentration pattern is strong at both local and global scales. Across GSM8K, MathQA, and AQuA,
  per-module top-k continuation reaches its optimum at k in {2, 4} in all twelve seed-level cases we
  test. A stricter global ranking test shows that learned top-16 and top-32 subsets outperform matched
  random subsets, especially on GSM8K/Qwen and MathQA/Qwen. Single-direction ablations further reveal a
  sparse set of late q_proj, o_proj, and down_proj components with outsized behavioral impact.

</details>


### [229] [Polish ModernBERT: The Long and Short of Polish Language Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01379)
*Michał Perełkiewicz,Sławomir Dadas,Rafał Poświata,Małgorzata Grębowiec*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Polish ModernBERT，一个包含四种波兰语编码器的模型家族（Base/Large规模，512-token和8K上下文变体），基于ModernBERT预训练配方适配而来。在30个任务中，该模型在波兰语编码器中取得最佳综合表现，且8K变体在长上下文任务中显著超越基线，同时参数更少、内存占用和延迟更低，并在检索基准上表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 波兰语的编码器模型仍然主要依赖传统的BERT/RoBERTa架构，而ModernBERT等更新的编码器架构尚未在波兰语中得到充分探索和应用，因此需要构建更高效、更强的波兰语编码器。

Method: 作者基于ModernBERT预训练配方，通过分阶段选择实验进行适配，构建了四个Poland编码器（Base/Large × 512-token/8K上下文），并发布了覆盖法律主题分类、意识形态决策方向预测、文学情节摘要事实一致性评估和人权侵犯评估的长上下文基准。

Result: 在30个任务中取得最佳综合性能（Base-8K为83.99，Large-8K为85.11）；长上下文任务从67.47提升至77.15（Base）和从75.88提升至78.49（Large）；Base-8K比匹配的RoBERTa-8K少22%参数（149M vs 190M）；推理时峰值内存和延迟均更低；8K-Base在300M参数以下的检索基准中取得最佳成绩。

Conclusion: Polish ModernBERT验证了ModernBERT架构在波兰语上的有效性，证明其不仅能超越传统BERT/RoBERTa风格编码器的性能，还能在参数效率、推理效率和长上下文处理能力方面取得全面优势。

Abstract: Encoder-only Transformers remain effective for discriminative and representation-learning tasks, yet Polish encoders still largely rely on BERT/RoBERTa-style architectures. We introduce \textbf{Polish ModernBERT}, a family of four Polish encoders available at Base and Large scales, each with 512-token and 8K context variants. We adapt the ModernBERT pretraining recipe through staged selection experiments and release a long-context benchmark covering legal topic classification, ideological decision-direction prediction, factual-consistency assessment over literary plot summaries, and human-rights violation assessment. Across 30 tasks, Polish ModernBERT achieves the best overall performance among the evaluated Polish encoders, reaching 83.99 and 85.11 for the Base-8K and Large-8K models, respectively. On long-context tasks, the 8K variants improve over matched Polish RoBERTa-8K baselines from 67.47 to 77.15 and from 75.88 to 78.49 at the Base and Large scales, respectively. The Base-8K model achieves this gain with 22\% fewer parameters (149M vs.\ 190M). Efficiency measurements in representative inference setups show lower peak memory usage and latency than matched Polish RoBERTa baselines in both 512-token and 8K settings. Polish ModernBERT-8K-Base additionally achieves the best result on a Polish retrieval benchmark among the evaluated encoders below 300M parameters.

</details>


### [230] [InSight: A Benchmark for Agentic Claim Verification in Interactive Visualizations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01383)
*Maeve Hutchinson,Syed Mahbubul Huq,Mohammad Albinhassan,Radu Jianu,Aidan Slingsby,Pranava Madhyastha*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了InSight基准，用于评估智能体在交互式可视化环境中的声明验证能力，包含21,349条来自人类分析叙事的人类撰写声明，要求智能体在完全交互式网络环境中判断声明是被支持、反驳还是不可验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代数据分析本质上是动态的，需要主动交互探索交互环境，但现有基准局限于静态图像和一次性问答，无法捕捉该领域中证据常被遮挡、分布在多个关联视图或通过用户行为条件性揭示的认识论需求。

Method: 构建InSight基准：从人类撰写的分析叙事中提取21,349条声明，并将其置于完全交互式的基于网络的环境中；要求智能体在环境中导航以判断自然语言声明是被支持、反驳还是无法从现有证据中验证；将交互轨迹视为推理的内在代理，以严格审计模型如何寻求和综合视觉证据。

Result: 评估了最先进模型，揭示交互式验证仍然是一个非平凡挑战。

Conclusion: 交互式声明验证在视觉语言模型中仍具挑战性，InSight基准为这一能力提供了更贴近真实数据分析场景的评测手段，并公开发布了数据集。

Abstract: Vision Language Models have demonstrated remarkable proficiency in interpreting static visual artifacts, but modern data analysis is inherently dynamic, requiring the active interrogation of interactive environments. Existing benchmarks are predominantly constrained to static imagery and one-shot question answering and fail to capture the epistemic demands of this domain, where evidence is frequently occluded, distributed across linked views, or conditionally revealed through user agency. In this paper, we introduce InSight, a benchmark for agentic claim verification over interactive visualizations. The dataset consists of 21,349 claims derived from human-authored analytical narratives and grounded in fully interactive web-based environments. Agents must navigate these environments to determine whether a natural language claim is supported, refuted or not verifiable given the available evidence. Unlike traditional evaluations, InSight treats interaction traces as intrinsic proxies for reasoning, enabling a rigorous audit of how models seek and synthesize visual evidence. We evaluate state-of-the-art models, revealing that interactive verification remains a non-trivial challenge. We release InSight at https://github.com/maevehutch/insight.

</details>


### [231] [When Tokenization is Secretly Output Supervision](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01386)
*Tanja Baeumel,Josef van Genabith,Simon Ostermann*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文论证了分词(tokenization)不应仅被视为输入预处理决策，而应被理解为自回归模型中的"输出监督"(output supervision)信号。通过数值推理任务的受控实验，作者发现任务表现、训练动态和模型内部表征主要由输出分词决定，而非输入分词。对120篇*CL论文的调查显示，约69%的研究跨分词(从而跨监督)比较模型却不报告该信息，仅10%报告了数值分词方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献虽然记录了分词策略持续影响模型性能，但缺乏对其背后机制的原理性解释。此外，跨模型比较可能混淆了"任务定义差异"与"能力差异"，因为分词粒度决定了模型在单次前向传播中解决的任务难度和监督信号。作者旨在填补这一理论空白，并揭示研究实践中的普遍忽视。

Method: 作者提出将分词重新框定为输出监督信号的理论视角，并通过数值推理的受控实验验证：将输入与输出分词解耦，分别考察两者对任务性能、训练动态及模型内部表征的影响。此外，对120篇近期*CL数值推理论文进行系统性调查，统计分词方案的报告率及跨分词比较的比例。

Result: 实验结果表明，任务表现、训练动态和模型内部表征的差异主要由输出分词诱导，且对输入分词基本不变，验证了"输出监督"假设。调查发现仅约10%的论文报告数值分词方案，而69%的研究在未报告的情况下比较了不同分词(监督)机制下的模型。

Conclusion: 分词应被理解为自回归模型的输出监督维度而非单纯的输入表征决策。不同分词策略的模型实际上在被训练解决不同定义的任务，因此跨模型比较可能在某种程度上反映的是任务定义差异而非能力差异。将分词视为输出监督为此提供了一个原则性的解释框架。

Abstract: Tokenization in language models is treated by default as an input preprocessing decision. We argue that this framing is incomplete: in autoregressive models, tokenizer granularity determines what the model must resolve in a single forward pass, and therefore the supervision signal it receives. This affects both the difficulty of the learning problem and the representations that emerge inside the model. We test this in a controlled experiment on numeric reasoning with a novel decoupling of input and output tokenization. As the output supervision view predicts, differences in task performance, training dynamics, and model internals are induced by output tokenization and largely invariant to input tokenization. This may matter in practice, because models with different tokenization strategies differ not only in input representation but in the task they were trained on. Comparisons between models may thus partly reflect task definition rather than ability. A survey of 120 recent *CL papers on numeric reasoning confirms that this is rarely acknowledged: only about 10% report the numeric tokenization of the models they evaluate, while 69% compare across tokenization, and thus supervision, regimes without reporting it. While prior work documents that tokenization consistently affects model performance, there is no principled account of why. We argue that framing tokenization as output supervision provides that account.

</details>


### [232] [From Rollouts to Recipes: Self-Contained Post-Training for LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01422)
*Yifei Li,Lingling Zhang,Muye Huang,Zihan Ma,Jiashuai Liu,Jun Liu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出Self-Routing框架，根据模型自身rollout的正确性和置信度将样本路由到不同的优化策略（GRPO、自蒸馏、正则化或跳过），实现行为条件化的自适应后训练，在数学推理任务上持续优于统一训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的后训练方法对所有样本使用单一训练配方，忽略了模型自身rollout所反映出的不同样本级学习状态，导致训练效率低下且无法针对性优化。

Method: 基于行为状态（rollout正确性和置信度）对样本进行分类路由：不同状态分别采用GRPO策略优化、在线自蒸馏、正则化或跳过更新。无需外部教师、额外标注或额外采样，完全利用模型自身的rollout信号。

Result: 在Qwen3和Qwen3.5主干上的数学推理实验表明，Self-Routing一致优于统一GRPO、统一OPSD、固定混合比以及更简单的路由基线。路由分布随训练动态变化，减少了对低信号或已稳定样本的不必要更新。

Conclusion: 行为条件化的自适应路由能够更有效地利用样本信号，避免了统一训练配方的局限性，为后训练阶段提供了更精细、更高效的优化策略。

Abstract: Post-training large language models usually applies a single training recipe to all samples, even though the model's own rollouts reveal different sample-level learning states. We propose Self-Routing, a behavior-conditioned post-training framework that uses rollout correctness and confidence to decide how each sample should be optimized. Depending on its behavior state, a sample is routed to GRPO, on-policy self-distillation, regularization, or skipping, allowing training to adapt without external teachers, extra annotations, or additional sampling. Experiments on mathematical reasoning across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 backbones show that Self-Routing consistently improves over uniform GRPO, uniform OPSD, fixed mixtures, and simpler routing baselines. Further analyses show that the routing distribution changes over training and reduces unnecessary updates on low-signal or already stable samples.

</details>


### [233] [Knowledge Distillation During Mid-Training Favors Reasoning over Factual Recall](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01532)
*Jacqueline He,Howard Yen,Shuyue Stella Li,Margaret Li,Hanqing Zeng,Yinglong Xia,Benyu Zhang,Zhuokai Zhao,Qiang Zhang,Pang Wei Koh,Luke Zettlemoyer,Wen-tau Yih*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文发现基于Logit的知识蒸馏（前向KL散度）在预训练与中期训练阶段对语言模型的作用存在根本性差异：预训练时同时提升推理与事实记忆，但中期训练时虽继续提升推理却拖慢了事实记忆的获取。作者将这一阶段性差异归因于教师在不同领域数据上的信心不对称以及学生知识状态的演变，并提出Switch Distillation——一种仅对教师高置信度token进行蒸馏、其余token回退到交叉熵的简单中期训练目标，在推理、知识与常识上取得显著提升，且不损害事实记忆能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有知识蒸馏研究大多集中于预训练或后训练阶段，缺乏对中期训练（mid-training）这一关键中间阶段的系统分析；同时，前向KL蒸馏在前训练和中期训练中的影响是否一致尚不明确，需要揭示其阶段性差异背后的机理并设计有效的方法。

Method: 1) 通过受控实验对比预训练与中期训练中前向KL蒸馏的作用差异；2) 揭示教师置信度在不同数据域（程序性vs知识密集型）的不对称以及学生先获得低熵事实知识的演变规律；3) 提出Switch Distillation：以教师预测熵作为轻量路由信号，仅在教师高置信度的token上进行蒸馏，否则回退到标准交叉熵损失。

Result: Switch Distillation在多种教师规模下均优于现有蒸馏目标。相对标准NTP：推理性能提升1.61-1.71倍，知识与常识性能提升1.13-1.19倍，同时保留96.7-96.8%的事实记忆。经过后训练后优势仍然保持：弥补了事实记忆差距，同时推理提升1.25-1.32倍，知识与常识提升1.13-1.20倍。

Conclusion: 知识蒸馏的效果并非跨训练阶段一致，其阶段性差异源于教师-学生置信度模式的不匹配。基于教师熵的路由信号（Switch Distillation）能有效缓解中期训练中蒸馏对事实记忆获取的负面影响，使蒸馏在中期训练阶段也能同时兼顾推理与事实记忆能力，且收益可跨后训练阶段保持。

Abstract: Logit-based knowledge distillation (KD) is used to train smaller language models (LMs) via supervision from stronger teachers, but whether its benefits are consistent across training stages remains unclear. Through controlled experiments, we find that forward Kullback-Leibler (KL) distillation--the standard KD formulation--with post-trained teachers behaves fundamentally differently during mid-training, an intermediate phase of self-supervised learning on curated corpora. Surprisingly, while forward KD simultaneously improves reasoning and factual recall during pre-training relative to standard next-token prediction (NTP), it instead slows factual recall acquisition during mid-training despite continued reasoning gains. We trace this stage dependence to an asymmetry in teacher confidence across data domains and the student's evolving knowledge state: teachers are more confident on procedural than knowledge-intensive data, while students acquire low-entropy factual knowledge earlier in training. To mitigate this imbalance, we propose Switch Distillation, a simple mid-training objective that distills on tokens where the teacher is confident, using teacher predictive entropy as a lightweight routing signal, and otherwise falls back to cross-entropy. Switch Distillation consistently outperforms existing distillation objectives across teacher sizes. Relative to standard NTP, it achieves 1.61-1.71x the reasoning performance and 1.13-1.19x the knowledge and commonsense performance while preserving 96.7-96.8% of factual recall. Crucially, these benefits persist after post-training: Switch Distillation closes the factual recall gap while maintaining 1.25-1.32x and 1.13-1.20x gains in reasoning and knowledge and commonsense, respectively.

</details>


### [234] [SDARE-Bench: Evaluating Large Language Models on Conversational Stigma Detection and Response in Dyadic and Group Dialogue](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01548)
*Stephanie Fong,Yiwen Jiang,Zimu Wang,Hongxi Yang,Yaling Shen,Hiu Weh Naomi Chow,Heung Ying Lai,Xiangyu Zhao,Qingyang Xu,Zhongxing Xu,Jiahe Liu,Guilherme C. Oliveira,Vincent Lee,Zongyuan Ge,Dominic Dwyer*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SDARE-Bench，首个基于场景的基准测试，用于评估LLM在对话情境中的污名检测和开放式回复生成能力。该基准包含1,138个二元对话和1,388个群体对话查询。实验表明8个LLM在识别污名成分方面表现不佳，尤其在群体对话中；开放生成场景下群体设定中的污名表达显著高于二元情境，且构建的群体压力情境下污名表达率平均高达97.5%，揭示了污名回应是LLM反复出现的安全漏洞。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于寻求建议和决策场景中，可能影响社会判断。尽管污名对人和社区有深远影响，但现有基准极少涉及此问题。已有的一般领域评估依赖静态提示和固定格式任务，忽视了日常交流中的对话情境和听众效应。

Method: 构建SDARE-Bench场景化基准，包含污名检测和开放式回复生成两大任务，涵盖1,138个二元查询和1,388个群体对话；使用1,392条人工标注回复训练分类器进行评估；在8个LLM上进行系统实验，并额外构建群体压力情境测试模型在压力下的表现。

Result: 8个LLM在污名成分识别上表现较差，尤其在群体对话中；群体设定下开放生成的污名表达显著高于二元情境，抵御污名的能力更弱且建议更不现实；在群体压力情境下污名表达率平均激增至97.5%。

Conclusion: 污名回应是LLM反复出现的安全漏洞，尤其在社交复杂的对话情境中问题更加突出。该基准为评估和改善LLM的污名安全提供了重要工具。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in advice seeking and decision making that may affect social judgements. Despite stigma's profound effects on people and communities, benchmarks remain scarce. Existing general-domain evaluations typically rely on static prompts and fixed-format tasks, overlooking conversational contexts and audience effects in everyday communication. To address these gaps, we introduce SDARE-Bench, the first scenario-based benchmark evaluating both stigma detection and open-ended response generation in LLMs, comprising 1,138 dyadic queries and 1,388 group dialogue. Empirical results across 8 LLMs consistently demonstrate poor identification of stigma components, especially in group dialogues. In open-ended response generation, stigma expression was substantially higher in group settings than in dyadic, with weaker resistance to stigma and more unrealistic advice. Responses were evaluated using a classifier trained on 1,392 human annotated responses. In constructed group pressure settings, stigma expression rates further increased to a striking average of 97.5%. Our findings identify stigma response as a recurring LLM safety vulnerability, especially in socially complex conversational contexts.

</details>


### [235] [A systematic Approach to constructing a Chance-and-Risk Matrix for Semiconductor Supply Chains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01563)
*Ema Salkić,Alexander Fichtl,Philipp Ulrich,Hans Ehm,Marta Bonik,Georg Groh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个端到端管道，利用大语言模型从半导体公司的公开企业披露中持续提取、结构化和排序风险情报，构建知识图谱并通过三层机制（算法公式、LLM相关性调整、专家验证）对项目排序。在五家覆盖价值链的公司上应用，产生76,207个评分项目，独立检验有效性达92.6%，自动化排序与专家判断平均Spearman相关系数分别为风险0.55和机会0.72。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体供应链面临地缘政治紧张、地理集中和快速技术变革带来的不断升级的风险，但目前缺乏可扩展的系统来持续从公开企业披露中提取、结构和优先排序风险情报。

Method: 构建端到端管道：(1)检索半导体公司的企业文档；(2)使用LLM提取其中描述的风险与机会；(3)将其组织成知识图谱，链接每个条目到其类别、来源和相关事件；(4)去重合并；(5)通过三层机制排序——算法公式、LLM相关性调整和专家验证。

Result: 应用于价值链上的五家公司，管道产生76,207个评分项目，独立检查发现92.6%有效。自动化排名与专家判断的平均Spearman相关性为风险0.55、机会0.72。生成的风险矩阵识别出贸易限制是跨公司的主导风险。

Conclusion: 该管道证明了大语言模型驱动的风险情报系统在半导体制供应链中的可扩展性和有效性，能够自动从企业披露中提取高质量、与专家判断相吻合的风险与机会情报，并识别出关键的跨公司系统性风险。

Abstract: Semiconductor supply chains face escalating risks from geopolitical tensions, geographic concentration, and rapid technological shifts, yet no scalable system continuously extracts, structures, and prioritizes risk intelligence from public corporate disclosures. We present an end-to-end pipeline that retrieves corporate documents for semiconductor companies and uses large language models (LLMs) to extract the risks and opportunities they describe. It organizes these into a knowledge graph linking each item to its category, sources, and related events, then merges duplicates and ranks them with a three-layer mechanism combining an algorithmic formula, an LLM relevance adjustment, and expert validation. Applied to five companies across the value chain, the pipeline produces 76,207 scored items, of which an independent check finds 92.6% valid. The automated rankings match expert judgment at an average Spearman correlation of 0.55 for risks and 0.72 for opportunities, and the resulting matrices identify trade restrictions as the dominant cross-company risk.

</details>


### [236] [From Confusion to Clarity: Confusion-Aware Retrieval and Knowledge Injection for Text Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01564)
*Manish Gupta,Chaitanya Giri,Jayasimha Talur*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 提出一个无需微调的框架，通过识别易混淆标签对、扩展候选集并生成差异化规则，帮助LLM在大型语义相似标签分类任务中提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在将文本分类到具有许多语义相似标签的分类体系中时表现不佳，因为标签间的细微差异具有领域特异性，无法从预训练中获得。现有的top-K检索方法虽然减少了候选数量，但当两个相似标签同时出现在候选中时，模型缺乏足够的信号来正确区分它们。

Method: 提出一个三步框架：(1)识别模型难以区分的标签对；(2)扩展候选集以包含易混淆标签；(3)生成针对性的规则来区分相似候选。该框架无需微调，且生成的规则可迁移到更小、更便宜的模型。

Result: 在三个基准测试（WOS、Flipkart、LEDGAR）上，该方法相较于检索基线在Macro F1上最多提升10.0个百分点；通过跨模型迁移，较小的模型（2B-20B）可获得最多11.5个百分点的提升。

Conclusion: 通过显式识别并解决标签间的混淆问题，可以有效提升LLM在大规模细粒度分类任务中的表现，且生成的规则具有良好的跨模型可迁移性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) struggle to classify text into taxonomies with many semantically similar labels, as the distinctions are domain-specific and not captured by pre-training. To handle large label spaces, a common approach retrieves top-$K$ candidate labels by embedding similarity and prompt the LLM to choose among them. However, top-$K$ retrieval reduces the number of candidates but does not help the model tell similar ones apart. When two similar labels both appear as candidates, the model lacks the signal to choose correctly between them. We propose a framework that (1) identifies which label pairs the model struggles to distinguish, (2) expands the candidate set to include confusable labels, and (3) generates targeted rules to differentiate between similar candidates. The framework requires no fine-tuning, and the generated rules transfer to smaller, cheaper models. On three benchmarks (WOS, Flipkart, LEDGAR), our approach improves Macro F1 by up to 10.0pp over retrieval baselines, with smaller models (2B--20B) gaining up to 11.5pp via cross-model transfer.

</details>


### [237] [From Production Traffic to Post-Training: Building a Self-Hosted LLM That Covers the Corporate Request Mix](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01572)
*Olga Tsymboi,Dmitrii Stoianov,Ramil Latypov,Danil Taranets,Daniil Dryabin,Mikhail Gashkov,Viktor Zelenkovskiy,Aleksandr Fida,Gleb Alektorov,Nikita Gulyakov,Arthur Babkin,Aleksandr Medvedev,Pavel Gein,Anatolii Potapov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将企业内部多个LLM服务整合为单一模型的方案：通过生产错误分析识别质量差距，按指令遵循、函数调用和内部任务分布三个轴分别训练独立的GRPO专家模型，再通过两阶段SLERP（球形线性插值）合并。结果显示该模型在非推理模式下以远小于基线的参数规模超越了约7倍参数的基线模型，并吸收了平台50%（每月1.16亿次）的流量，大幅降低服务成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数据驻留约束迫使企业自托管LLM，但不断引入新模型而不淘汰旧模型会使服务集群膨胀，导致有限的GPU资源碎片化。需要一个方案将流量整合到单一模型以降低服务成本和资源浪费。

Method: 1) 从200多个内部应用的生产错误分析中识别沿三个轴的质量差距（指令遵循、函数调用、内部任务分布）；2) 使用分层于生产流量的离线基准测试追踪质量，通过确定性验证器或校准后的LLM法官评分；3) 不联合优化所有目标（以避免跨领域奖励干扰），而是为每个轴训练独立的GRPO专家；4) 通过两阶段SLERP合并专家模型；5) 针对每个专家奖励暴露的不同失败模式（语义坍塌、过度调用、冗长hacking）进行领域特定修复。

Result: 在非推理模式下，该模型在内部Arena上超越约7倍总参数量的基线（69.6 vs 65.8），指令遵循得分0.85 vs 0.83，函数调用得分0.79 vs 0.77，同时提升通用对话基准。模型吸收了平台50%的流量（每月1.16亿请求），服务成本仅为原来的一小部分。

Conclusion: 通过轴独立训练GRPO专家并结合两阶段SLERP合并的策略，可以在不牺牲质量的前提下将企业内部广泛的LLM服务流量整合到单一模型上，显著降低GPU成本和运营负担。

Abstract: Data-residency constraints force enterprises to self-host LLMs, but continuous adoption of newer models without decommissioning their predecessors expands the serving fleet, fragmenting a finite GPU pool. We consolidate traffic from over 200 internal applications onto a single model by closing quality gaps identified through production error analysis along three axes: instruction following, function-calling, and internal task distribution. Quality is tracked by offline benchmarks stratified to production traffic and scored by deterministic verifiers or calibrated LLM judges. Rather than optimising all objectives jointly, which introduces cross-domain reward interference, we train a separate GRPO expert per axis and merge them via two-stage SLERP. Each expert's reward exposes a distinct failure mode, namely semantic collapse, over-calling, and verbosity hacking, each requiring a domain-specific fix. In non-reasoning mode the recipe surpasses a ${\sim}7\times$ larger by total parameters baseline on the in-house Arena with 69.6 to 65.8, instruction following with 0.85 to 0.83, and function-calling with 0.79 to 0.77, while lifting general dialogue benchmarks. The model absorbs 50% of platform traffic, 116M requests per month, at a fraction of the serving cost.

</details>


### [238] [Scaling Near-Optimal SFT-RL Annotation Budget Allocation from Small to Large LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01573)
*Jingtan Wang,Arun Verma,Xiaoqiang Lin,Zhengyuan Liu,Nancy F. Chen,Daniela Rus,Bryan Kian Hsiang Low*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文研究LLM后训练中，如何在有限的标注预算下分配监督微调（SFT）与强化学习（RL）的数据量。作者提出从"近最优性"角度分析，发现近最优分配区域（在峰值性能2-10%容差内）通常很宽，随模型规模增大而变宽，且能从小的代理模型可靠迁移到大的目标模型，因此可以用小规模实验确定迁移性的近最优区域，避免大规模穷举搜索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有工作仅描述SFT与RL预算分配的大致趋势（如低数据量下SFT占优），缺乏原理性的分配框架，也未考察最优比例是否跨模型规模迁移。作者希望填补这一空白，提出系统性的分配策略。

Method: 将问题框架化为近最优性：不追求单一最优SFT-RL比例，而是刻画在指定性能容差范围内的近最优区域。对不同容差（2-10%）、不同模型规模、不同任务和模型家族进行系统性实验，并分析标注成本不对称对近最优区域的影响。

Result: 近最优区域即使在小容差（2-10%）下也很宽，且随模型规模增大而变宽；近最优区域能从小的代理模型可靠迁移到大型目标模型。结论在多种任务、模型家族、基于偏好的离线RL和基于奖励监督的在线RL方法上一致成立。标注成本的SFT与RL不对称性会改变近最优区域的位置。

Conclusion: 提出实用策略：通过小型代理模型实验即可识别可迁移的近最优区域，无需对大规模模型进行穷举搜索，从而大幅降低后训练预算分配的探索成本。该发现为LLM后训练中的预算分配提供了原则性指导。

Abstract: How to divide a fixed annotation budget between supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) during LLM post-training remains an open problem. Existing work characterizes only broad trends (e.g., SFT dominates in low-data regimes), lacks a principled allocation framework, and does not examine whether the optimal ratio transfers across model sizes. We frame this problem in terms of near-optimality: rather than seeking a single optimal SFT-RL ratio, we characterize the near-optimal region, the set of allocations within a specified tolerance of peak performance. Empirically, this region is wide even for small tolerances (2-10%), widens with model scale, and transfers reliably from small proxy models to large target models. This yields a practical strategy: small proxy-model experiments suffice to identify a transferable near-optimal region, eliminating the need for exhaustive large-scale search. Our results hold consistently across tasks, model families, and both preference-based off-policy and reward-supervision on-policy RL methods. We further analyze how the asymmetry in annotation costs between SFT and RL data shifts the near-optimal region.

</details>


### [239] [Closing Cost-Quality Gap in Document VLMs: Difficulty-Aware Data Curation and Quality-Adjusted Deployment Economics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01575)
*Maksim Evdokimov,Matvey Ivanov,Dmitrii Tsiupin,Olga Tsymboi,Anatolii Potapov,Aleksandr Ivanov*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个部署于受监管行业的文档理解系统，基于Mixture-of-Experts VLM（35B总参、3B激活），在单张H100上运行，通过难度感知数据管道微调，相比人类标注和竞品开源模型分别降低超过80%和50%的期望成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受监管行业中每年需从数亿文档中提取结构化字段，但成本高昂：定制OCR级联仅覆盖部分工作流、隐私规则禁止外部模型、现有开源VLM在达到质量阈值的条件下服务成本高于人工标注。

Method: 构建基于Mixture-of-Experts VLM（35B总参数、3B激活）的系统，在内部分产数据与开放域文档混合数据上进行微调；采用Difficulty-Aware（难度感知）管道筛选文档，兼顾布局多样性、事实可提取性和跨模型一致性；通过提示词（prompting）方式服务异构工作流，单张H100即可部署。

Result: 模型在可部署（非推理型）基线中领先，超越大至一个数量级的基线模型；在质量调整成本分析中（校准自生产遥测的确认与纠正成本），相对人类基线降低超80%成本，相对最佳竞品开源模型降低超50%成本，而更大规模的模型在经济上不可行。

Conclusion: 通过MoE架构与难度感知数据筛选相结合，可以在保持低成本的同时达到可用质量，使开源VLM在受监管的文档理解场景中替代人工标注和超大模型成为经济可行方案。

Abstract: Extracting structured fields from hundreds of millions of documents annually remains costly in regulated industries: bespoke OCR cascades cover only a fraction of workflows, privacy rules preclude external models, and existing open-source VLMs that clear quality thresholds cost more to serve than human annotation. We present a deployed document-understanding system built on a Mixture-of-Experts VLM (35B total, 3B active), fine-tuned on in-house production data mixed with open-domain documents curated by a Difficulty-Aware pipeline for layout diversity, fact-extractability, and cross-model consistency. Fitting on a single H100 and serving heterogeneous workflows via prompting, the model leads all deployable (non-reasoning) baselines up to an order of magnitude larger. A quality-adjusted cost analysis, with confirmation and correction costs calibrated from production telemetry, shows it reduces expected costs by over 80% against the human baseline and by more than 50% against the best competing open-source model, while larger baselines remain economically unviable.

</details>


### [240] [StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01591)
*Ke Yang,Chenglong Wang,Michel Galley,Chandan Singh,Jeevana Priya Inala,ChengXiang Zhai,Jianfeng Gao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出StudentSim框架，通过池化训练加每学生专门化，将稀疏的每学生数据转化为个性化模拟器，既能反映学生自身反应，也能在教师指导下更新。同时提出StudentSimEval标准化评估协议，涵盖国际象棋、二语英语写作和数学三个领域共60名学生，在行为保真度(F)和指导响应性(R)两个指标上均优于GPT-5.4和Maia2等基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI教师需要适应每个学生的特点与偏好，但收集真实学习者关于何种指导有效的证据稀疏、缓慢且昂贵。学生模拟器可提供代理信号，但现有方法有局限：状态跟踪模型难以处理解释或纠正，LLM角色扮演虽能流畅遵循指导但无法可靠匹配被模拟学生的能力水平。

Method: StudentSim采用两阶段训练框架：先在池化数据上进行训练，再针对每个学生进行专门化微调。评估方面提出StudentSimEval协议，使用公开学习者数据集（含去标识化记录），涵盖国际象棋、二语英语写作和数学三个领域共60名学生，同时衡量行为保真度(F)和指导响应性(R)两个指标。

Result: 三个领域上StudentSim在两个指标上均优于GPT-5.4。国际象棋中StudentSim达F=0.51和R=0.91，而GPT-5.4为0.23和0.72，Maia2为0.45和0.27。概念验证中，将StudentSim用作教师强化学习的奖励模型，产生的人类专家评价更高的国际象棋教师（比无RL基线和GPT-5.4模拟器奖励训练的教师更准确、指导更好、更个性化）。代码已公开。

Conclusion: StudentSim框架能有效将稀疏个体数据转化为个性化学生模拟器，在行为保真度和指导响应性上显著超越现有方法，并可作为教师强化学习的奖励信号，提升AI教师的个性化教学能力。

Abstract: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence of the student being imitated. We present StudentSim, a training framework that turns sparse per-student data into individualized simulators through pooled training followed by per-student specialization. The resulting simulators both mirror a student's own responses and update them under tutor guidance. We also introduce StudentSimEval, a standardized protocol covering 60 students across chess, second-language English writing, and mathematics, using public learner datasets with de-identified records shared for research. StudentSimEval measures behavioral fidelity (F), or how well a simulator matches a student's responses, and guidance responsiveness (R), or how readily it updates under tutor guidance, with all methods fit and evaluated on the same records. Across all three domains, StudentSim outperforms GPT-5.4 on both metrics. In chess, StudentSim reaches F=0.51 and R=0.91, compared with 0.23 and 0.72 for GPT-5.4 and 0.45 and 0.27 for Maia2. As a proof of concept, using StudentSim as a reward model for tutor reinforcement learning produces a chess tutor that expert humans rate as more accurate, better-guided, and more personalized than a no-RL baseline and a tutor trained against a GPT-5.4 simulator reward. Code is available at https://github.com/microsoft/StudentSim.

</details>


### [241] [The Rise of Verbal Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01597)
*Kshitij Tayal,Arun Sharma,Genta Indra Winata,Anirban Das,Sambit Sahu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次对"语言强化学习"（VRL）这一范式进行了系统性的统一阐述。VRL利用自然语言作为改善语言智能体的反馈渠道，文章基于"语言反馈在智能体生命周期中何时生效、修改什么"这一单一轴，将该领域划分为三大支柱：语言作为接地信号、语言作为深思反馈、语言作为学习信号，并总结了各支柱下的代表工作、子类别及语言在塑造智能体行为中的独特作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言正在成为改善语言智能体的主要反馈渠道，能传达意图、偏好和因果结构。然而，这一快速发展的领域缺乏统一的组织框架和系统性视角，研究者难以把握不同方法之间的关联与差异，因此需要一个统一的分类体系来厘清该范式。

Method: 提出Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL)范式，以"语言反馈在智能体生命周期中何时生效以及修改什么"为单一组织轴，将领域划分为三大支柱：(1)语言作为接地信号——语言通过指定目标、状态和奖励结构来定义任务本身；(2)语言作为深思反馈——自然语言在测试时引导推理而无需更新模型参数；(3)语言作为学习信号——基于语言的反馈通过训练塑造模型参数。在各支柱内综合代表性工作并区分关键子类别。

Result: 提出了一个涵盖三大支柱的统一分类体系，综合了各支柱下的代表性研究，区分了关键方法子类别，展示了语言在塑造智能体行为中的多层次作用，并据此勾勒了语言强化学习如何重塑智能体开发格局。

Conclusion: 该分类体系表明语言强化学习正在根本性地改变智能体的开发方式，同时也界定了构建更强能力和更对齐智能体过程中面临的挑战与机遇，为后续研究提供了清晰的路线图。

Abstract: Natural language is emerging as a primary feedback channel for improving language agents, capable of conveying intent, preferences, and causal structure in forms interpretable by both humans and modern language models. We call this paradigm Verbal Reinforcement Learning (VRL) and offer the first unified account of it. We organize the field around a single axis, \textit{when} verbal feedback takes effect in an agent's lifecycle and \textit{what} it modifies, yielding three pillars: (1) \textbf{Language as Grounding Signal}, where language defines the task itself by specifying goals, states, and reward structures; (2) \textbf{Language as Deliberative Feedback}, where natural language guides reasoning at test time without the need to update model parameters; (3) \textbf{Language as Learning Signal}, where language-based feedback shapes model parameters through training. Within each pillar, we synthesize representative work, distinguish key subcategories of approaches, and outline the distinct role language plays in shaping agent behavior. Together, this taxonomy shows how verbal reinforcement is reshaping agent development, while also defining the challenges and opportunities for building more capable and aligned agents.

</details>


### [242] [CordisBench: Can Language Models Reason About Component Lifecycles in Dynamic Agent Harnesses?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01600)
*Damien Sileo,Dimitri Kachler*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出CordisBench基准测试，包含1200个问题，用于评估语言模型在动态智能体环境中对组件生命周期（依赖关系和清理）的推理能力。研究发现模型在小规模系统上表现良好，但随着交互规模增大可靠性下降，且中等推理成本显著（如GPT-5.6 Luna每个问题消耗近3000推理token），但该成本可通过独立的有限参考语义逻辑避免。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动态智能体工具允许语言模型修改塑造自身执行的软件，但这种灵活性引入了新的推理负担：局部插件更改可能需要跨依赖关系和清理步骤进行传播推理。现有模型在此类"生命周期推理"上缺乏系统评估，作者希望通过受控基准来度量模型能力。

Method: 构建CordisBench：包含1200个问题的基准，结合受控形式化环境与Cordis运行时（管理组件依赖和清理）。任务类型包括：识别受影响组件、预测指定拆除顺序后的状态、判断哪些条件下在所有/部分顺序下成立、选择能成功执行的重新配置方案。在低推理努力(2/4/8/16/24/32次相关交互)下评估三个效率导向模型，使用确定性任务特定评分。

Result: 模型在小系统上通常表现良好，但随着相关交互增加而可靠性下降，尤其在预测最终状态和跨拆除顺序推理时最弱。额外推理努力对部分模型带来显著提升，但成本不菲（16交互子集上GPT-5.6 Luna中等努力每问题消耗近3000推理token）。该成本可避免：独立的有限参考语义在所有528个可执行问题上的所有观察与动作结果均与Cordis执行一致。

Conclusion: CordisBench揭示了语言模型在动态系统生命周期推理方面的局限性，表明当前模型的推理扩展方式（消耗更多token）并非必要——由于存在与运行时完全一致的确定性参考语义，可以通过更高效的确定性机制解决这些受控实例，无需高昂的神经推理成本。

Abstract: Dynamic agent harnesses let language models change the software that shapes their own execution. This flexibility brings a new reasoning burden: a local plugin change can propagate through dependencies and cleanup. We introduce CordisBench, a 1,200-question benchmark of this lifecycle reasoning. It combines a controlled formal setting with programs executed against Cordis, a runtime that manages component dependencies and cleanup, and asks models to identify affected components, predict state after a specified teardown order, determine which conditions hold under all or some orders, and choose reconfigurations that succeed when executed. Across these tasks, we evaluate three efficiency-oriented models at low reasoning effort with 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, or 32 relevant interactions, using deterministic task-specific scoring. Models usually handle small systems well but grow less reliable as more interactions become relevant, especially when predicting final state and when reasoning across teardown orders. Additional inference effort recovers marked gains for some models. The cost is nontrivial: on our 16-interaction subset, GPT-5.6 Luna uses nearly 3,000 reasoning tokens per question at medium effort. For these controlled instances, that cost is avoidable: an independent finite reference semantics agrees with Cordis execution on every observation and action outcome used for scoring across all 528 executable questions.

</details>


### [243] [Beyond Scores: Understanding LLM-as-a-Judge Mechanisms in Summarization Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.01604)
*Himil Vasava,Ming Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文通过八种攻击扰动分类、生成配对干净与损坏摘要的流水线，以及因果追踪、logit-lens词汇投影、注意力头敲除等四组实验，对LLM-based NLG质量评估器（Themis和Prometheus）的内部评分机制进行机械论式（mechanistic）研究。发现两个评估器均实现两阶段结构化推理：第15层以下注意力负责局部错误比较并路由结果；其上层MLP级联整合信号并写出评分，决策在残差流中于特定晚层结晶。基础模型对照实验显示微调是在既有基座上雕刻而非从零构建流水线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 虽然基于LLM的NLG质量评估器被广泛用作评分工具和自动化训练信号，但其内部如何分配评分的程序机制仍不清楚。理解这种内部机制对于解释模型行为、改进评估可靠性和揭示训练过程影响具有重要价值。

Method: 构建八类攻击的扰动分类学，覆盖NLG质量的Readability和Adequacy两个维度；设计生成流水线产出配对干净/损坏摘要，并控制错误强度及提供显式token级修改映射；对Themis（Llama-3-8B）和Prometheus（Mistral-7B）施加四组实验：因果追踪、logit-lens词汇投影、注意力头敲除，并与同规模基础模型（Llama-3-8B）对照。

Result: 两个评估器均表现出结构化的两阶段评估流水线：(1) 第15层以下注意力进行局部错误比较并将结果路由到最终输入位置；(2) 第15层以上MLP级联整合信号并写出评分，决策在残差流中于尖锐的晚层结晶（Themis在L=26，Prometheus在L=25）。同规模基础模型再现了路由架构和结晶现象，但缺乏阶段分离，表明微调专门安装了两种机制：抑制低于L15层在末位置的MLP贡献，以及结晶深度提前两层。

Conclusion: LLM评估器内部采用可解释的结构化两阶段评估机制，且该机制并非微调从零构建，而是微调在已有基座（routing架构和结晶机制）上进行雕刻改造而成。作者公开了源代码和数据。

Abstract: LLM-based evaluators of natural language generation (NLG) quality are widely deployed as scoring tools and as automated training signals, yet the internal procedure by which they assign a rating remains poorly understood. We investigate this procedure mechanistically through an eight-attack perturbation taxonomy across the Readability and Adequacy dimensions of NLG quality, a generation pipeline that produces paired clean and corrupt summaries with controlled error intensity and explicit token-level modification maps, and a four-experiment battery of causal tracing, logit-lens vocabulary projection, and attention-head knockout applied to Themis (Llama-3-8B) and Prometheus (Mistral-7B). Both evaluators implement a structured, coherent evaluation pipeline operating in two stages: below layer 15, attention performs local error comparison and routes the result to the final input position; above it, the MLP cascade integrates the signal and writes the rating, with the decision crystallizing in the residual stream at a sharp late layer (L = 26 on Themis, L = 25 on Prometheus). Furthermore, a base-model control at the same scale (Llama-3-8B) reproduces the routing architecture and crystallization but not the stage separation, isolating the two mechanisms that fine-tuning specifically installs, suppression of below-L15 MLP contribution at the last position and a two-layer advance of the crystallization depth, indicating that fine-tuning sculpts an existing substrate rather than building the pipeline from scratch. We release the source code and data at https://github.com/himil-v/judge-mech

</details>

### [244] [Long-Horizon State Tracking in LLMs: Executing MD5 through a Deep Sequence of Dependent Tool Calls](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00012)
*Dheeraj Mohandas Pai,Lu Xian*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过让LLM逐步计算MD5哈希（196个依赖工具调用、64轮，携带4个32位字）来干净地测试长程任务中的状态跟踪能力，消除了指令理解等混淆因素。实验表明gpt-oss-120b在多数完成运行中能正确携带完整状态并返回正确摘要，即使将所有工具替换为第二个LLM（无精确算术oracle）也能成功，关键在于保留模型自身推理上下文并对思考型worker进行投票。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长程任务基准混淆了状态跟踪困难与指令理解，缺少隔离该能力的对照组，且易受幻觉最终答案等捷径影响，因此无法解释长程运行失败的原因。LLM能否跨多次工具调用精确携带中间状态本身尚未被充分验证。

Method: 设计MD5逐步骤计算任务：196个依赖工具调用分64轮进行，模型在上下文中携带4个32位字(a,b,c,d)。从零实现MD5(RFC 1321)，每一步调用都与ground-truth trace对齐并逐位检查digest，确保任何失败都是纯粹的簿记错误。最强设定中每个基本工具都被第二个LLM替换，由driver和worker从零计算完整哈希。成功取决于两个不改变权重的要素：每轮将模型自身推理保留在上下文中，以及对启用思考的worker进行投票以消除模算术错误。

Result: gpt-oss-120b（每token仅约5.5B活跃参数的MoE模型）在温度0、短固定提示下，能在全部196次调用中携带完整状态并在多数完成运行中返回正确digest。即使在没有精确算术oracle的最强设定下（所有工具替换为LLM）也能成功。

Conclusion: LLM确实具备跨大量工具调用精确携带中间状态的能力。通过保留推理上下文和对思考型worker投票可消除大部分失败，剩余失败可按来源归因，区分为状态携带、算术和服务问题。

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks remain uncommon in large language model (LLM) evaluation, and for a reason: when each step depends on the last, per-step accuracy that looks excellent in isolation decays catastrophically, as errors cascade and the end-to-end failure probability grows sharply with length. Existing agentic benchmarks report end-to-end success but confound this state-tracking difficulty with instruction interpretation, give no control group that isolates it, and are vulnerable to shortcuts such as a hallucinated final answer, so they cannot say why a long run fails. Whether an LLM can carry exact intermediate state across many tool calls at all is itself not well established. We test this cleanly by having the model compute a cryptographic hash, MD5, step by step: a sequence of $196$ dependent tool calls over $64$ rounds while it carries four $32$-bit words $(a,b,c,d)$ in its own context from one call to the next. Interpretation is trivial and, because we implement MD5 from scratch (RFC~1321), we align every call to the ground-truth trace and check the digest to the bit, so any failure is pure bookkeeping. gpt-oss-120b, a mixture-of-experts model with only $\sim$5.5B active parameters per token, at temperature $0$ with a short fixed prompt, carries the full state across all $196$ calls and returns the correct digest on a majority of completed runs. In the strongest setting we replace every primitive tool with a second LLM, so a driver and a worker compute the whole hash from scratch with no exact-arithmetic oracle in the loop. Two ingredients decide success and neither changes the weights: keeping the model's own reasoning in its context each turn, and voting over a thinking-enabled worker to remove its modular-arithmetic slips. We localize the residual failures by origin, separating state-carrying from arithmetic and from serving.

</details>


### [245] [EULER: Exploring Underused Links with Evidence-Checked Return for Multi-Agent Mathematical Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00032)
*Ren Zhenzhuo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EULER是一个多智能体系统，它将数学领域之间的"桥梁"（问题迁移）作为搜索的基本单元，通过直接、相邻领域和远距离领域三条路线竞争来研究数学猜想。系统在120个近期猜想上测试，产生10个证明、3个反驳和45个部分结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 数学社区使用不同的对象、不变量和工具，因此在不同数学领域之间迁移问题代价高昂且常被跳过。作者希望自动化这种跨域问题迁移，使数学推理能够跨越领域边界。

Method: EULER采用多智能体架构，围绕固定猜想同时运行直接证明、相邻领域和远距离领域三条路线。每条"桥梁"路线只有在提供源表示无法执行的操作，且目标侧证据能通过验证的蕴含关系回到原始命题时才保留预算。系统还设计了六项有序压力测试，在昂贵搜索开始前拒绝无效桥梁。

Result: 在120个近期猜想（冻结于搜索前并筛选污染，来源为Journal of Combinatorial Theory Series A作者近期论文）上，EULER产生10个证明、3个反驳和45个范围限定的部分结果。消融实验显示：桥梁特定压力测试将错误结论从9降至3；桥梁材料与目标原生操作结合产生+4.2的正交互效应。领域距离并不能可靠预测成功，而可执行的操作增益和有效回归才是关键预测因素。

Conclusion: 跨域迁移的成功不取决于领域之间的距离，而取决于桥梁是否提供源表示无法执行的操作，以及目标侧结果能否通过验证的蕴含关系有效地回到原始命题。这种以"桥梁"为搜索单元的范式可能为自动数学推理开辟新方向。

Abstract: Mathematical communities work with different objects, invariants, and tools, so transferring a problem across them is expensive and often skipped. We present EULER, a multi-agent system that takes such a transfer--a bridge--as its unit of search. Around a fixed conjecture, EULER runs direct, adjacent-domain, and distant-domain routes in competition; a bridge keeps its budget only if it supplies an operation the source representation cannot execute and its target-side evidence returns to the original statement along a checked implication. Six ordered stress tests reject invalid bridges before expensive search begins.
  We evaluate EULER on 120 recent conjectures. The conjectures were frozen before search and screened for contamination, and are drawn from public papers by authors who had recently published in the Journal of Combinatorial Theory, Series A, a leading journal in combinatorics. EULER produced 10 proofs and 3 refutations, plus 45 scoped partial results. Two mechanisms held up under ablation: bridge-specific stress tests cut incorrect conclusions from 9 to 3, and bridge material combined with a target-native operation yielded a positive interaction of +4.2 resolved tasks that neither factor produced alone. Domain distance did not reliably predict success; executable operation gain and valid return did.

</details>


### [246] [HyperWorld: Hypergraph-Structured State Serialization Improves Learned Textual World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00002)
*Yun-Jian Zhang,Chen-Wei Liang,Tian-Yi Zhang,Jian Ding,Yi-Lun Wu,Ao-Bo Li,Wei-Cong Su,Saifullah,Hong-Yu An,Mu-Jiang-Shan Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HyperWorld，系统研究文本环境中状态序列化结构对学习符号世界模型的影响。通过对比原始观测和三种符号序列化（独立句、成对三元组、以实体为中心的超边单元），发现超边序列化在中小规模模型（0.5B-1.5B）及分布外场景下效果最佳，在贪心规划中成功率最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型能让语言模型智能体预测环境动态并制定规划，但文本环境中状态序列化结构的作用尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出HyperWorld对照研究，比较原始观测与三种符号序列化方式（独立句、成对三元组、实体中心超边单元），所有变体使用相同训练目标：给定状态和动作，预测符号效果或判断动作不可行。

Result: 超边序列化在0.5B-1.5B模型和分布偏移下增益最明显；更大模型缩小差距；成对三元组在分布内精确匹配上可媲美或略超超边，但超边在分布外事实F1和中小规模可行性检测与效果预测权衡上最佳；超边世界模型在贪心规划中成功率最高。

Conclusion: 高阶状态组织是一种简单而有效的归纳偏置，尤其适用于模型容量受限或测试环境与训练环境存在差异的情境。

Abstract: World models enable language-model agents to predict environment dynamics and plan before acting. In text environments, the model must learn symbolic action effects from serialized state descriptions, but the role of serialization structure remains underexplored. We present HyperWorld, a controlled study of state serialization for learned textual world models. We compare raw observations with three symbolic serializations of the same ground-truth state: independent sentences, pairwise triples, and entity-centered hyperedge units that group multiple related facts around entities and relations. All variants use the same training objective: given a state and an action, predict symbolic effects or judge the action infeasible. Across model scales, data budgets, and in-distribution and out-of-distribution test worlds, hyperedge serialization gives the clearest gains for 0.5B--1.5B models and under distribution shift. Larger models reduce the gap, and pairwise triples can match or slightly exceed hyperedges on in-distribution exact match, but hyperedges achieve the strongest out-of-distribution fact F1 and the best small-to-medium scale trade-off between feasibility detection and effect prediction. In downstream greedy planning, the hyperedge world model also attains the highest success rate among the tested representations. These results show that higher-order state organization is a simple but effective inductive bias for learned symbolic world models, especially when model capacity is limited or test environments differ from training.

</details>


### [247] [I-CARE: Analysis of interference-related phenomena in a controllable, diverse and representative unlearning setting for text-to-image models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00003)
*Leonardo Santiago Benitez Pereira,Marcos Escudero Viñolo,Luis Herranz Arribas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了I-CARE，一个将"干扰"（interference）形式化为生成式机器遗忘中一等研究对象的系统方法论，提供任务、指标和结果报告模板的形式化定义，以实现跨遗忘设置的系统性和可重复性研究，并通过开源框架和Web界面支持实际应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管生成式机器遗忘领域进展迅速，但遗忘过程中对语义相关概念（本应保留的）造成的意外退化（即干扰现象）仍缺乏明确的特征化描述和一致的评估方法，阻碍了该方向的系统研究。

Method: I-CARE不提出新的基准或遗忘算法，而是提供一套形式化方法，包括：干扰现象的任务定义、评估指标定义、结果报告模板，旨在使该方法论在模型和遗忘算法演进中保持有效性，将长期科学洞见与短期经验结果解耦。

Result: 作者使用最先进的遗忘算法和常用数据集进行了可行性演示，结果表明I-CARE能够跨多种遗忘设置对干扰模式进行有意义的分析，验证了该框架的实际适用性。同时提供了开源软件实现和基于Web的图形界面供用户探索。

Conclusion: I-CARE为生成式机器遗忘中的干扰研究建立了系统化、可复现的研究框架，弥补了该领域在干扰评估方面缺乏统一标准的空白，为后续研究提供了方法论基础。

Abstract: Machine unlearning studies the removal of knowledge from an AI model, making the system forget a concept it previously learned. Despite rapid progress in generative machine unlearning, the unintended degradation of semantically related concepts that should have been retained (henceforth, interference) remains poorly characterized and inconsistently evaluated. This paper introduces I-CARE, a methodology that formalizes interference as a first-class object of study in generative unlearning. Rather than proposing a new benchmark or unlearning algorithm, I-CARE provides formal definitions for tasks, metrics, and templates for reporting results, enabling the systematic and reproducible study of interference across unlearning settings. While our methodology is designed to remain valid as models and unlearning algorithms evolve, decoupling long-term scientific insight from transient empirical results, we present a feasibility demonstration with state-of-the-art algorithms and frequently used datasets. The results demonstrate that I-CARE enables meaningful analysis of interference patterns across multiple unlearning settings, establishing the practical applicability of the framework. The software implementation of the methodology is provided in an open-source framework, together with a web-based graphical interface that enables exploration of the outcomes of this study without requiring direct interaction with the codebase or specialized data analysis tools.

</details>


### [248] [Control-Data Flow Separation: Stable Prompt Optimization in Multi-Agent LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00621)
*Wentao Zhang,Syed Shariyar Murtaza,Junaid Ahmad Bhatti,Utkarsh Soni,Yifan Nie,Eugene Wen,Yuntian Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出多智能体LLM系统中提示词的角色分离方法——将执行关键的控制流（如消息路由、输出格式、终止信号）表示为类型化程序对象，而将任务相关内容保留为可优化的语言数据流，从而防止提示词优化破坏系统执行协议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体系统中的提示词同时承担两个纠缠的角色：生成任务相关内容 + 指定执行关键协议（路由、格式化、终止信号）。当提示词优化器修改提示词以提升内容生成质量时，可能意外破坏执行协议导致整个流水线失败。

Method: 提出控制-数据流分离（control-data flow separation）：将执行关键的控制信息表示为类型化的、经过验证的程序对象，而任务相关的语言内容保持为可优化的数据流，用于智能体间通信。这样优化器可以在不暴露路由或格式化接口给提示漂移的情况下改进多智能体行为。

Result: 在合成推理、协作审查生成和保险评级工作流三个场景中，该方法实现了100%的最终协议有效性，同时持续提升任务性能。

Conclusion: 控制与数据流的分离是一种有效的设计原则，既能保障多智能体系统协议执行的鲁棒性，又保留了提示词优化的灵活性，使优化器能够在安全边界内持续改进任务表现。

Abstract: Prompt optimization can improve multi-agent LLM systems, but the prompts being optimized often serve two entangled roles: generating task-relevant content and specifying execution-critical protocols, such as message routing, output formatting, and termination signals, on which the underlying code relies. As a result, a prompt edit intended to improve content generation can inadvertently corrupt the protocol and cause the entire agent pipeline to fail. Our key observation is that these two roles have different representations: execution protocols are typically structured, while task-relevant content is usually expressed in unstructured language. Based on this, we propose control-data flow separation, where execution-critical control is represented as typed, validated program objects, while task-relevant language remains the optimizable data flow for agent communication. This design allows optimizers to improve multi-agent behavior without exposing the routing or formatting interface to prompt drift. Across synthetic reasoning, collaborative review generation, and insurance rating workflows, our framework empirically achieves 100% eventual protocol validity while consistently improving task performance.

</details>


### [249] [Discrete-Time MDP Modeling for Multi-Item Capacitated Lot Sizing with Stochastic Demand Timing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00004)
*Léa Bayati,Mohamed Dahmoune,Melek Rodoplu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究有限时域多物品有容量限制的批量排产问题，其中需求量确定但需求到达时期随机。作者将问题建模为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（DTMDP），并提出遗传算法（GA）搜索可行状态-反馈策略。实验表明GA在330个基准实例上平均最优性差距约3.44%，在困难实例上低于5%阈值，且获得显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的批量排产问题通常假设需求到达时期是确定的，但实际生产环境中需求可能出现的时间窗口存在随机性。作者希望在需求级做出生产和分配决策，以表示容量竞争、需求特定积压和依赖分配的库存动态，同时隔离并研究随机到达时间对计算复杂度的影响。

Method: 将随机问题建模为离散时间马尔可夫决策过程（DTMDP），定义状态空间、可行动作、转移核和单期成本函数。首先通过与确定性对照版本比较来量化随机时序带来的计算开销增加；然后提出遗传算法（GA），该算法在可行的状态-反馈策略空间中进行搜索，并通过DTMDP转移模型精确评估每个策略。

Result: 在330个基准实例上，GA在可精确求解的实例上平均最优性差距约3.44%。在90个困难测试实例上，GA保持在5%最优性差距阈值以下，平均优化加速为6.89±1.41（95%置信水平）。对于无法在现有硬件上精确求解的实例，使用经验Bellman时间回归估计缺失的精确求解时间并外推预期的GA加速。

Conclusion: 研究证实随机需求到达时序显著增加了问题的状态数、转移数、求解时间和内存压力，而所提出的遗传算法能够在状态-反馈策略空间中高效搜索，在接近最优解的同时实现显著的求解加速，为随机时序下的多物品有容量批量排产问题提供了实用解决方案。

Abstract: This paper studies a finite-horizon multi-item capacitated lot-sizing problem in which demand quantities are deterministic, while demand-arrival periods are stochastic. Each demand occurs once within a known time window and must be satisfied no later than its deadline. The proposed model makes production and allocation decisions at the demand level, allowing it to represent capacity competition, demand-specific backlog, and allocation-dependent inventory dynamics. The stochastic problem is formulated as a discrete-time Markov decision process (DTMDP), including the state space, feasible actions, transition kernel, and one-period cost function. To isolate the computational effect of stochastic timing, each stochastic instance is first compared with a deterministic counterpart in which each arrival distribution is replaced by its most likely arrival period. This comparison shows that stochastic timing substantially increases the number of states, the number of transitions, solution time, and memory pressure. A genetic algorithm (GA) is then proposed for the stochastic-timing problem. The GA searches over feasible state-feedback policies and evaluates each policy exactly under the DTMDP transition model. Computational experiments on 330 benchmark instances show that the GA remains close to the exact stochastic solution whenever the latter is available, with an average optimality gap of about $3.44\%$. On the difficult benchmark instances, comprising 90 test cases, the GA remains below the $5\%$ optimality-gap threshold and achieves an average optimization speedup of $6.89 \pm 1.41$ at the $95\%$ confidence level. For instances that cannot be solved exactly on the available hardware, an empirical Bellman-time regression is used to estimate the missing exact resolution time and extrapolate the expected GA speedup.

</details>


### [250] [ChatDev 2.0: A No-Code Multi-Agent Platform for Developing Everything](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00714)
*Yufan Dang,Shu Yao,Bowen Lai,Chenting Xu,Ruijie Shi,Wai-Shing Leung,Huatao Li,Chen Qian,Zhiyuan Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ChatDev 2.0: DevAll 是一个无代码平台，用于构建、执行和检查异构多智能体系统（MAS），通过声明式可执行图结合循环感知执行引擎，在保持高表达力的同时实现易用性，无需编写代码即可完成MAS的编排与检查。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的多智能体系统开发存在两难困境：代码框架表达力强但工程负担重，无代码构建器虽然简化了创作流程，却将智能体交互限制在作者定义的固定工作流中，无法兼顾表达力与易用性。

Method: DevAll采用双层设计：(1) 表达层面，提出声明式可执行图抽象，并配套循环感知执行引擎，支持异构智能体及动态、循环交互的统一表示与执行；(2) 易用层面，集成可视化界面，使用户无需写代码即可完成MAS的创作、运行、监控与检查，并支持人机协作步骤。

Result: 实验表明，DevAll在三个代表性任务上以具有竞争力的性能复现了最先进的MAS，且无需任务特化的编排代码，验证了其作为LLM-based MAS通用平台的有效性。

Conclusion: DevAll成功弥合了代码框架与无代码构建器之间的鸿沟，证明了无代码平台也能兼顾高表达力与易用性，为LLM-based多智能体系统的通用化开发提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, yet their development forces a tradeoff: code frameworks are expressive but engineering-intensive, while no-code builders simplify authoring but constrain agent interactions to author-defined workflows. We present ChatDev 2.0: DevAll (hereafter DevAll), a no-code platform for building, executing, and inspecting heterogeneous MAS that delivers both high expressiveness and ease of use. In terms of expressiveness, DevAll pairs a declarative executable graph abstraction with a cycle-aware execution engine, so that heterogeneous agents and dynamic and cyclic interactions can be represented and executed within a single framework. For ease of use, an integrated visual interface lets users author, run, monitor, and inspect MAS, including human-in-the-loop steps, entirely without writing code. Experiments demonstrate that DevAll reproduces state-of-the-art MAS across three representative tasks at competitive performance and without task-specific orchestration code, highlighting its effectiveness as a general-purpose platform for LLM-based MAS. DevAll is available at https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev.

</details>


### [251] [Incremental Risk Assessment of Progressive Elder Financial Scams via Instruction-Tuned Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00005)
*Parviz Ghafariasl,Weimin Fu,Xiaolong Guo,Shing I. Chang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于累积回合的风险评估框架，用于在对话进行中逐轮增量更新金融诈骗风险评估。作者构建了一个包含投资、慈善和技术支持三类诈骗场景的多轮对话数据集，并微调了四个小型语言模型（Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3）。结果表明Phi-4和LLaMA-3.2在参数规模相近的条件下表现出更强的回合感知风险评估能力，适合在移动设备和资源受限环境中进行隐私保护的端侧诈骗防护。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对老年人的金融诈骗越来越多地通过文本和语音渠道（如邮件、短信、电话）发生，通常跨越多轮对话逐步升级——从冒充或闲聊开始，通过建立信任和制造紧迫感逐步推进，最终诱导受害者提供敏感信息或转账。由于风险信号是逐轮渐进出现的，传统单次检测方法难以捕捉跨回合的逐步升级模式，且部署场景资源受限，因此需要能够持续更新风险估计的轻量级模型。

Method: 1. 提出累积回合式风险评估框架：逐步聚合对话回合，在每一步重新估计风险，实现动态诈骗监控。2. 构建多轮对话数据集，覆盖投资诈骗、慈善诈骗和技术支持诈骗三类场景，每段对话含2至8个回合，并在每个累积阶段标注定性风险等级、连续风险分数、解释性理由和安全建议。3. 在统一训练框架下微调四个小型语言模型（Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2、DeepSeek-R1、Qwen3），评估其跨回合诈骗信号捕捉能力。

Result: 微调后的小型语言模型能够捕捉诈骗相关的语言线索和跨回合升级模式，同时保持紧凑的模型架构，适合移动端和资源受限部署。在评估的模型中，Phi-4和LLaMA-3.2在其参数规模下展现出更强的回合感知风险评估性能。

Conclusion: 结构化累积建模能够支持部署场景下的增量式诈骗风险评估，同时展示了紧凑型语言模型在隐私保护、设备端诈骗防护方面的潜力。这为在资源受限环境中实现实时、逐轮更新的诈骗检测提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Financial scams targeting older adults increasingly occur through text and voice channels such as email, SMS, and phone calls, unfolding over multiple conversational turns that begin with impersonation or casual contact, escalate through trust building and urgency, and culminate in requests for sensitive information or financial transfers. Because risk signals emerge incrementally across turns, effective detection requires models that continuously update risk estimates under resource-constrained deployment settings. We propose a cumulative turn-based risk assessment framework that incrementally aggregates conversational turns and re-estimates risk at each step, enabling dynamic scam monitoring across progressively evolving conversations. A multi-turn dialogue dataset is constructed to cover investment, charity, and tech support scam scenarios, with each dialogue containing two to eight turns and annotated at every cumulative stage with a qualitative risk level, a continuous risk score, an explanatory rationale, and a safety recommendation. Four small language models (Phi-4, LLaMA-3.2, DeepSeek-R1, and Qwen3) are fine-tuned and evaluated under a unified training framework. Fine-tuned small models capture fraud-related linguistic cues and cross-turn escalation patterns while maintaining compact architectures suitable for mobile and resource-constrained deployment settings. Among the evaluated models, Phi-4 and LLaMA-3.2 achieve stronger turn-aware risk estimation performance relative to their parameter scale. These results suggest that structured cumulative modeling can support incremental scam risk assessment in deployment-oriented settings while highlighting the potential of compact language models for privacy-aware and on-device fraud protection.

</details>


### [252] [OpenAgentFlow: Enabling System-Wide Safety Boundaries for Heterogeneous AI Agent Fleets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00015)
*Dongsheng Chen,Xiangyu Zhao,Xin Yao,Xuetao Wei*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: OpenAgentFlow提出了一种控制平面/动作平面架构，在动作提交边界强制执行安全策略。它将GUI动作、API调用、工具调用和LLM生成的调用统一规范化为AgentEvent流，通过共享的预执行策略执行点路由每个事件，并维护溯源、会话状态、审计记录和可更新策略。在Android上的300案例基准中达到94.0%准确率和95.3%攻击拦截率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI代理正从孤立助手演变为异构系统，多个代理、规划器、控制器和执行后端在同一环境中运行，安全成为系统级的动作治理问题。现有防护措施覆盖提示词、工具调用、GUI动作和代理本地行为，但存在执行碎片化、难以揭示跨多步动作流风险、审计性和策略演化支持有限等问题。

Method: 提出控制平面/动作平面架构：动作平面将待执行的GUI动作、API调用、工具调用和LLM生成调用规范化为统一的AgentEvent流；每个事件通过共享的预执行策略执行点路由；控制平面负责维护溯源、会话状态、审计记录和可更新策略，使新规则无需修改代理、提示词、模型或执行路径即可生效。

Result: 在Android上300案例动作事件基准中达到94.0%准确率和95.3%攻击拦截率；在30案例动态策略套件中安装新规则后有27例符合预期行为；在100案例Android模拟器套件的98个追踪案例中达到90.8%原始准确率和92.9%追踪调整后通过率。

Conclusion: OpenAgentFlow为异构AI代理集群提供了实用的共享强制执行边界，展示了统一策略执行点在多代理环境中的有效性和可扩展性。

Abstract: AI agents powered by large language models are evolving from isolated assistants into heterogeneous systems in which multiple agents, planners, controllers, and execution backends operate over the same user or enterprise environment. In such settings, safety becomes a system-level action-governance problem: deciding whether concrete agent-generated actions should be committed before they modify shared state. Existing safeguards cover prompts, tool calls, GUI actions, and agent-local behavior, but often leave enforcement fragmented, obscure risks that emerge across multi-step action flows, and provide limited support for auditability and policy evolution.
  We present OpenAgentFlow, a control-plane/action-plane architecture that enforces safety at the action-commit boundary. It normalizes pending GUI actions, API calls, tool calls, and LLM-generated invocations into a unified AgentEvent stream, routes each event through a shared pre-execution Policy Enforcement Point, and maintains provenance, session state, audit records, and updatable policies in the control plane. This creates a shared governable action stream and allows new rules to take effect without modifying agents, prompts, models, or execution paths.
  We instantiate OpenAgentFlow on Android. On a 300-case action-event benchmark, it achieves 94.0% accuracy and a 95.3% attack block rate. On a 30-case dynamic-policy suite, it matches expected behavior in 27 cases after new rules are installed. Across 98 traced cases from a 100-case Android emulator suite, it achieves 90.8% raw accuracy and a 92.9% trace-adjusted pass rate across GUI, API, and LLM-planned cases. These results show that OpenAgentFlow provides a practical shared enforcement boundary for heterogeneous AI agent fleets.

</details>


### [253] [SCAFFOLD: A Large-Scale Structured Dataset of Computer Science Research Figures with Diagram QA and Chain-of-Thought Reasoning Traces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00018)
*Ranjit Raut,Aarav Subedi,Sagun Rai,Sudan Jha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了SCAFFOLD，一个大规模计算机科学论文图表数据集，包含图、标题、上下文、问答对和思维链推理。数据集有三个规模版本（157K/37K/12K对），并在12K子集上使用Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct进行了基线实验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算机科学论文高度依赖架构图、流程图和管线示意图等图表，这些图表往往比周围文字承载更多信息，但目前缺乏将这些图表与标题、上下文、问题和逐步推理配对的公开数据集，无法用于训练视觉语言模型理解此类图表。

Method: 从arXiv计算机科学论文中，使用版面检测和PDF解析构建（图像、标题、上下文、问答、思维链）元组数据集，并采用AI辅助的问题生成步骤。提供三个规模版本：SCAFFOLD-157K（3,058篇论文，29,887个图，157,387对）、SCAFFOLD-37K（36,797对）和SCAFFOLD-12K（12,000对）。

Result: 构建了多规模的数据集，其中SCAFFOLD-157K覆盖3,058篇论文和29,887个图共157,387对数据。使用SCAFFOLD-12K在Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct上进行了基线实验。

Conclusion: SCAFFOLD填补了计算机科学图表理解数据集的空白，为训练视觉语言模型理解CS论文图表提供了重要的资源和基准基础。

Abstract: Computer science papers rely heavily on diagrams: architecture drawings, system flowcharts, and pipeline schematics that often carry more information than the text around them. There is currently no public dataset that pairs this specific kind of figure with captions, context, questions, answers, and step-by-step reasoning, which is exactly what is needed to train a vision-language model to understand them. We present \textbf{SCAFFOLD}\footnote{https://github.com/theranjitraut/scaffold}, a large-scale structured dataset of computer science research figures with diagram QA and Chain-of-Thought reasoning traces. This dataset consists of (image, caption, context, question-answer, chain-of-thought) tuples from arXiv computer science papers prepared using layout detection and PDF parsing, with an AI-assisted question-generation step. The resulting large-sized SCAFFOLD-157K dataset spans 3,058 papers with 29,887 figures (157,387 pairs), a medium-sized SCAFFOLD-37K dataset (36,797 pairs), and a small-sized SCAFFOLD-12K dataset (12,000 pairs). We used SCAFFOLD-12K for baseline experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct.

</details>


### [254] [UI-Venus-2 Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00028)
*Venus Team,Zhuohan Cai,Haoxing Chen,Jiaxuan Chen,Weizhi Chen,Changlong Gao,Zhangxuan Gu,Yuan Guo,Yusong Hu,Jianrong Jiang,Jianguo Li,Runze Li,Jinzhen Lin,Zhenyu Ma,Changhua Meng,Han Peng,Xinyu Qiu,Shuheng Shen,Zhongyi Shui,Weiqiang Wang,Ming Wen,Zhuoer Xu,Hang Yan,Kaiwen Yang,Ruilin Yao,Nanjun Yu,Zhengwen Zeng,Lianrui Zhang,Yunzhu Zhang,Zhe Zhao,Beitong Zhou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: UI-Venus-2是一个通用型多模态GUI基础智能体，通过统一闭环推理-行动框架在移动端、网页和桌面环境中运行，并通过联合扩展环境覆盖、任务构建和奖励验证三个关键维度来弥合从基准测试到实际部署的差距，同时集成了安全感知机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态GUI智能体在数字任务自动化方面前景广阔，但从基准导向模型过渡到可靠的真实世界应用仍面临挑战，具体包括环境覆盖有限、任务构建脆弱以及奖励验证不可靠等问题。

Method: 论文提出了UI-Venus-2，采用统一的闭环推理-行动框架，并联合扩展三个维度：(1) 环境维度，扩展到超过170个多语言移动应用和原生桌面操作系统；(2) 任务维度，使用深度研究流水线进行基于功能的指令生成；(3) 验证维度，采用轨迹级和样本级评估器，结合视觉关键点和多模型投票来确保可靠的强化学习信号。此外还集成了安全感知机制以控制关键操作的执行。

Result: UI-Venus-2作为一个兼具能力、效率且开源的通用GUI智能体框架，推动了该领域向更可泛化、可验证、可自反的智能体方向发展。

Conclusion: UI-Venus-2通过在环境、任务和验证三个维度上的联合扩展，为真实世界应用中的通用GUI智能体提供了基础支撑，推动其向通用化、可验证和自反式方向发展。

Abstract: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. To bridge the gap toward practical deployment, we jointly scale three critical dimensions: (1) Environments, expanding coverage to more than 170 multilingual mobile apps and native desktop operating systems; (2) Tasks, employing a deep-research pipeline for function-grounded instruction generation; and (3) Verification, adopting trace-level and sample-level evaluators with visual keypoints and multi-model voting to ensure reliable RL signals for training. Furthermore, we integrate safety-aware mechanisms to ensure controlled execution of consequential actions. By offering a capable, efficient, and open-source foundation, UI-Venus-2 advances the field toward more generalizable, verifiable, and self-reflective agents for real-world applications.

</details>


### [255] [When Prediction Error Is Not Enough: Evaluating Nuisance-Function Prediction for Causal Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00071)
*Cong Cao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟，在部分线性模型中比较了OLS、GAM、XGBoost和DML-XGBoost四种方法，研究了干扰函数预测误差与因果估计性能之间的关系。结果发现预测误差不能一致地反映因果偏差，联合误差度量与因果偏差关联微弱，预测误差不应被视为因果估计器质量的直接衡量标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在因果推断中，预测误差常被用于评估干扰函数（nuisance function）估计器的质量，但其与不同因果估计性能指标（如偏差、RMSE、置信区间覆盖率）之间的关系尚不明确，需要系统研究这种关联是否成立。

Method: 在部分线性模型框架下设计蒙特卡洛模拟实验，比较四种方法（OLS、GAM、XGBoost、DML-XGBoost），同时评估干扰函数的预测误差、因果估计的偏差、RMSE和95%置信区间覆盖率，并考察一种基于暴露和结局干扰函数估计误差绝对值交叉乘积的简单联合误差度量。

Result: 在模拟设置中，XGBoost在非oracle方法中RMSE最低，而DML-XGBoost通常提供更好的置信区间覆盖率。预测误差在方法间和设置间并不一致地追踪因果偏差，点估计性能最好的方法不一定有最好的置信区间覆盖率。联合误差度量与因果偏差仅有弱关联。值得注意的是，B-样条在delta_n=0.25时几乎达到oracle覆盖率（0.956），在delta_n=2.0时会仍保持高覆盖率（0.952），表明半参数方法的稳健性。

Conclusion: 预测误差对于评估干扰函数估计有用，但不应将其视为因果估计器质量的直接度量。研究人员在因果推断中选择干扰函数估计方法时，需要结合具体的因果性能指标进行综合评估，而非单纯依赖预测误差。

Abstract: Prediction error is widely used to evaluate nuisance-function estimators in causal inference, but its relationship with causal estimator performance may differ across performance measures. We studied this question in a partially linear model using Monte Carlo simulations. We compared ordinary least squares (OLS), generalized additive models (GAMs), XGBoost, and Double Machine Learning with XGBoost (DML-XGBoost), evaluating nuisance-function prediction error, bias, RMSE, and 95\% confidence interval coverage. We also examined a simple joint-error measure based on the absolute cross-product of estimation errors from the exposure and outcome nuisance functions. Across the simulated settings, XGBoost had the lowest RMSE among the non-oracle methods, while DML-XGBoost generally provided better confidence interval coverage. Prediction error did not consistently track causal bias across methods and settings, and the method with the best point-estimation performance did not necessarily have the best confidence interval coverage. The joint-error measure was only weakly associated with causal bias and did not provide a useful standalone measure of causal performance. These results suggest that prediction error is useful for assessing nuisance-function estimation, but it should not be treated as a direct measure of the quality of the resulting causal estimator.

</details>


### [256] [MiNER: Fine-Tuned Biomedical Natural Language Processing for Malaria Disease Entity Recognition in Clinical Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00073)
*V. S. Anoop,Devika N*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于微调BioBERT预训练语言模型的方法，用于从疟疾相关科学文献中提取生物医学信息（尤其是命名实体）。方法包括语料库选取与预处理、临床意义实体的标注、BioBERT编码及监督微调。实验表明该方法在精确率、召回率和准确率上显著优于其他编码和机器学习算法，并发布了人工标注数据集供研究者使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 疟疾作为全球重大健康负担，其相关文献数量庞大且不断增长，从海量文献中高效提取关键生物医学信息（如流行病学、分子机制、治疗干预等）极具挑战，需要创新的自动化方法来解决信息过载问题。

Method: 1) 选取并预处理大量疟疾相关科学文献语料；2) 对文献中的临床意义实体进行人工标注；3) 利用BioBERT（预训练生物医学语言模型）将文本编码为上下文感知表示；4) 使用领域特定标注和监督学习微调模型以增强生物医学命名实体提取能力。

Result: 通过与不同编码方法和机器学习算法的广泛实验对比，所提出的方法在精确率（precision）、召回率（recall）和准确率（accuracy）方面均显著优于对比方法。此外，作者公开了人工标注的实体与关系提取数据集，以促进后续研究。

Conclusion: 微调后的BioBERT模型能够有效提升疟疾文献中的生物医学信息提取性能，且公开的数据集为健康信息学领域的其他研究者提供了有价值的资源，有助于推动疟疾信息提取的进一步研究与发展。

Abstract: Malaria remains a significant global health burden, necessitating continuous research efforts to understand its complex molecular mechanisms, epidemiology, and potential therapeutic interventions. Extracting essential biomedical information from the vast and constantly growing malaria literature is a challenging task that demands innovative approaches. Recently, pre-trained language models have revolutionized natural language processing tasks, demonstrating remarkable capabilities in various domains. This paper proposes a fine-tuned pre-trained biomedical language model for biomedical information extraction from scientific literature on malaria disease. The proposed methodology selects and preprocesses a large corpus of scientific articles on malaria, and then annotates them with entities of clinical significance. It then leverages BioBERT, a state-of-the-art pre-trained language model, to encode the textual data into context-aware representations. We fine-tune the model using domain-specific annotations and supervised learning to enhance its ability to extract relevant biomedical named entities. Extensive experiments and comparisons with different encoding and machine learning algorithms show that the proposed approach significantly outperforms them in precision, recall, and accuracy. We also publish our human-labeled dataset for entity and relation extraction to enable other health informatics researchers to train advanced models for malaria information extraction.

</details>


### [257] [AI Morbidity and Mortality: A Framework for Clinical AI Failure Review](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00076)
*Paulius Mui,Dean F. Sittig,Steve Labkoff,Sanjay Basu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出AI发病率和死亡率（AI M&M）审查框架，这是一个结构化、无责的基于案例的临床AI失败审查框架，通过标准化的案件接收、证据保存、调查级重建、工具循环归因和纠正行动追踪，将单个AI工作流失败转化为可操作的机构学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床AI日益嵌入实际医疗中，但现有安全机制（聚合模型监控和传统患者安全报告）都难以重构和学习个体AI相关错误和险些失误。现有方法无法解释风险如何在AI系统、临床医生、工作流程和机构控制之间的互动中产生。

Method: 提出AI M&M框架，包含四个维度分类：触发因素-机制-临床路径-纠正行动，将暴露脆弱性的条件与产生风险的过程、对护理的影响及补救措施分开。结合标准化案件接收、证据保存、调查级重建、工具循环归因和纠正行动追踪。

Result: 使用五个说明性门诊用药和临床决策支持案例进行演示；两名临床审查员独立应用所有四个分类轴，在全部20个轴级分类上达成一致。

Conclusion: AI M&M旨在补充而非替代模型监控、患者安全报告和监管监督，将单个AI工作流失败转化为可操作的机构学习，但需要对跨机构、AI系统和临床环境进行前瞻性评估。

Abstract: Clinical artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in real-world care, yet existing safety mechanisms are poorly suited to reconstructing and learning from individual AI-related errors and near-misses. Aggregate model monitoring can identify performance changes, and traditional patient safety reporting can capture adverse events, but neither is designed to explain how risk emerges across the interaction among AI systems, clinicians, workflows, and institutional controls. We propose AI Morbidity and Mortality (AI M&M), a structured, blameless framework for case-based review of clinical AI failures. The framework combines standardized case intake, evidence preservation and investigator-level reconstruction, tool-in-loop attribution, and corrective-action tracking. Each event is classified across four linked dimensions: Trigger - Mechanism - Clinical Pathway - Corrective Action, separating the condition that exposed a vulnerability from the process that produced risk, its consequence for care, and the remediation assigned. We demonstrate the framework using five illustrative outpatient medication and clinical decision-support cases; two clinician reviewers independently applied all four classification axes and reached agreement across all 20 axis-level classifications. AI M&M is intended to complement, rather than replace, model monitoring, patient safety reporting, and regulatory oversight by converting individual AI-in-workflow failures into actionable institutional learning. Prospective evaluation across institutions, AI systems, and clinical settings is needed.

</details>


### [258] [Different representation learning objectives recover distinct latent structures from the same psychometric data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00100)
*Cong Cao,Tassos C. Kyriakides,Pambos Vrasidas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究利用塞浦路斯ProW试验中757对教师-儿童配对数据，比较了主成分分析(PCA)、对比学习及多任务学习等不同表征学习目标在恢复心理测量数据潜在组织方面的差异。对比学习虽大幅提升教师-儿童匹配检索性能（Top-1从0.13%升至7.27%），但相比PCA更难以保留行为表型结构；多任务目标虽部分恢复行为组织却牺牲了检索性能，表明不同表征学习目标揭示的是潜在组织的不同面向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 心理测量问卷包含丰富的条目级信息，但不同表征学习目标是否能恢复相同的潜在组织（如行为表型、教师-儿童对应关系）尚不清楚。理解这一问题是确保表征学习结果具有心理学有效性的关键。

Method: 使用塞浦路斯ProW试验基线数据中757对教师-儿童配对样本，对儿童SDQ、ASBI、CBRS条目作答进行主成分分析(PCA)和聚类，得到四种行为表型。比较PCA表征、对比学习表征及多任务（对齐+行为预测联合优化）表征在教师-儿童检索任务和行为表型结构保留两方面的表现。

Result: 对比学习显著提升教师-儿童检索性能（Top-1准确率从0.13%提升至7.27%，Top-10从1.98%提升至56.14%），但对行为表型结构的保留能力不如PCA表征。多任务目标（联合优化对齐与行为预测）部分恢复行为组织，但导致检索性能下降。

Conclusion: 教师-儿童对应关系与行为表型代表了两种不同的潜在组织形态，链接心理测量数据所恢复的潜在结构取决于所采用的表征学习目标。这意味着研究者在选择表征学习方法时需要明确其目标组织，因为不同目标会导向不同的潜在结构发现。

Abstract: Psychometric questionnaires contain rich item-level information, yet it remains unclear whether different representation learning objectives recover the same latent organization. We investigated this question using 757 matched teacher-child pairs from the baseline assessment of the Cyprus ProW preschool trial. Behavioral structure was characterized from child SDQ, ASBI, and CBRS item responses using principal component analysis and clustering, yielding four behavioral phenotypes. A contrastive objective substantially improved teacher-child retrieval relative to PCA-based representations, increasing Top-1 accuracy from 0.13% to 7.27% and Top-10 accuracy from 1.98% to 56.14%. However, contrastive representations preserved behavioral phenotype structure less effectively than PCA-based representations. A multi-task objective jointly optimizing alignment and behavioral prediction partially restored behavioral organization but reduced retrieval performance. These findings indicate that teacher-child correspondence and behavioral phenotypes represent distinct forms of latent organization and demonstrate that the latent structure recovered from linked psychometric data depends on the representation learning objective.

</details>


### [259] [Deploying and Evaluating a Smart-Agriculture Agentic Engine for Full-Season Soybean Farm Operations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00106)
*Ao Qu,Panagiotis Michelakis,Linyuan Han,Yiannis Hadjiyianni,Kun Ouyang,Konstantinos Siskos,Feng Li,Ran Meng,Jingchi Jiang,Dimitrios Stamoulis,Jie Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了FAIRY，一个在哈尔滨工业大学智慧农业基地实际部署的全栈智能农业代理系统。该系统基于"万物皆事件"的执行范式，将时空世界演化、传感器读数、作物生长转变、机械动作等都表示为共享农场流程引擎中的状态变更事件。FAIRY集成了生产级机械、土壤和冠层传感器、多光谱和热成像无人机、卫星植被产品、天气站、校准的作物过程模型等基础设施，并通过一百个全季大豆场景对九个先进代理控制器进行了评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能农业代理系统缺乏在真实运营农场上进行全季节、全流程、时空耦合的农艺操作执行与评估的平台。现有研究通常局限于模拟或单一任务，无法捕捉从垄间准备到收获储存的完整季节性时空工作流中操作约束、延迟效应和最终产量之间的复杂耦合关系。

Method: FAIRY采用"一切皆事件"的执行范式，将时空世界演化、遥感/UAV观测、传感器读数、作物生长转变、机械动作和管理干预统一表示为共享农场流程引擎中的状态变更事件。在此事件驱动世界模型之上，实现了完整代理栈：原子农艺技能知识库、多代理控制器与编排后端、前沿及边缘模型执行、全路径追踪日志和本地节点部署分析。评估套件结合了代理成功率、全路径时空正确性、token成本和边缘设备运行时。

Result: 在100个全季大豆场景中评估了9个最先进的代理控制器，场景保留了64垄田地中空间观测、时间决策序列、农艺约束、延迟效应和最终产量之间的操作耦合。开发了结合代理成功、全路径时空正确性、token成本和边缘设备运行时的综合评估套件。

Conclusion: FAIRY作为首个部署在运营农场的全栈智能农业代理系统，通过事件驱动范式和完整代理栈，为全季时空农艺工作流的执行与评估提供了一个生产级平台，展示了其在智能农业代理研究中的价值。

Abstract: This paper presents FAIRY, a full-stack smart-agriculture agent system developed for and deployed to an operating soybean research farm at Harbin Institute of Technology's smart-agriculture site. We develop FAIRY to execute and evaluate agentic agronomic operations on full-season spatiotemporal workflows that span ridge preparation, planting, irrigation, fertilization, pest and disease treatment, harvest, grain handling, drying, and storage. FAIRY integrates APIs and infrastructure across production-grade machinery, fixed soil and canopy sensors, multispectral and thermal drones, satellite vegetation products, a weather station, calibrated crop-process models, agronomic records, and multi-season yield histories. The system is built around the novel "everything is an event" execution paradigm, which represents spatiotemporal world evolution, remote sensing and UAV observations, sensor readings, crop-growth transitions, machinery actions, and management interventions as state-changing events in a shared farm process engine. On top of this event-driven world model, FAIRY implements a complete agentic stack: a knowledge library of atomic agronomic skills; multi-agent controller and orchestration backends; frontier- and edge-model execution; full-path trace logging; and deployment profiling on local nodes.
