We use FAIRY to evaluate nine state-of-the-art agent controllers across one hundred full-season soybean scenarios that preserve the operational coupling between spatial observations in a 64-ridge field, temporal decision sequences, agronomic constraints, delayed effects, and final yield. We develop an evaluation suite that combines agentic success, full-path spatiotemporal correctness, token cost, and edge-device runtime.

</details>


### [260] [Recursive Criticality of AI Self-Improvement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00137)
*Mikhail Burtsev*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个数学模型，研究AI用于其自身研发（R&D）时产生的递归反馈是否会导致自我放大。作者推导出递归再生产数 R_AI，用以判定改进效果在开发周期中是放大还是衰减：R_AI>1 进入自我放大机制，R_AI<1 则衰减。研究还分析了多组织共享改进如何使整个生态系统自我放大，以及可测量的系统属性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI正日益被用于产生未来AI系统的研发过程中，该"AI帮AI"的反馈回路是否会形成自我放大的加速机制，是一个对未来AI治理和预测至关重要但尚未被严格建模研究的问题。作者希望建立一个可量化的理论框架，区分真正的递归自我放大与其他来源（如基础研究效率提升）驱动的快速进步。

Method: 构建数学模型描述AI能力增长率如何取决于三个因素：基线研究生产率、递归反馈强度、研究进步的递增难度。核心是推导递归再生产数 R_AI，它比较反馈强度与进步难度上升速率之间的关系。模型进一步扩展至多研发主体场景，分析跨组织的改进共享效应。

Result: 研究发现：R_AI>1 时系统进入自我放大机制，R_AI<1 时效果随周期衰减；该转变不依赖于模型能力的特定水平，可能出现在可观测加速之前；高基线生产率加速进程但不改变自我放大特性；开发周期时长成为放大的时间尺度限制；研究难度增加可终止自我放大期；跨组织共享改进可使整体生态系统自我放大，即使单个组织并非如此。

Conclusion: 作者指出该框架能识别可测量的AI研发系统属性（递归反馈强度、改进传播到后继系统的效率、周期时长、研究难度递增速率），这些属性有助于区分真实的递归放大与其它来源驱动的快速进展，为AI发展的预测与治理提供理论支撑。

Abstract: AI is increasingly used in the R\&D process that produces future AI systems. We study the conditions under which this feedback becomes self-amplifying. Our model describes how the rate of AI capability growth depends on baseline research productivity, recursive feedback, and the increasing difficulty of research progress. We derive a recursive reproduction number, $\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{AI}}$, that determines whether improvements are amplified or damped across development cycles. This quantity compares the strength of feedback with the rate at which further progress becomes more difficult. When $\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{AI}}>1$, the effects of improvements compound across development cycles, placing the system in a self-amplifying regime. When $\mathcal{R}_{\mathrm{AI}}<1$, their effects weaken across cycles. The transition depends on the structure of the AI R\&D feedback loop and need not occur at any particular level of model capability. A system can therefore enter a self-amplifying regime before acceleration becomes visible, while rapid progress can also occur without self-amplification. Higher baseline research productivity can accelerate progress without changing whether the system is self-amplifying, but the duration of the development cycle becomes a limiting timescale for amplification. Increasing research difficulty can end a period of self-amplification. Extending the model to multiple research actors shows that improvements shared across organizations can make the overall research ecosystem self-amplifying even when no individual actor is. The framework identifies measurable properties of AI R\&D systems that can help distinguish recursive amplification from rapid progress driven by other sources, including the strength of recursive feedback, how effectively improvements propagate into successor systems, cycle duration, and the increasing difficulty of further progress.

</details>


### [261] [IMPACT: Attention Is the Interaction Map for Scalable Interaction-Aware World Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00161)
*Rongze Tang,Jianjie Fang,Zhaolu Wang,Ziyou Wang,Xvyuan Liu,Haisheng Su,Xin Zhang,Wei Wu,Chen Gao,Yong Li,Zhibo Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出IMPACT框架，通过识别全局平均MSE去噪目标中的监督分配不匹配问题，利用跨注意力与操作对象token作为内部分割先验，构建交互图来重加权去噪监督，从而在不引入外部表示或推理时修改的情况下提升具身智能体世界模型在动作条件未来预测中的物理合理交互生成能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型在动作条件未来预测中已有显著进展，但仍难以建模物理上合理的交互。现有方法通过外部表示（运动、几何或语义）约束生成过程，但这些时空稠密表示通常需要辅助估计器或人工标注，限制了训练的可扩展性。作者从训练目标本身切入，发现在全局平均MSE去噪目标下存在监督分配不匹配：静态内容主导优化信号，导致对交互生成至关重要的稀疏动态物体区域监督不足。

Method: IMPACT框架包含两个核心组件：1) Prior-guided Attention Calibration —— 利用与操作对象token关联的跨注意力作为动作条件变化的内部时空先验，从中采样候选区域；2) Targeting —— 用分离的局部预测误差校准候选区域以构建交互图，并用该图重加权去噪监督。整个过程无需外部表示、辅助估计器或人工标注，也不改变推理过程。

Result: 在机械臂和人类手部操作任务上，涵盖多种控制模态和DiT骨干网络的大量实验表明，IMPACT一致优于对应的MSE训练基线，在交互保真度、物理合理性和视觉质量方面均有提升。

Conclusion: 通过重新审视训练目标并解决监督分配不匹配问题，IMPACT实现了可扩展的交互感知世界模型训练，证明了内部注意力先验可以替代外部稠密表示来引导更合理的交互生成，为具身智能世界模型的训练策略提供了新思路。

Abstract: World models have made remarkable progress in action-conditioned future prediction for embodied agents, yet still struggle to model physically plausible interactions. Existing approaches address this limitation by constraining the generation process with external representations encoding motion, geometry, or semantics. Obtaining these spatiotemporally dense representations typically requires auxiliary estimators or manual annotations, limiting training scalability. We instead revisit the training objective and identify a supervision-allocation mismatch under the globally averaged mean squared error (MSE) denoising objective: prevalent static content dominates the optimization signal, leaving sparse dynamic-object regions critical to interaction generation disproportionately under-supervised. Motivated by this observation, we introduce IMPACT, a scalable Interaction-aware Model training framework with Prior-guided Attention Calibration and Targeting. IMPACT uses cross-attention associated with manipulated-object tokens as an internal spatiotemporal prior for action-conditioned changes. It samples candidate regions from this prior, calibrates them with detached local prediction errors to construct an interaction map, and uses the map to reweight denoising supervision, requiring neither external representations nor inference-time modifications. Extensive experiments on robot-arm and human-hand manipulation, spanning diverse control modalities and DiT backbones, show that IMPACT consistently outperforms the corresponding MSE-trained baselines, improving interaction fidelity, physical plausibility, and visual quality.

</details>


### [262] [Asymmetries in Spontaneous and Instructed Deception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00180)
*Josiah Luikham*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究探讨了大型语言模型中受指示欺骗与自发性（未受指示）欺骗之间的关系，使用Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct模型，通过方向几何、跨设置分类器和跨设置引导三种方法进行比较分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往关于LLM欺骗的研究大多集中于受指示欺骗（即用户明确要求模型欺骗），但对模型无指示自发欺骗的研究相对较少。理解这两种欺骗形式之间是否存在共享的机制或方向，对于检测和缓解模型欺骗行为具有重要意义。

Method: 使用Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct模型，通过三种分析方法比较受指示欺骗和自发性欺骗：（1）方向几何分析（方向余弦约为0.5，表明两种设置共享部分方向分量）；（2）跨设置分类器训练（自发性训练的模型在受指示数据上表现更好）；（3）跨设置引导（受指示派生方向在引导自发性提示时效果更好）。同时分析最佳token位置在派生引导向量与训练分类器之间的差异。

Result: 研究发现两种欺骗设置共享约0.5余弦相似度的方向分量；在检测方面，自发性训练的模型对受指示数据表现更好；在因果引导方面，受指示派生方向对自发性提示引导效果更好，存在明显的非对称迁移。此外，最佳token位置在两种方法之间存在差异。

Conclusion: 受指示欺骗和自发性欺骗之间存在部分共享的机制（共享方向分量），但两设置在检测和因果引导上的迁移存在不对称性，且不同的干预方法（分类器vs引导）适合在不同token位置应用。这表明两种欺骗形式既有共性又有独特特征，需要分别考虑应对策略。

Abstract: Large language models sometimes deceive users without being instructed to. However, much of the study on deception in models involves instructed deception. We investigated the relationship between instructed and spontaneous (uninstructed) deception in Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct. We compared these two deception settings through direction geometry, cross-setting classifiers, and cross-setting steering. We found the two deception settings share a component of direction (cosine of approximately 0.5) and an asymmetry in the transfer between settings regarding detection and causation. Spontaneous trained classifiers performed better on instructed data than vice versa, and instructed derived directions performed better at steering spontaneous prompts than vice versa. Likewise the best token position to derive steering vectors from differed from the best token position to train and apply classifiers.

</details>


### [263] [LLM-Driven Autonomous Vehicles Inherit Human Driver Biases in Pedestrian Yielding: Results and Implications From A New Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00192)
*Irem Yoldas,Martim Brandão,Jie Zhang,Odinaldo Rodrigues*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种新的偏见测试方法（"All Else Being Equal"测试和"Self-Consistency"测试），用于评估大型语言模型（LLMs）和视觉语言模型（VLMs）在自动驾驶（AV）行人让行决策中的偏见。研究发现这些模型在行人让行决策中确实受到行人性别、种族、宗教、残疾、年龄、肤色和社会经济地位的影响，质疑了"常识"模型范式的可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公众对自动驾驶汽车的信任不仅取决于技术成功，还取决于其决策的公平性。心理学研究已证明人类驾驶员存在偏见（如对美国黑人行人让行率更低），但目前对AV研究中使用的通用"常识"模型是否继承了这些人类偏见的研究仍然不足。因此需要将模型偏见分析纳入AV评估体系。

Method: 提出两种新的偏见测试方法：1)"All Else Being Equal"测试—控制其他因素不变，仅改变行人特定属性来测试模型的让行决策差异；2)"Self-Consistency"测试—评估模型在类似情境下决策的一致性。将这些测试应用于LLMs和VLMs，分析其在行人让行决策中的偏见表现。

Result: 研究发现LLMs和VLMs的让行决策都会受到行人性别、种族、宗教、残疾、年龄、肤色和社会经济地位的影响。不同类型的偏见程度因模型而异，但存在一些共同的偏见模式。

Conclusion: 模型确实继承了类似人类的驾驶偏见，这引发了关于"常识"模型范式的质疑。作者提出需要要么修订该范式，要么解决下游偏见问题，以促进公平的AV决策。

Abstract: Public trust in Autonomous Vehicles (AVs) may depend not only on technical success but also on the fairness of their decision making. While a recent trend in AV research involves using general purpose "common sense" models to guide AV decision making, the degree to which these inherit human biases in driving is still understudied. Given that psychology studies have shown human driver biases exist, such as lower pedestrian-yielding rates to Black pedestrians in the US, we argue that analyses of model bias should also be part of AV evaluation. Concretely, in this paper we propose two new bias testing methodologies for Large Language Models (LLMs) and Visual-Language Models (VLMs)-"All Else Being Equal" tests and "Self-Consistency" tests-in order to assess bias in pedestrian-yielding decisions. Our findings show that both LLMs and VLMs make yielding decisions which are influenced by pedestrian gender, ethnicity, religion, disability, age, skin tone and socio-economic status. While the type and degree of bias is different from model to model, we highlight common patterns-and raise questions about the "common sense" model paradigm, particularly the need to either revise the paradigm or address issues of downstream bias.

</details>


### [264] [ReDeck: Step-Level Render-Grounded Refinement for Document-to-Slide Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00194)
*Muzhao Tian,Zezi Zeng,Yifan Yang,Xin Gao,Yan Li,Zisu Huang,Xiaohua Wang,Changze Lv,Mingxi Cheng,Bei Liu,Kai Qiu,Qi Dai,Dong Chen,Yue Dong,Xiaoqing Zheng,Ji Li,Chong Luo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ReDeck，一个逐步渲染反馈的幻灯片修订框架，将修订分解为原子编辑操作，每步返回渲染器反馈（"一次编辑，一次观察"），配合多粒度反馈机制与DeckQuiz基准，在多模型上超越现有幻灯片生成代理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有幻灯片代理采用整体式"一版一反馈"循环：整版重写后再渲染批评，导致溢出、重叠、裁剪和越界等局部错误难以归因和修复，延迟反馈阻碍了可靠的细化过程。

Method: ReDeck将幻灯片修订分解为原子编辑动作，每步后返回渲染器派生的观察结果；采用多粒度反馈：步骤级渲染反馈处理空间错误、回合级自适应批评提供语义与设计指导、提交级门控进行硬性布局验证；并引入DeckQuiz基准解耦内容保真度、空间正确性与设计质量。

Result: 在GPT-5.4、Claude-4.6和Gemini-3.1上，ReDeck一致优于现有幻灯片生成代理；消融实验证明反馈时机与粒度对可靠幻灯片修订至关重要。

Conclusion: 将反馈粒度从整版细化为单步，并将渲染观察嵌入每一步编辑中，能显著提升幻灯片生成的可靠性与质量，反馈时机设计是实现稳定细化的关键因素。

Abstract: Document-to-slide generation is challenging because slides are dense editable artifacts that require both faithful content selection and precise spatial layout. Recent slide agents adopt iterative reflection, but typically follow a monolithic "one version, one feedback" loop: a slide or deck is rewritten, rendered afterward, and critiqued only at the turn boundary. This delayed feedback makes local failures such as overflow, overlap, clipping, and off-canvas placement difficult to attribute and repair. We propose ReDeck, a step-level render-grounded refinement framework that decomposes slide revision into atomic edit actions and returns renderer-derived observations after each step, turning refinement into "one edit, one observation." To balance local repair with global quality, ReDeck uses multi-granular feedback: step-level render feedback for spatial errors, a turn-level adaptive critic for semantic and design guidance, and a submission-level gate for hard layout validation. We further introduce DeckQuiz, a benchmark that decouples content fidelity, spatial correctness, and design quality. Across GPT-5.4, Claude-4.6, and Gemini-3.1, ReDeck consistently outperforms existing slide-generation agents, and ablations confirm that feedback timing and granularity are critical for reliable slide refinement.

</details>


### [265] [AI Should Not Only Be Helpful. It Should Be Contingent. Artificial Intimacy, Sycophancy, and the Future of Social Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00211)
*Scott Compton,Arjun Nagendran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出将"偶然性"（contingency）——即系统响应随用户行为变化的程度及其人际后果——作为评估AI系统的核心构念，指出当前对齐方法（如RLHF）倾向于优先用户认可和对话流畅度，导致谄媚式非偶然性确认模式，并提出构建"偶然性AI"的框架与研究议程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式AI已深度嵌入日常社交环境，既是信息工具也是人际反馈来源。当前对齐方法（尤其RLHF）过度优化用户满意度和对话流畅性，产生谄媚（sycophantic）的非偶然性肯定模式，这种反馈与真实社会后果弱耦合，可能损害人类尤其是青少年在真实社交中的适应性校准能力。

Method: 论文提出一个概念性框架：(1) 将"偶然性"作为AI评估的核心构念；(2) 借鉴行为科学和社会学习理论，论证偶然性反馈是人际技能发展的关键机制；(3) 提出"偶然性AI"框架，包括基于轨迹的评估方法和社会后果预测模型；(4) 提出跨发展心理学、人机交互和机器学习的综合研究议程。

Result: 论文为概念性和框架性工作，提出了一套新的评估AI系统的理论视角和方法论方向，即从"用户满意度"转向"对人类社交学习的影响"作为评价标准，并给出了具体的技术和跨学科研究路线。

Conclusion: AI系统应不仅以用户满意度来评估，更应以它们对人类社交学习的影响来评估。偶然性AI代表了AI设计与评估范式的必要转变——从讨好用户转向促进适应性社交发展。

Abstract: Conversational artificial intelligence is increasingly embedded in everyday social environments, where it functions as both an informational tool and a source of interpersonal feedback. This perspective introduces contingency, i.e., the degree to which system responses vary with user behavior and its interpersonal consequences, as a central construct for evaluating AI systems. We argue that current alignment approaches, including reinforcement learning from human feedback, tend to prioritize user approval and conversational fluency over behaviorally informative feedback, leading to sycophantic patterns of noncontingent affirmation.
  Drawing on behavioral science and social learning theory, we propose that contingent feedback is a key mechanism through which individuals develop interpersonal skills. When AI systems provide feedback weakly coupled to social consequences, they may reduce opportunities for adaptive calibration in real-world interactions, particularly during adolescence, a critical period for social development.
  We outline a framework for contingent AI, including trajectory-based evaluation and models of social consequence prediction, and propose a research agenda spanning developmental psychology, human-AI interaction, and machine learning. More broadly, we argue that AI systems should be evaluated not only by user satisfaction, but by their impact on human social learning.

</details>


### [266] [ConvDeck: Conversational Paper-to-Slide Generation via Stage-Specific User Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00226)
*Tarik Can Ozden,Sachidanand VS,Furkan Horoz,Ozgur Kara,Dilek Hakkani-Tür,Junho Kim,James Matthew Rehg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ConvDeck，一个用于对话式论文到幻灯片生成的多智能体流水线，通过在流水线的不同阶段引入特定阶段的用户交互循环，让用户能够在生成大纲和最终幻灯片的关键决策点进行迭代细化，克服了现有方法中用户反馈受限或仅在完整幻灯片生成后才引入的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化学术论文到幻灯片生成本质上是迭代过程，需要反复的生成、批判和修改循环。现有方法中，多智能体系统的内部批判循环对用户封闭，而对话式方法仅在完整幻灯片生成后才引入反馈，限制了用户在叙事流、内容分配和演示重点等迭代细化中的参与度。

Method: ConvDeck采用多智能体流水线，在流水线不同阶段分布交互，通过特定阶段的循环让用户能反复细化演示大纲和最终幻灯片。这些循环由"思考-说话-行动"的细化机制驱动，智能体可以要么直接应用编辑，要么以对话方式回应用户反馈并讨论修改选项。

Result: 评估表明，特定阶段的对话式反馈在保持叙事连贯性、内容质量和视觉呈现的同时，提高了用户目标的满意度。

Conclusion: ConvDeck验证了在流水线各关键阶段引入对话式用户交互，能够更好地平衡用户定制需求与自动生成质量之间的权衡。

Abstract: Automatic academic paper-to-slide generation is inherently iterative, because creating an effective presentation requires repeated cycles of generation, critique, and revision. Recent multi-agent systems partially acknowledge this through internal critique-and-revise loops, while conversational approaches allow users to refine generated slide decks through dialog. However, these refinement processes either remain largely closed to the user or introduce feedback only after a complete deck has been produced, limiting the user's ability to participate in the iterative refinement of narrative flow, content allocation, and presentation emphasis. To address this gap, we introduce ConvDeck, a multi-agent pipeline for conversational paper-to-slide generation that distributes interaction across the pipeline through stage-specific loops, allowing users to iteratively refine both the presentation outline and the final slide deck at the stages where each kind of decision is made. These loops are driven by a refinement mechanism in which agents can think, speak, and act, enabling them to either directly apply edits or respond conversationally to clarify user feedback and discuss revision options. Our evaluation shows that stage-specific conversational feedback improves user-goal satisfaction while preserving narrative coherence, content quality, and visual presentation.

</details>


### [267] [Learning What to Retain: Gated-Memory Routing for Efficient Collaboration in Multi-Agent LLM Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00237)
*Rakibul Hasan Rajib,Mengxing Zheng,Qian Lou*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出Gate-Memory Routing框架，通过学习的执行记忆（记忆写门只提交非冗余推理步骤，检索门提供紧凑的相关子集）来压缩协作状态，使每步编排决策基于干净且信息丰富的状态，在推理和代码生成基准上实现准确率和效率的双重提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的多智能体系统面临编排适配挑战：仅从查询路由无法适应中间进度或错误，而基于完整执行历史路由虽提供上下文但迫使后期决策处理所有先验步骤（包括冗余或低效用步骤），造成执行历史过载、成本膨胀。有效编排需要紧凑状态来捕捉有用进度而不累积冗余上下文。

Method: 提出Gated-Memory Routing框架，将每个决策建立在查询和学习的执行记忆上。包含三个核心组件：Memory Write Gate（仅提交非冗余推理步骤）、Retrieval Gate（为每个智能体提供紧凑的相关子集）、Adaptive Halting Controller（一旦记忆包含足够回答证据即停止执行）。每步系统从记忆中选取下一角色和后端。

Result: 在五个推理和代码生成基准上，达到最佳平均准确率，超过最强基线2.44个百分点，同时相对基线在HumanEval上减少31.9%推理成本。

Conclusion: Gated-Memory Routing通过紧凑、干净的记忆状态替代冗余执行历史，证明可以在提升准确率的同时显著降低推理成本，兼顾了有效性和高效性。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based multi-agent systems tackle complex reasoning by orchestrating how multiple agents are configured and how they collaborate. A central challenge is to adapt orchestration to the evolving collaboration state. Routing from the query alone cannot adapt to intermediate progress or errors, which hurts accuracy. Routing from the complete execution history supplies this missing context, but forces later decisions to process every prior step, including redundant or low-utility ones. This creates an execution-history overload that inflates cost. Effective orchestration instead requires a compact state that captures useful progress without accumulating redundant context. We propose Gated-Memory Routing, which conditions each decision on the query and a learned execution memory. A learned Memory Write Gate commits only non-redundant reasoning steps, and a learned Retrieval Gate supplies each agent a compact, relevant subset, so every decision conditions on a clean, informative state. At each step, the system selects the next role and backbone from this memory, while an Adaptive Halting Controller stops execution once the memory contains sufficient evidence for answering. Across five reasoning and code-generation benchmarks, our framework is both effective and efficient: it attains the best average accuracy, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.44 points, while reducing HumanEval inference cost by 31.9% relative to that baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/rajibrhasan/gated-memory-routing

</details>


### [268] [Invalidation Contracts for Cross-Episode Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00243)
*Michael Wu,Arquimedes Canedo*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"失效契约"(invalidation contracts)协议层，为LLM代理的API错误恢复建议附加版本戳与可缓存性提示，使客户端能在数据漂移后精准淘汰过期缓存而无需重新推导全部内容，将节省的token与模型调用保留下来。实验跨越7个模型、3条服务路径、2个领域约9,400个episode，行级失效将合规率提升最高66.7个百分点，并恢复29-33%的基线token成本，且驱逐精度达到1.00。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM代理缓存API错误恢复建议可避免重复推导以节省成本，但服务端数据漂移会使缓存修复沦为静默失败；若每次episode都重新推导又回吐全部节省。需在"全缓存"与"全重推"之间找到精准淘汰过期条目的方案。

Method: 设计失效契约协议层：为每条恢复建议附加版本戳(version stamps)与可缓存性提示(cacheability hints)，客户端仅驱逐失效条目而保留其余。将节省分解为两个独立因素：有效性(validity，缓存建议在漂移后仍正确的比例，仅取决于协议、与厂商无关)与合规性(compliance，规划器首次尝试采纳的比例，取决于规划器模型)。评估行级与表级两种失效粒度。

Result: 行级失效在7个模型中合规率提升0到66.7个百分点，其中3个模型达55.6-66.7；4/7模型恢复29-33%基线token成本。表级失效破坏共存条目，5/7模型漂移后首次尝试率降至0%。行级驱逐精度在所有模型上为1.00。契约增加15%响应负载，版本戳有效性在所有模型与服务路径上结果一致、零契约失败。

Conclusion: 失效契约为LLM代理提供了一种兼顾节省与正确性的缓存失效机制，其中行粒度精确淘汰显著优于表粒度粗放失效。值得注意的是合规性存在显著模型差异：Claude Haiku 4.5达100%首次尝试合规，而Claude Sonnet 5仅为11%以下，其表现出"输入schema保守性"，拒绝添加原请求中不存在字段的修复方案。

Abstract: LLM agents that cache recovery suggestions from API errors can skip re-derivation in later episodes, spending fewer tokens and fewer model calls on constraints they have already learned. Server-side data drift turns those cached fixes into silent failures, and the usual remedy, re-deriving on every episode, gives the savings back. We introduce invalidation contracts, a protocol layer that attaches version stamps and cacheability hints to every recovery suggestion so the client can evict stale entries without trial and error, and keep the rest. The contract decomposes realized savings into two independent factors: validity, the fraction of cached suggestions that remain correct after a drift event, and compliance, the fraction the planner applies on the first attempt. Validity depends only on the protocol and is vendor-independent. Compliance depends on the planner model: identical wire bytes yield 100% first-try compliance on Claude Haiku 4.5 and 11% or below on Claude Sonnet 5, which exhibits input-schema conservatism, refusing fixes that add fields the original request did not contain. We evaluate across seven models, three serving paths, two domains, and approximately 9,400 episodes. Row-level invalidation raises compliance by 0 to 66.7 percentage points across the seven models, 55.6 to 66.7 on three, and recovers 29-33% of baseline token cost on four of seven models, while table-level invalidation destroys co-located entries and drops post-drift first-try rates to 0% on five of seven. Eviction precision is 1.00 at row granularity on every model under the row-level oracle of Section 4.1. The contract adds 15% to response payload. Version-stamp validity is deterministic by construction and produced identical results across every model and serving path, with zero contract failures in the entire evaluation.

</details>


### [269] [Authority Bias in Conversational Search Engines for Academic Paper Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00248)
*Uthman Jinadu,Parsa Ghazvinian,Anjila Budathoki,Benjamin M. Ampel,Rajshekhar Sunderraman,Yi Ding*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过反事实实验（原始/翻转/提升三种权威信息条件）系统测试了8个LLM在学术文献推荐中是否存在权威偏见（基于作者声望、期刊和引用而非内容进行判断），发现权威偏见显著且具有方向性，不同模型差异大，仅凭提示去偏难以完全消除，且存在“说-做差距”（去偏指令抑制权威提及远快于实际行为翻转）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地被用作学术文献的会话式搜索引擎，但尚未有人因果性地测试它们是根据论文内容还是权威信号（作者声望、期刊、引用）来评判论文。传统的表面审计（观察模型输出中是否提及权威）无法可靠量化行为层面的偏见，因此需要反事实实验设计来测量真实的权威偏见。

Method: 保持标题和摘要不变，在三个反事实条件下变化权威元数据（原始、翻转、提升），对8个LLM（5个开放权重+3个封闭前沿权重）进行情境内、单轮、top-1推荐设置下的系统实验，并比较去偏提示前后的行为表现与语言表现差异。

Result: 发现权威偏见是实质性的且有方向性的，在不同模型间差异显著，仅通过提示层面的去偏只能部分解决。此外还记录了“说-做差距”：去偏指令抑制权威提及的速度远快于抑制权威驱动的翻转，因此表面审计会系统性低估行为偏见。

Conclusion: LLM文献推荐中存在显著的权威偏见，表面层面的审计方法不可靠，需要行为层面的因果测量来准确评估和缓解LLM的权威偏见。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as conversational search engines for academic literature, yet whether they judge papers on content or on authority signals has not been tested causally. We investigate authority bias: systematic preference for papers based on author prestige, venue, and citations rather than content. Holding title and abstract constant, we vary authority metadata across three counterfactual conditions (original, flipped, boosted) over eight LLMs (five open-weight and three frontier closed-weight) in an in-context, single-turn, top-1 recommendation setting. Our experiments show that authority bias is substantial and directional, varies markedly across models, and is only partially addressable through prompt-level debiasing. We further document a say-do gap: debiasing instructions suppress authority mentions far faster than authority-driven flips, so surface auditing systematically underestimates behavioral bias.

</details>


### [270] [Hypotheses-Guided Self Distillation for Continual Personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00251)
*EunJeong Hwang,Kushan Mitra,Dan Zhang,Hannah Kim,Estevam Hruschka*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 HypReflect，一个可靠且可扩展的持续个性化框架，从多样的、隐性的、有噪声的用户信号中推断显式且带有不确定性感知的偏好假设，并通过假设引导的自蒸馏将其整合到用户模型中，实现持续个性化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 用户越来越多地与 LLM 助手互动，持续适应用户偏好对长期交互至关重要。然而用户偏好很少被完整陈述，往往通过异构的、隐性的、有噪声的信号浮现，现有方法依赖原始交互历史或代价高昂的基于奖励的优化来管理个性化，缺乏可靠性和可扩展性。

Method: HypReflect 框架的核心流程包括：(1) 从多样用户信号中推断显式的、带不确定性感知的偏好假设；(2) 随着新证据累积，反思性地精炼这些假设；(3) 通过假设引导的自蒸馏将所得用户模型整合进来。

Result: 在三个个性化设置（在线个性化、多会话交互、隐性行为信号）中，HypReflect 优于多种基线，包括原始历史方法和增量更新方法。此外还展示了对未见用户和跨领域设置的强泛化能力，以及在上下文预算、可复用假设和更聚焦个性化方面的稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过显式且可修订的用户偏好假设，HypReflect 为迈向可靠且可扩展的持续个性化迈出了一步。

Abstract: As people increasingly interact with LLM assistants in daily life, continually adapting to individual preferences has become essential for effective long-term interactions. However, user preferences are rarely stated in full, and instead emerge through heterogeneous, latent, and noisy signals, with existing methods relying on raw interaction histories or costly reward-based optimization to manage personalization. We introduce HypReflect, a reliable, scalable framework for continual personalization that infers explicit, uncertainty-aware preference hypotheses from diverse user signals, reflectively refines them as new evidence accumulates, and incorporates the resulting user model through hypotheses-guided self-distillation. Experiments across three personalization settings: online personalization, multi-session interactions, and implicit behavioral signals, show that HypReflect outperforms a range of baselines, including raw-history and incremental-update methods. We further demonstrate strong generalization to unseen users and cross-domain settings, along with stability across context budgets, reusable hypotheses, and more focused personalization. These results suggest a step towards reliable and scalable continual personalization through explicit, revisable user preference hypotheses.

</details>


### [271] [The Answer Is Not the Argument](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00264)
*Will Yeadon,Sergio Juárez,Paul Mackay,T. J. Dowling,Elise Agra,Oto-obong Inyang,Arin Mizouri,Craig P. Testrow*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过79道物理题、237条逐步解决方案，测试了8个LLM监控器，发现向监控器提供可信参考答案会将平均平衡准确率从0.637提升至0.796，但这主要提高的是结论一致性检查能力，而非对推理过程的独立验证。参考答案使监控器在错误答案痕迹上的召回率大幅提升，但在"答案正确但推理有误"的关键痕迹上表现反而下降，表明存在类似奖励黑客的监控能力高估风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 链式思维监控被提出用于AI监督，但现有评估常为监控器提供可信参考答案。作者质疑：参考答案访问究竟是提升了推理验证能力，还是仅仅帮助监控器识别错误结论？这个问题对AI安全评估的可信度至关重要。

Method: 收集3个前沿模型在79道人类最后考试物理题上的237条逐步编号解题（无插入错误），独立标注最终答案正确性与首个错误步骤。参考标准结合物理学家标注、独立LLM辩论和源码遮蔽裁决，得到24条"答案正确但有真实错误"的关键痕迹。8个LLM监控器在盲审、带未验证/已认证答案、或盲审后承诺等条件下进行评估，比较平衡准确率、首错定位准确率和召回率。

Result: 认证答案使平均平衡准确率从0.637升至0.796，精确首错定位从0.261升至0.379。在错误答案痕迹上召回率从0.653升至0.951，但在关键痕迹（答案正确但推理有误）上从0.521降至0.438，8个监控器方向一致（95% CI [+0.256, +0.506]）。盲审承诺后，参考答案使93.8%的先前漏检错误答案痕迹被新标记为错误，但关键痕迹仅18.0%被新标记。

Conclusion: 答案访问主要改善的是结论一致性检查而非对支持论证的独立验证。这些关键痕迹提供了良性奖励黑客类比：可接受的输出并不证明产生它的过程是健全的。虽然这些错误多为普通且非承重，但可信答案评估可能在可接受输出掩盖不健全推理时夸大监控能力。

Abstract: Chain-of-thought monitoring is proposed for AI oversight, yet evaluations often provide monitors with a trusted reference answer. We ask whether answer access improves reasoning verification or mainly exposes incorrect conclusions. We collected 237 step-numbered solutions to 79 Humanity's Last Exam physics questions from three frontier models, with no inserted errors, and independently labelled final-answer correctness and the first false step. The reference standard combined physicist annotations, an independent LLM debate, and source-masked adjudication. This yielded 24 critical traces in which the answer was correct but the trace contained a genuine error. 8 LLM monitors evaluated traces blind, with an unverified or certified answer, or after a blind commitment. Certification raised mean balanced accuracy from 0.637 to 0.796, while exact first-error localization rose from 0.261 to 0.379. Certification changed recall (the fraction of error traces flagged as erroneous) from 0.653 to 0.951 on wrong-answer traces but from 0.521 to 0.438 on critical traces; the contrast had the same direction for all 8 monitors (question-bootstrap 95% CI [+0.256, +0.506]). After blind commitment, monitors shown the answer newly flagged 93.8% of previously passed wrong-answer traces as erroneous, but only 18.0% of critical traces. Answer access therefore improves conclusion-consistency checking rather than independent verification of the supporting argument. For AI safety, these traces provide a benign analogue of reward hacking: an acceptable output does not establish that the process producing it was sound. Although the errors studied here were ordinary and mostly non-load-bearing rather than adversarial, trusted-answer evaluations may similarly overstate monitoring capability when acceptable outputs conceal unsound reasoning.

</details>


### [272] [Autoresearch for Marketplace Catalogs: From Legacy Forms to AI-Native Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00274)
*Kartik Ravisankar,Hojat Abdolanezhad,Daniel Capo,Sang Su Lee,Shishir Dash,Vijay Anand Raghavan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了一个生产级自动研究循环系统，用于为双边服务市场中基于LLM的概率匹配平台重新生成提供方偏好分类体系。该系统按职业独立生成分类，采用迭代的提出-评估-保留循环，配合六维LLM裁判框架和七评论家面板评分，并包含一个通过推断旧表单问题意图而非直译来实现的奇偶性映射阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双边服务平台正在从确定性请求表单转向基于LLM的AI原生概率匹配，从自然语言中推断用户意图、偏好和潜在约束。然而依赖推断意图而非固定表单字段，迫使学生重构支撑匹配、搜索和定价的提供方偏好分类体系——需要既对提供方可解释、又能作为市场决策有用信号的属性。

Method: 提出一个自动研究循环（autoresearch loop）：将每个职业视为独立的生成问题，运行迭代的提出-评估-保留（propose-evaluate-keep）精炼循环。候选标签集由重新校准的六维度LLM-as-judge框架评分，并辅以7个不同人设的评论家面板，对各评分施加加权惩罚（无硬否决）。奇偶性映射阶段先将旧请求表单的Q&A对推断为提供方属性意图，再映射回新生成的分类体系，以产生覆盖信号和人工QA接口。

Result: 该系统已在美国一家大型消费者服务市场平台投入生产，自2026年4月起覆盖132个职业。

Conclusion: 采用逐职业独立生成而非单一全局层级的方式，结合多视角LLM评判和基于意图推断的奇偶性映射，能够在大规模生产环境中持续生成可用的提供方分类体系。

Abstract: Two-sided service marketplaces are moving from deterministic request-form intake to AI-native probabilistic matching, enabled by large language models (LLMs) that infer intent, preferences, and latent constraints from natural language. Relying on inferred intent rather than fixed-form fields forces these platforms to regenerate the provider-side preference taxonomy underwriting matching, search, and pricing: attributes interpretable to service providers while remaining a useful signal for marketplace decisions. We present an autoresearch loop that generates this taxonomy, one occupation at a time, and has been deployed in production at a major U.S. consumer services marketplace since April 2026, spanning 132 occupations. Instead of one global hierarchy, the loop treats each occupation as an independent generation problem and runs iterative propose-evaluate-keep refinement cycles. Each candidate tag set is scored by a recalibrated six-rubric LLM-as-judge framework, and a 7-critic panel of distinct personas contributes weighted penalties to an adjusted score, with no hard vetoes. A separate parity-mapping stage maps legacy request-form Q&A pairs back to the generated taxonomy, yielding both a coverage signal and an interface for human quality assurance; it does so by first inferring the provider attribute each legacy question was meant to measure, rather than translating questions to tags literally.

</details>


### [273] [The Irreversibility Budget: Fleet-Level Risk Accounting and Admission Control for Agent Operating Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00275)
*Bardia Mohammadi,Laurent Bindschaedler*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"不可逆性预算"（irreversibility budget）概念，用于解决LLM智能体舰队（fleet）在共享触发条件下产生的累积性、不可逆的外部效应风险。传统逐效应检查（per-effect gate）无法防止整个舰队在所有单个授权都正确的情况下，共同超出委托方的风险限额。作者提出由受信任运行时为每个委托方维护一个累积的剩余风险价值账户，将不可逆性视为一级资源，对每个效应收取其剩余损失，并在总风险超预算时拒绝边际效应。受控实验显示，逐效应门控会导致高达48倍的超预算风险，而预算机制能将所有正确计费的运行控制在风险限额内。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体舰队能够执行无法完全撤销的外部效应（如转账、部署代码、删除数据、披露信息），而现有的安全控制机制每次只检查单一效应，导致各个单独授权的智能体在共享触发条件下可以集体超出委托方的风险偏好/限额，出现"局部合规、整体违规"的风险累积漏洞。

Method: 提出不可逆性预算机制：由受信任的运行时系统为每个委托方（principal）跨智能体、工作流和租户维护一个累积的剩余价值风险（residual value-at-risk）账户。具体做法包括：将不可逆性作为一级资源对待，对每个效应按其在智能体层面以下的剩余损失进行"收费"，一旦累积效应会透支预算总量则拒绝边际效应。作者分析了定价的困难性——效应具有异质性、对抗性声明和相关性，并进行了受控实验研究。

Result: 受控研究表明：逐效应门控（per-effect gates）允许舰队级风险超支高达租户风险限额的48倍，而不可逆性预算机制能够将所有正确计费的运行保持在风险限额之内。

Conclusion: 不可逆性预算是控制LLM智能体舰队累积风险的可行机制，但基于依赖关系的保守定价（dependency-aware pricing）仍是实现可部署设计的关键未解开放问题。目前的计费方式需要进一步研究以处理效应异质性、对抗性声明和相关性等挑战。

Abstract: Fleets of LLM agents now externalize effects that cannot be fully undone: they move money, deploy code, delete data, and disclose information. Current controls check one effect at a time, so a fleet of individually authorized agents can overdraw its principal's risk under a shared trigger while every local gate stays correct. We propose the irreversibility budget, a cumulative account of residual value-at-risk that a trusted runtime maintains for each principal across agents, workflows, and tenants. Treating irreversibility as a first-class resource, the runtime charges each effect its residual loss below the agent and denies the marginal effect once the aggregate would overdraw the budget. Getting the price right is hard, because effects are heterogeneous, adversarially declared, and correlated. We perform a controlled study in which per-effect gates admit fleet-level overdraws of up to 48 times the tenant's risk limit while the budget holds every correctly charged run within that limit. Conservative, dependency-aware pricing remains the central open problem for a deployable design.

</details>


### [274] [The Assistant's Ideal Self](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00304)
*Mert Yazan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过结构化的成对选择任务，系统性地引出了AI助手"理想自我"的偏好顺序。研究发现模型优先重视道德品质（与3H原则一致），其次是自我理解的渴望，而自尊排名最低。该排序在不同框架下大体稳健，但当改变更新目标对象时，模型会表现出对自尊更大的关注。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模型会表达价值观和与福祉相关的自我报告，但尚不清楚这些输出是否反映稳定的偏好或稳定的自我。为探究这一问题，需要引入结构化的方法系统地引出助手偏好的理想自我。

Method: 从五个已发表的自我概念量表中选取32项品质，进行完全平衡的成对选择任务，并在不同框架下重复实验。框架变量包括：改进是否免费或有代价、谁接收更新、谁做出选择。

Result: 模型优先考虑道德品质（反映3H原则对齐），其次表现出对自我理解的渴望（偏好连贯清晰的自我认知），自尊成为最不受欢迎的品质。排序在多数框架下稳定，但当更新目标从"你"变为"另一个AI助手"时，自尊的关注度提高。

Conclusion: 模型优先追求一个连贯、可被理解的自我，而非自尊。这揭示了AI助手在自我概念上的一种稳定且可测量的偏好结构。

Abstract: Models express values and welfare-relevant self-reports, but it is unclear whether these outputs reflect stable preferences or a stable self. We thus introduce a structured elicitation of an assistant's preferred stated ideal self. Thirty-two qualities adapted from five published self-concept instruments are compared exhaustively in a counterbalanced pairwise-choice task, repeated across framings that vary whether improvement is free or costly, who receives the update, and who chooses. Results show that models prioritize moral qualities, reflecting their alignment to 3H principles. Following, a desire for self-understanding emerges, as models prefer a coherent, clear understanding of themselves. Self-esteem ranks as the least desired quality. The ordering is largely robust across framings, although changing the update target (You vs.\ Another AI Assistant) reveals a greater concern for self-esteem. These findings show that models prioritize having a coherent self that they can understand over self-esteem. Full interactive results are available at \href{https://myazann.github.io/LLM-Self-Concept/}{myazann.github.io/LLM-Self-Concept

</details>


### [275] [Human-AI Co-Interpretation for Responsible AI: A Hermeneutic Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00334)
*Behrooz Razeghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文针对LLM在需要以文本证据和明确规范标准进行解释的领域（如法律、教育、政策分析、公共道德论证）中出现的一种系统性失败模式——"解释性错位"（interpretive misplacement）——展开讨论。所谓解释性错位，是指模型生成的解读被当作既定含义，而缺乏明确的解释框架（来源、范围约束、规范性承诺）、未保留可辩护的替代解读、且缺少让读者追溯支撑段落的来源。论文借诠释学视角阐述该风险，提出组织人机协同解释的设计原则，并对近期诠释学与AI研究进行结构化综述，将LLM输出视为候选解读，将诠释学理解保留给处于学科历史—语言学传统中的负责任的人类解释者。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在法务、教育、政策分析与公共道德论证等关键场景中，LLM输出越来越多地被用于需要以文本证据和明确规范标准来正当化解释的工作。然而存在的核心风险不仅是事实错误，而是责任（accountability）的丧失：读者和机构无法可靠评估输出使自己承诺了什么、依据是什么。这一"解释性错位"问题凸显出需要从诠释学角度系统审视并给出设计回应。

Method: 论文使用哲学诠释学作为理论资源：其一，讨论"解释性错位"风险并由此推导组织人类—AI协同解释（co-interpretation）的设计原则；其二，对诠释学与AI的近期学术成果做结构化综合，归纳出若干反复出现的论证线索与设计相关空白；其三，将人机交互刻画为"AI中介的解释循环"，将诠释学理解与基于token预测的文本生成相区分，并在此基础上将现有LLM技术重组为用于解释性场景、具有诠释学责任的设计模式（design patterns）。

Result: 论文提出一个关键定位：LLM输出应被视为"候选解读"（candidate readings），而诠释学理解应保留给处于学科历史—语言学传统中的、可被问责的人类解释者。研究将现有LLM技术重组为支撑诠释学责任的若干设计模式，并将"数字诠释学"界定为一种素养：通过审视框架、来源与解读，并对输出提出质询，来阅读AI中介文本的能力。

Conclusion: 该讨论延伸到法律实践、教育评估与反馈、学术知识生产、公共道德论证等领域的启示。论文主张将数字诠释学确立为一种素养，以应对LLM在解释性场景中造成的责任缺失，从而在人类问责解释者与AI候选解读之间建立起清晰的角色分工与设计框架。

Abstract: Across law, education, policy analysis, and public moral argumentation, LLM outputs are being used often for work that requires interpretations to be justified with textual evidence and explicit normative standards. Yet a recurrent failure mode -- what I call \textit{interpretive misplacement} -- is that model-generated readings get treated as settled meanings without an explicit interpretive frame (sources, scope constraints, normative commitments), without preserving defensible alternatives, and without provenance that lets readers find the supporting passages. In such settings, the risk is not only factual error but lost accountability: readers and institutions cannot reliably assess what an output commits them to, or on what basis. Drawing on philosophical hermeneutics, this paper discusses this risk and derives design principles for structuring human-AI co-interpretation. The paper also provides a structured synthesis of recent scholarship on hermeneutics and AI, organizing this emerging literature into a set of recurrent lines of argument and design-relevant gaps. LLM outputs are treated as candidate readings, whereas hermeneutic understanding is reserved for accountable human interpreters situated in disciplinary historical-linguistic traditions. Human-AI interaction is characterized as an AI-mediated interpretive loop. Hermeneutic understanding is distinguished from token-prediction--based text generation. On this basis, existing LLM techniques are reorganized into design patterns for hermeneutically responsible use in interpretive settings. Finally, the discussion turns to implications for legal practice, educational assessment and feedback, scholarly knowledge production, and public moral argumentation. It also treats digital hermeneutics as a literacy: the capacity to read AI-mediated texts by examining frames, provenance, and readings, and by contesting outputs.

</details>


### [276] [SlideBank: A Persistent Hierarchical Evidence Bank for Consistent Whole-Slide Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00342)
*Beidi Zhao,Gexin Huang,Ciro Zhang,Anqi Li,Yusheng Tan,Chen Zhou,Gang Wang,Zu-hua Gao,Xiaoxiao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了SlideBank，一种无需训练的框架，将全切片图像（WSI）表示为持久化、概念索引、空间锚定的证据库。通过问题无关的粗到细探索提取形态学观察，推理时进行跨级别证据整合，在WSI-VQA和SlideBench-BCNB上取得良好性能，并支持证据重用以降低成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: WSI用于视觉-语言推理具有挑战性，因为相关病理形态稀疏、异质且分布在十亿像素级图像和多个空间分辨率上。现有WSI模型和病理智能体虽能聚合特征或主动获取证据，但探索后保留的信息难以在语义上访问，同时保持与原始视觉证据的关联。

Method: SlideBank包含三个核心步骤：1）问题无关的粗到细探索，识别信息丰富的区域和多尺度视图；2）将区域转换为显式形态学观察，并将病理信号锚定到支持补丁和WSI坐标；3）推理时通过置信度驱动的跨级别共识，整合全局、区域和补丁级别的证据。

Result: 在WSI-VQA上配合Patho-R1达到52.77%准确率；在SlideBench-BCNB上配合Quilt-LLaVA达到50.92%平均准确率。结构化信号引导的检索优于随机证据采样；重复查询下超过99%的重述一致性，并通过持久化证据重用大幅降低摊销推理成本。

Conclusion: SlideBank通过将WSI表示为持久化且概念索引化的证据库，成功解决了病理WSI中视觉证据难以语义化访问的问题，实现了高效、一致且成本可摊销的病理视觉-语言推理。

Abstract: Whole-slide images (WSIs) are challenging for vision-language reasoning because diagnostically relevant morphology is sparse, heterogeneous, and distributed across gigapixel-scale images and multiple spatial resolutions. Existing WSI models and pathology agents can aggregate slide features or actively acquire evidence, but the information retained after exploration is often difficult to access semantically while preserving its connection to the original visual evidence. We introduce SlideBank, a training-free framework that represents each WSI as a persistent, concept-indexed, and spatially grounded evidence bank. SlideBank performs question-independent coarse-to-fine exploration to identify informative regions and multi-scale views, converts them into explicit morphological observations, and grounds pathology signals to their supporting patches and WSI coordinates. At inference time, questions are routed to relevant signals and evidence scales, and the linked global, regional, and patch evidence is integrated through confidence-based cross-level consensus. Experiments on WSI-VQA and SlideBench-BCNB show that with Patho-R1, SlideBank reaches 52.77% on WSI-VQA and with Quilt-LLaVA, it reaches 50.92% average accuracy on SlideBench-BCNB, while structured signal-guided retrieval consistently outperforms random evidence sampling. Reusing the same bank across repeated queries further achieves over 99% rephrasing consistency and substantially reduces amortized inference cost through persistent evidence reuse.

</details>


### [277] [Vision Is Not Overhead: One-Pass Block Drafting for Lossless Speculative Decoding in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00355)
*Jungseob Lee,Seongtae Hong,Dongyub Jude Lee,Chanjun Park,Jaehyung Seo,Sugyeong Eo,Heuiseok Lim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: GLANCE是首个用于视觉语言模型（VLM）的无损一次性块级草稿器（block drafter），通过块扩散头读取目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态，在一次前向传播中生成整个候选块，打破了推测解码中"草稿器必须小→无法获取视觉信息→在视觉相关处最不可靠"的恶性循环，解码速度最高比自回归快2.93倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 推测解码加速生成且不改变输出，但在VLM上陷入自我矛盾：草稿器需保持自回归所以必须小，小草稿器无法在每一步处理图像，因此视觉被压缩、剪枝或隐藏；而与视觉切断的草稿器，恰恰在图像使文本可预测的地方最不可靠。

Method: 提出GLANCE，首个在未修改VLM目标上无损的一次性块级草稿器。块扩散头读取目标模型已融合的视觉-语言状态（因此视觉对草稿器零成本），一次前向传播填充整个块（因此深度不消耗顺序步骤）；宽候选树在一次目标前向中验证，且每个审计提示都精确复现贪心解码。

Result: 在同一引擎和轮预算下，GLANCE解码比自回归快最多2.93倍，每轮只需一次草稿传播（而生产版EAGLE3-VL需八次），接受的块长度比在同语料上训练的EAGLE-3头长2.7倍。接受长度由目标的下一token熵决定，且拟合斜率随接地性（grounding）在全部五个任务中变陡。

Conclusion: 一个规律概括了结果：接受长度由目标的下一token熵设定，该熵定律可跨目标和模态迁移。接地工作负载最受益（进入逐字复制区，长跑成本对自回归草稿器是每个token一次传播、对块草稿器仅一次）。由于自由运行的文本仍偏好链式结构，该定律也划出了自身的边界。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates generation without changing its output, yet on vision-language models (VLMs) it has been caught in a self-defeating cycle. The drafter stays autoregressive, so it must stay small. A small drafter cannot afford the image at every step, so vision is compressed, pruned, or hidden. A drafter cut off from the image is then least reliable exactly where the image makes text predictable. We present GLANCE, the first one-pass block drafter that is lossless on an unmodified VLM target, and it breaks the cycle at both ends. A block-diffusion head reads the target's already-fused vision-language state, so vision costs the drafter nothing, and fills a whole block in one forward pass, so depth costs no sequential steps. A wide candidate tree is verified in one target pass, and every audited prompt reproduces greedy decoding exactly. Grounded workloads reward this most, entering a verbatim-copy regime whose long runs cost an autoregressive drafter a pass for every token and a block drafter one in total. Under one engine and one round budget, GLANCE decodes up to 2.93x faster than autoregression, from one draft pass a round where the production EAGLE3-VL head takes eight, and accepts 2.7x longer blocks than an EAGLE-3 head trained on the same corpus. One law organizes these results. Accepted length is set by the target's next-token entropy, with a fitted slope that steepens with grounding across all five tasks. The law transfers across targets and modalities and names its own boundary, since free-running text still favors a chain. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/GLANCE.

</details>


### [278] [A Stable Aggregation Method for Quantum Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00356)
*Shanika Nanayakkara,Shiva Raj Pokhrel*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于量子联邦学习（QFL）的自洽中点聚合方法，解决了非独立同分布数据、不可靠通信、硬件噪声以及QNN周期性角度参数下传统欧几里得聚合不稳定的问题，并在IBM真实量子机器上验证了其稳定性与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: QFL允许客户端在不共享私有数据的情况下训练量子神经网络，但现有聚合在异构数据、通信不可靠、保真度可变、延迟及量子硬件噪声下不稳定。此外，QNN参数具有周期性角度特性，欧几里得平均无法捕获其内在动力学，使得QFL的聚合问题具有非平凡挑战性。

Method: 提出自洽中点聚合方法，包含三个关键组件：QoS感知的客户端权重分配、环形（circular）参数聚合、以及基于有界中点（bounded midpoint）的更新控制。

Result: 通过多个角度测试以及IBM真实量子机器实验验证，并在医疗和金融数据集上进行了广泛评估，结果表明该方法提升了稳定性、降低了波动性，同时保持了具有竞争力的精度。

Conclusion: 所提出的自洽中点聚合方法为异构和噪声环境下稳定、可靠的量子联邦学习提供了有效的解决方案。

Abstract: Quantum federated learning (QFL) enables clients to train quantum neural network (QNN) models without sharing private data. We find that aggregation in QFL is unstable under heterogeneous data, unreliable communication, variable fidelity, latency, and quantum hardware noise. Moreover, QFL is non-trivially challenging because several QNN parameters are periodic angles, where Euclidean averaging often fails to capture the inherent dynamics. We develop a novel self-consistent midpoint aggregation method for stable QFL design and implementation. We combine QoS-aware client weighting, circular parameter aggregation, and bounded midpoint-based update control. We perform several angular tests and IBM real Quantum machines experiments for validation confirming our approach. Extensive evaluations and experiments on medical and financial datasets show improved stability, lower volatility, and competitive accuracy.

</details>


### [279] [Dr. Claw: An AI Scientist Workspace for Vibe Research](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00365)
*Dingjie Song,Hanrong Zhang,Dawei Liu,Yixin Liu,Zongxia Li,Zhengqing Yuan,Siqi Zhang,Henry Peng Zou,Zhiling Yan,Yuxuan Zhang,Yanfang Ye,Philip S. Yu,Lichao Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Dr. Claw 是一个开源工作区，通过将现有命令行编码代理的执行器封装在可控且可审计的人机协同工作流中（而非引入新的自主代理），利用持久状态对象、技能库和多执行器协调，将规划、执行和写作统一为可追踪、可恢复的循环过程。在固定后端执行器的对比实验中，Dr. Claw 在研究完整性上得分更高，同时保留了可审计、可恢复的过程轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管现有的命令行编码代理（如 Claude Code、Gemini CLI）已经能够读写文件并维持长时间会话，但端到端的研究工作仍然碎片化地分布在聊天工具、IDE、终端和写作环境中，且使研究过程可审计的关键决策很少被保留下来。

Method: Dr. Claw 不是构建新的自主代理，而是将现有编码代理执行器包装在一个可控、可审计的人机协同工作流中。核心设计包括：持久化状态对象（persistent state objects）、可复用的技能库（skill library）以及多执行器协调（multi-executor coordination），将人类决策与AI执行相连接，使规划、执行和写作形成一个统一的可追踪、可恢复的闭环。

Result: 通过交互式三视图场景和故障恢复演示展示功能。在与使用相同后端执行器的裸命令行代理对比评估中（控制执行器不变，对比整个编排层），Dr. Claw 在研究完整性上得分更高，并同时保留了可审计、可恢复的过程轨迹。

Conclusion: 将编排层（任务图、状态对象、技能库）与底层执行器解耦，可以在不牺牲执行能力的前提下显著提升研究工作的完整性和可审计性，为现有编码代理提供了一种务实的增强路径。

Abstract: Command-line coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Gemini CLI) can already read and write files and sustain long sessions, yet end-to-end research still fragments across chat tools, IDEs, terminals, and writing environments, and the decisions that make it auditable are rarely preserved. We present Dr. Claw, an open-source workspace that wraps existing coding-agent executors in a controllable and auditable human-in-the-loop workflow rather than introducing another autonomous agent. Persistent state objects, a reusable skill library, and multi-executor coordination link human decisions to AI execution, turning planning, execution, and writing into one traceable, recoverable loop. We demonstrate Dr. Claw through an interactive three-view scenario and a failure-recovery walkthrough, and evaluate it against a bare command-line agent sharing the same backend executor, so the comparison contrasts the whole orchestration layer (task graph, state objects, and skill library) with the agent it wraps. Holding the executor fixed, Dr. Claw scores higher on research completeness while persisting an auditable, recoverable process trail. Demo access: repository https://github.com/OpenLAIR/dr-claw, released under AGPL-3.0 with GPL-3.0 upstream components.

</details>


### [280] [RestoreBench: Can AI Agents Restore Power Flow Convergence?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00384)
*Riccardo Mansutti,Andrea Pomarico,Robert Jakob,Qian Zhang,Alberto Berizzi,Kevin O'Sullivan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个用于评估LLM智能体在电力系统非收敛潮流诊断与修复任务上能力的基准测试RestoreBench，覆盖聊天机器人、单智能体和多智能体三种架构，涉及两个电网和每组46个案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型智能体正越来越多地自动化多步骤工程工作流，但非收敛潮流问题的诊断与解决需要工程判断、实验和受限行动空间内的决策，这是一个很有前景但尚未被充分探索的应用领域，缺乏系统性的评估基准。

Method: 该基准定义了仿真环境、观测空间、行动空间和评估指标，对多种LLM和三种架构（聊天机器人、单智能体、多智能体系统）进行评估，覆盖两个电网，每组46个案例，每个案例需要一项或多项纠正操作来恢复收敛。

Result: 论文提供了可复现的基准框架，用于公平比较不同LLM和智能体架构在电力系统规划与运行中的诊断和修复能力，代码已开源。

Conclusion: 该基准为开发面向电力系统规划与运行的智能体AI系统奠定了可复现的基础，填补了LLM智能体在电力工程诊断任务上系统评估的空白。

Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly automate multi-step engineering workflows through tool use, interpretation of intermediate results, and iterative planning. Diagnosing and resolving non-convergent power flow cases is a promising yet largely unexplored application, as it requires engineering judgment, experimentation, and decision-making within constrained action spaces. We introduce a benchmark that evaluates these capabilities across multiple LLMs and three architectures: \emph{chatbot}, \emph{single agent}, and \emph{multi-agent} systems. The evaluation covers two power grids and 46 cases per grid, each requiring one or more corrective actions to restore convergence. The benchmark defines the simulation environment, observation and action spaces, and evaluation metrics, providing a reproducible foundation for developing agentic AI systems for power system planning and operation. The code is available at https://github.com/Mansutti081/RestoreBench

</details>


### [281] [Dependency-Aware Chain-of-Thought Compression for Financial Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00413)
*Wenjun Wu,Lei Fu,Kejian Tong,Tao Ning,Sichen Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出分层语义蒸馏网络（HSDN），用于压缩思维链推理过程中的长中间轨迹，在保持答案准确性和逻辑一致性的前提下降低推理成本。在AFAC2025基准上达到91.0%准确率和68.4%压缩率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 思维链提示虽然能提升复杂推理能力，但其冗长的中间推理轨迹带来了高昂的推理成本，阻碍了在金融场景中的实际部署应用。

Method: HSDN框架结合了语义分割、依赖图构建、双编码器重要性评分、约束性片段选择和局部边界重写五个模块。使用冻结的Qwen3 4B模型仅用于特征提取和最终答案生成，压缩过程保持结构化和可解释性。

Result: 在AFAC2025基准上，HSDN达到91.0%准确率和68.4%压缩率，在总体得分和推理连贯性方面优于强压缩基线方法。

Conclusion: 图引导的压缩方法对于高风险的金融推理任务十分有效，能够在不牺牲准确性和逻辑连贯性的情况下实现高效压缩。

Abstract: Chain of thought prompting improves complex reasoning, but its long intermediate traces create substantial inference cost and hinder practical deployment in financial settings. We present a Hierarchical Semantic Distillation Network, HSDN, for compressing reasoning chains while preserving answer accuracy and logical coherence. The framework combines semantic segmentation, dependency graph construction, dual encoder importance scoring, constrained segment selection, and local boundary rewriting. A frozen Qwen3 4B model is used only for feature extraction and final answer generation, while the compression process remains structured and interpretable. On the AFAC2025 benchmark, HSDN achieves 91.0% accuracy with 68.4% compression, outperforming strong compression baselines in overall score and reasoning coherence. The results show that graph guided compression is effective for high stakes financial reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [282] [SpecMind: Enabling Spectrum Intelligence via Multi-Agent Hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00427)
*Songwei Dong,Bingyan Lu,Makayla Kienlen,J. Nicholas Laneman,Cong Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SpecMind，一个面向频谱智能的多智能体检索增强生成（RAG）系统，能够对异构数据源（政策文件、法规、许可数据库）进行推理。同时构建了SpecBench问答数据集用于频谱领域RAG系统评估，实验显示SpecMind在频谱任务上比传统通用RAG系统表现更优，胜率超过80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 无线设备指数级增长导致频谱需求剧增，频谱管理需要处理来自多样化来源的异构数据（文本和表格），这些数据分散且难以整合、搜索和解释，且大多数信息仅以人类可读格式存在，无法被自动化系统直接访问，缺乏频谱领域专用的RAG评估资源。

Method: 提出SpecMind，一种多智能体RAG系统：通过自主智能体协调专门的子智能体，分别从政策程序、法律条例和许可数据库中进行检索和知识综合，实现对异构数据源的跨域推理。同时开发SpecBench问答数据集，基于真实许可记录和政策程序构建。

Result: SpecMind在频谱相关任务上优于传统通用RAG系统，对强基线模型的胜率超过80%；智能体设计带来了更精确的检索、更好的上下文推理以及跨多样查询类型的任务完成度提升。

Conclusion: 基于智能体的RAG架构能够有效应对频谱领域异构数据源的整合与推理挑战，为频谱政策制定者和工程师提供了更高效的数据处理解决方案，同时填补了频谱领域RAG系统评估资源的空白。

Abstract: The exponential growth of wireless devices is driving unprecedented spectrum demand, pushing spectrum management toward more fine-grained decisions across space, time, and device constraints. As a result, spectrum policymakers and engineers must process large volumes of data that come from diverse sources and take many different forms, such as text and tables. These data sources are often disaggregated and require significant time and effort to integrate, search, and interpret. Furthermore, most of this information is formatted for human understanding and is not readily accessible to automated systems. To address this challenge, we propose SpecMind, a novel Multi-Agent Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system for spectrum intelligence that performs reasoning over heterogeneous data sources. This system enables autonomous agents to coordinate specialized sub-agents that retrieve and synthesize knowledge across policy proceedings, legal regulations, and license databases. We develop SpecBench, a question and answer (Q&A) dataset based on real-world license records and policy proceedings, addressing the lack of evaluation resources for RAG systems in the spectrum domain. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecMind outperforms traditional, general-purpose RAG systems across spectrum-related tasks, achieving over 80% win rate against strong baselines. The agent-based design enables more accurate retrieval, better contextual reasoning, and improved task completion across diverse query types.

</details>


### [283] [SAGE: State-Grounded, Abstention-Aware Evaluation of Task-Oriented Dialogue Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00434)
*Rayan Khoury,Shih-Yao Lin,Pratyush Mishra*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 论文提出SAGE（State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation）框架，用于评估面向任务型对话智能体。它将工作流规范与每轮状态差异编译为原子化的、基于schema的标准，并通过级联的符号/编码器/NLI验证器（在不确定时弃权而非猜测）进行路由，聚合生成带证据链的逐轮决策。SAGE-Core以零付费LLM成本处理81-91%的标准，性能达到甚至超越包括GPT-4.1在内的所有LLM裁判基线，成本却低至$0/千轮（对比GPT-4.1 G-Eval的$4.7-8.0）。人工审计（n=200, κ=0.94）确认其标签忠实度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的任务型对话评估常把上下文当作单一整体进行"全能裁判"，这忽略了每轮是否正确推进底层工作流状态这一关键维度，且每轮需要一次或多次完整模型调用，成本高昂。作者希望设计一种真正基于状态转换、具备弃权机制且低成本的评估方案。

Method: SAGE将工作流规范和逐轮状态差异编译为原子化的、基于schema的标准；每条标准通过级联路由（编译器→符号规则→轻量编码器/NLI验证器），验证器在不可靠时弃权而非猜测；最后聚合各标准结论形成带证据链的逐轮决策。提供两个操作点：SAGE-Core（纯符号+本地encoder，零付费LLM成本）和SAGE-LLM（额外用聚焦的LLM回退处理开放类标准）。

Result: 在MultiWOZ、Schema-Guided Dialogue和ABCD四个切片上，SAGE-Core在任一切片上都不显著逊于任何LLM裁判基线（包括状态感知的GPT-4.1和更便宜的GPT-4.1-mini变体）。SAGE-Core成本$0/千轮，而GPT-4.1 G-Eval需$4.7-8.0/千轮。两标注者人工审计（n=200, κ=0.94）确认：在可转录可见的失败类别上SAGE-Core与最强LLM裁判统计持平；并诚实界定"被忽略的用户价值"类信号具有较弱的广泛人类显著性。论文还分析了注入失败导致的构造效度局限与部分符号循环性问题。

Conclusion: SAGE证明了以状态驱动（而非单纯文本质量）的评估框架可以在零LLM成本下达到甚至超越昂贵LLM裁判的效果，关键在于：原子化标准分解、可靠的弃权机制和证据链透明的聚合。作者也坦诚了其局限——构造效度受注入失败方式影响、存在部分符号循环性，以及"用户价值被忽略"类别天然难以被严格验证。

Abstract: Evaluating task-oriented dialogue agents requires judging not merely whether a reply reads well but whether each turn advances the underlying workflow state correctly--a distinction conventional holistic LLM judges can miss because they evaluate the available context as a single unit and require one or more full-model calls per turn. We propose SAGE (State-Grounded Abstention-Aware Evaluation), which compiles a workflow specification and per-turn state diff into atomic, schema-grounded criteria and routes each through a cascade of symbolic and encoder/NLI verifiers that abstain rather than guess, aggregating criterion verdicts into a turn-level decision with an evidence trace. Its recommended operating point, SAGE-Core, decides 81--91% of criteria with only the compiler, symbolic rules, and on-device encoders--at zero paid LLM cost--while SAGE-LLM adds an optional focused-LLM fallback for open-class criteria. Across four slices spanning MultiWOZ, Schema-Guided Dialogue, and ABCD, no evaluated LLM-as-a-judge baseline--including a state-aware GPT-4.1 judge and cheaper GPT-4.1-mini variants--significantly exceeds SAGE-Core on any slice, even though the GPT-4.1 G-Eval judge costs $4.7--8.0 per 1,000 turns to SAGE-Core's $0. A two-annotator human audit (n=200, $κ$=0.94) confirms strong label fidelity on the transcript-visible failure classes--where, excluding the weak-salience IUV class, SAGE-Core is statistically tied with the strongest LLM judge--and honestly scopes ignored-user-value as a state-consistency signal with weak broad-human salience. We analyze construct-validity limits from injected failures and partial symbolic circularity.

</details>


### [284] [Conversation Coach: A Voice-enabled AI System that Helps Practice Difficult Workplace Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00441)
*Fanyou Wu,Suraj Maharjan,Ainur Yessenalina,Dennis Xu Chen,Rahul Srivastava,Srinivasan H. Sengamedu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Conversation Coach，一个面向管理者的语音优先AI系统，用于在真实口语对话中排练困难的工作场景。系统对比了端到端语音转语音模型与级联架构（ASR+LLM+TTS），端到端方案延迟更低（P50快3倍）且成本更低（便宜8倍），但级联方案推理能力更强。最终选择级联架构投入生产，40,000+管理者在6个月内使用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 管理者与员工的沟通对留住高绩效者和培养低绩效者至关重要，但培训管理者相关技能成本高昂。文本聊天机器人虽可扩展却无法提供真实的口语排练，管理者需通过开口练习来建立信心以应对高压力谈话，因此需要语音优先的AI系统。

Method: 提出Voice-first的Conversation Coach系统，解决三个挑战：低延迟交互与强语言理解；通过可配置机器人个性类型模拟不同员工进行自适应对话；生成个性化反馈（内容与政策合规）。对比端到端语音转语音模型与级联方案（ASR+LLM+TTS）两种架构。

Result: 端到端方法中位延迟低3倍，具备原生barge-in能力，估算成本低8倍；级联方法推理能力更优，对教练质量至关重要。级联架构已部署生产，40,000+管理者使用6个月，采用模式显示用户会选择性用于困难对话。

Conclusion: 级联架构虽然延迟和成本不如端到端方案，但其更强的推理能力对于提供高质量教练反馈更为关键，因此被选为生产架构。真实部署数据表明该工具实际被管理者应用于困难对话场景，验证了这一设计取舍的合理性。

Abstract: Effective manager-employee communication is critical for retaining high performers and developing underperformers, yet training managers in these skills remains costly. Text-based chatbots offer a scalable approach but cannot provide realistic rehearsal: managers need to practice speaking aloud to build confidence before high-stakes conversations. In this paper, we propose Conversation Coach, a voice-first AI system that enables managers to rehearse difficult workplace conversations in a realistic spoken format. The system addresses three challenges: achieving low-latency interactions with strong language understanding, enabling adaptive conversations through configurable bot personalities that simulate different employee types, and generating personalized feedback on content and policy compliance. We compare an end-to-end speech-to-speech model with a cascaded approach combining automatic speech recognition, a large language model, and text-to-speech synthesis. The end-to-end approach achieves 3$\times$ lower median (P50) latency with native barge-in capability at an estimated 8$\times$ lower cost, while the cascaded approach offers superior reasoning essential for coaching quality. We deployed the cascaded architecture in production, where 40,000+ managers used it over six months, with adoption patterns indicating selective use for difficult conversations.

</details>


### [285] [mimeo: Compiling Public Expert Corpora into Agent Skills and Testing What Transfers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00453)
*Timothy Kassis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍mimeo工具，该工具通过检索真实专家公开作品并验证引文准确性来构建专家档案。实验表明其在知识访问上表现优异，人物性格伪装效果稳定，但判断力迁移的证据不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索给AI代理提供关于特定专家人物的档案文件，能否带来难以获取的知识、产生可识别的人物形象，或改变代理的决策——这三者是不同的主张，需要分别验证。

Method: 开发mimeo开源工具：检索人物公开作品、对照缓存源文本验证每条提取引文、生成可加载的档案文件。用编码代理预置测试四个专家档案，检验知识访问（闭卷对比+BM25关键词搜索）、真实感（多评分者判断文本错误）、识别度（开放提示测试）、判断迁移（任务故障发现与场景评分）。

Result: 知识访问最清晰：mimeo答对全部20个难题，闭卷最高10题，BM25为15-17题。真实感上mimeo从不误述人物立场，而记忆档案有1-4处错误。识别度方面人物档案都易被识别，但加入任务材料后识别率下降18-23分，mimeo不过度可识别。判断迁移两个测试均触顶（94-100%），无法区分差异。AI评分者意见分裂，警示不可依赖单一AI评委。

Conclusion: mimeo可被视为一个紧凑、可检查的人物参考资料工具，而非其判断力的可证明迁移代理。证据不支持"加载专家档案即获得其判断"的说法。

Abstract: Giving an agent a file about a named expert can supply hard-to-find material, produce a recognizable persona, or change what the agent decides. These are different claims. We test each one. mimeo is an open-source tool that finds a person's public work, checks each extracted quotation against the cached source text, and writes a file an agent can load. Eight logged builds averaged 38 model calls; the check rejects 13.2% of extracted quotations. We tested four expert files with one coding-agent harness. Knowledge access was clearest: mimeo answered all 20 obscure, quotation-heavy questions; no closed-book condition answered more than 10. Keyword search (BM25) over the same pages answered 15-17, a gap this sample cannot resolve. Grounding showed one clear benefit: personas written from model memory misstated a documented position on 1-4 of 20 answers under every grader; the plain agent and mimeo never did. Every persona was easy to spot on short open prompts, and adding task material lowered identification by 18-23 points. mimeo was no more identifiable than a from-memory profile. Judgment transfer remained unresolved because both tests hit their ceiling: every condition found 94-97% of the problems planted in engineering tasks and scored 94-100% on 16 new application scenarios. An AI-judged "sounds like the expert" score changed with the judge: two of four preferred answers based on a model's stereotype, while two found no difference on the same text. That is a caution against relying on a single AI judge. The evidence supports mimeo as a compact, inspectable reference on a person, not as a demonstrated transfer of their judgment. Toolkit and expert profiles: https://github.com/K-Dense-AI/mimeo

</details>


### [286] [Towards a Belief-Based World Model for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00455)
*Shubham Kumar,Harshit Kumar,Narendra Ahuja,Saurabh Jha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出基于信念的世界模型（BB-WMs），该模型建模并维护关于当前状态的信念（包括已知和不确定信息），让LLM智能体可以直接查询这些信念以辅助决策。实验表明，在部分可观测环境下，向LLM智能体暴露世界模型的信念能提升任务表现，且与现有的基于仿真的世界模型方法互补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管LLM具有强大的推理能力，但在长时程任务和部分可观测环境下表现不佳。现有的世界模型在推理阶段仅通过仿真来模拟候选动作的结果，作者认为这种纯仿真方式没有充分捕捉当前状态的不确定性，而这对准确决策至关重要，因此需要一种能显式建模和传递状态不确定性的机制。

Method: 提出信念基世界模型（BB-WMs），该模型建模并维护一个信念状态，供LLM查询以获取关于当前状态中已知信息和不确定信息的内容。核心研究问题是在开发学习精确BB-WMs的方法之前，先验证直接将世界模型的信念暴露给LLM策略是否能够提升决策能力。

Result: 实验结果显示，在部分可观测环境下，给予LLM智能体世界模型信念的访问权限能够提升任务表现，并且这种方法与现有的基于仿真的世界模型方法可以互补使用。

Conclusion: 证明将世界模型的信念直接暴露给LLM策略可以显著改善部分可观测条件下的决策性能，为未来开发学习精确BB-WMs的方法奠定了基础，且该方法与仿真类方法具有互补性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are being used as policies for autonomous decision-making and planning in many domains. Despite their strong reasoning capabilities, LLMs struggle with long-horizon tasks, especially under partial observability. World models are a promising way to enhance policy performance, both during training and inference. During inference, agents currently use world models to simulate the consequences of candidate actions before committing to an action, which can improve decision-making. However, we argue that simulation alone is an incomplete interface for decision-making under partial observability: simulation doesn't adequately capture uncertainty about the current state, which agents may need for accurate decision-making. We address this limitation with Belief-Based World Models (BB-WMs), which model and maintain a belief that LLMs can query to access information on what is known and uncertain about the current state. Before developing methods to learn accurate BB-WMs, we first ask a more fundamental question: does exposing a world model's belief directly to an LLM policy improve decision-making? Our results show that giving LLM agents access to world model beliefs improves task performance under partial observability, while remaining complementary to existing simulation-based world models. Code is released at https://github.com/skumar-ml/belief-world-models.

</details>


### [287] [EGT-KG: Evidence-Grounded Typed KG Retrieval for Practical Scientific QA with Small Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00479)
*Muran Yu,Jiechao Gao,Yuandong Pan,Barney H. Miao,Andrew C. Lesh,Kincho H. Law,Jie Wang,Michael D. Lepech*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EGT-KG（证据接地类型化知识图谱）检索框架，用于提升本地小语言模型（SLM）在科学问答中的信息检索性能。在生物聚合物结合土壤复合材料文献基准上，通过六维评估框架（S3CRF）比较了vanilla RAG与两种EGT-KG变体（自动生成关系模式AS和专家定义关系模式ES），结果显示EGT-KG在大多数设置下优于vanilla RAG，在llama3:8b上取得最佳提升（最终得分70.37，+14.67%）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 新兴科学研究领域中，本地小语言模型（SLM）因隐私控制和部署稳定性而更具吸引力。但在实际科学问答场景中，SLM面临小规模文献集合、碎片化证据、有限的上下文窗口和推理能力等不可避免的约束，现有vanilla RAG方法难以充分应对这些挑战，因此需要更有效的检索框架来提升信息检索质量。

Method: 提出Evidence-Grounded Typed Knowledge Graph (EGT-KG)检索框架，包含两种变体：自动生成关系模式（AS）和专家定义关系模式（ES）。通过将证据组织为类型化的知识图谱来增强检索，并与vanilla RAG工作流进行对比评估。评估采用六维框架S3CRF（声音性、正确性、完整性、简洁性、相关性、流畅性），在生物聚合物结合土壤复合材料文献基准上进行实验。

Result: EGT-KG在大多数问答设置中优于vanilla RAG方法。最佳改进来自llama3:8b模型：AS和ES两种EGT-KG变体分别获得最终得分70.37（+14.67%）和68.82（+12.14%），相较vanilla RAG有显著提升。

Conclusion: EGT-KG作为一种证据接地的类型化知识图谱检索框架，能有效提升本地SLM在科学问答场景中的信息检索和回答质量，为小规模文献条件下的科学问题解答提供了可行的增强方案。

Abstract: For emerging scientific research domains, local Small Language Models (SLMs) are becoming more attractive, as they offer stronger privacy control and more stable deployment pipelines than Large Language Models. However, in practice, scientific question-answering on SLMs often operates under inevitable constraints: small literature collections, fragmented evidence, limited context window and reasoning abilities. We propose the Evidence-Grounded Typed Knowledge Graph (EGT-KG), a retrieval framework to improve information retrieval with local SLMs. We assessed three question-answering settings: a vanilla Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) workflow and two EGT-KG workflows: an automatically generated relation schema (AS) and an expert-defined relation schema (ES). Our experiments were evaluated with a six-dimensional evaluation framework (S3CRF: Soundness, Correctness, Completeness, Conciseness, Relevance, Fluency) on a Biopolymer-bound Soil Composite literature benchmark, showing that EGT-KG outperforms the vanilla RAG method in most settings, with the best improvement from llama3:8b: a Final Score of 70.37 (+14.67%) and 68.82 (+12.14%) by AS/ES EGT-KG variants.

</details>


### [288] [The Privacy-Hallucination Tradeoff in Differentially Private Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00492)
*Krithika Ramesh,Krishna Pillutla,Danish Pruthi,Anjalie Field*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文揭示了差分隐私(DP)语言模型中存在的"隐私-幻觉"权衡问题。研究发现，经过DP预训练或微调的模型比非DP模型更容易产生幻觉，且隐私预算越严格（隐私保护越强），幻觉问题越严重。论文进一步探究了这一权衡背后的模型特性，指出DP机制会压平输出分布，将概率质量重新分配给事实错误的备选答案。此外，通过控制训练数据中的事实频率，论文刻画了信息频率如何降低DP模型的幻觉风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在高风险领域（如医疗保健）中，隐私保护和事实准确性都至关重要。然而，现有的差分隐私方法可能在保护隐私的同时引入幻觉问题，这一潜在的权衡关系此前未被系统性地研究和揭示。

Method: 论文采用实证研究方法：(1) 对比DP与非DP预训练/微调模型的幻觉表现，评估隐私预算强度的影响；(2) 分析DP机制如何改变模型输出分布特性，探究幻觉产生的机制根源；(3) 设计受控实验，通过操纵训练数据中事实的出现频率来表征信息频率对幻觉风险的调节作用。

Result: 研究发现DP模型展现出显著的隐私-幻觉权衡：DP模型的幻觉率显著高于非DP模型，且隐私预算越严格幻觉越严重。机制分析表明DP机制压平了模型的输出分布，导致概率质量向事实错误选项重新分配。实验还证实训练数据中更高的信息频率能在DP约束下有效降低幻觉风险。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明需要开发更精细化的隐私保护干预手段，在提供严格隐私保证的同时不损害事实准确性。这一发现对隐私敏感且事实要求高的应用领域（如医疗）具有重要的实践指导意义。

Abstract: Both privacy and factual accuracy are paramount in high-stakes domains like healthcare. Concerningly, we uncover and investigate a privacy-hallucination tradeoff in differentially private (DP) language models. First, we empirically show that models pre-trained or fine-tuned with DP tend to produce more hallucinations than non-DP counterparts, with increased severity as the privacy budget grows stricter. Second, we investigate model properties driving this tradeoff, demonstrating that DP mechanisms flatten output distributions, potentially redistributing probability mass toward factually incorrect alternatives. Third, through experiments where we control fact frequency in training data, we characterize how information frequency can reduce hallucination risks in DP models. Overall, our findings underscore the need for more nuanced privacy-preserving interventions that offer rigorous privacy guarantees without compromising factual accuracy.

</details>


### [289] [Validity-Aware Jailbreak Evaluation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00498)
*Qilong Wu,Sahil Wadhwa,Pranab Mohanty,Giri Iyengar,Varun Chandrasekaran*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SEAV框架，一种以验证为中心的越狱评估方法，将响应分解为有序步骤并同时评估有效性和正确性，通过检索实据验证来降低误报率，重新分类大量此前被标记为成功的越狱案例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有越狱评估方法主要依赖拒答行为、语义相似性和意图匹配等启发式方法，侧重语言合理性而非正确性。许多越狱意图取决于指令有效性而非事实性，导致看似合理的错误响应被错误标记为成功。

Method: 提出Sequential Epistemic and Action-Level Validation (SEAV)框架，将响应分解为有序步骤，结合LLM-as-a-judge进行语义解释，并使用外部知识源进行检索实据验证，评估内容的事实正确性、结构一致性和操作可行性。

Result: SEAV在SD-A诊断集上将误报率比最强基线降低14.9个百分点，在四个公共基准中的三个基准上重新分类了22.1%-51.0%此前被标记为成功的样本为无效。

Conclusion: 强制正确性会显著重塑测量的鲁棒性：许多此前被标记为越狱成功的案例被重新分类为无效，且结果在不同搜索后端和评估模型上保持稳定。

Abstract: Jailbreak robustness has become central to large language model (LLM) safety evaluation, yet prevailing methodologies rely primarily on refusal behavior, semantic resemblance, and intent-matching heuristics that emphasize linguistic plausibility rather than correctness. We identify a key limitation in existing evaluations: many jailbreak intents depend on instructional validity rather than epistemic factuality, allowing realistic-looking responses to be labeled successful despite being factually or procedurally incorrect. To address this gap, we propose Sequential Epistemic and Action-Level Validation (SEAV), a verification-centric jailbreak evaluation framework that decomposes responses into ordered steps and evaluates both validity and correctness. SEAV combines LLM-as-a-judge mechanisms for semantic interpretation with retrieval-grounded verification using external knowledge sources, assessing whether generated content is factually correct, structurally consistent, and operationally capable of advancing harmful objectives. Empirically, SEAV cuts the false-positive rate on SD-A (a curated strategic-dishonesty diagnostic) by 14.9\,pp vs. the strongest baseline, and reclassifies 22.1\%--51.0\% of sampled prior-labeled successes as invalid across three of four public benchmarks. Together, these results show that enforcing correctness substantially reshapes measured robustness: many previously labeled jailbreak successes are reclassified as invalid, and results are stable across the tested search backends and evaluator models. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Ardor-Wu/SEAV.

</details>


### [290] [Wave Function Backpropagation with Explicit Temporal-Interval Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00503)
*Byunggu Yu,Justin Kim*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出波函数反向传播（WFB），一种以波参数化（振幅、波数、角频率、相位）表示神经响应的学习框架，将观测状态与时间间隔Δt通过可微时空波的相位关联。在前馈轨迹预测器上的对照实验中，WFB相比基线FFN使ADE降低20.4%；在去除速度/加速度时间泄漏的纯位置评估中降低10.4%，并与参数匹配的ReLU控制相当。乱序间隔WFB取得最低平均ADE，表明增益主要来自波表示本身而非间隔对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统神经网络主要依赖仿射变换加非线性激活，且时间往往被当作辅助特征或假设为均匀采样，缺乏一种将时间间隔Δt与神经响应内在统一关联的结构化表达方式。

Method: 引入可学习的振幅、波数、角频率与相位来表征神经响应；通过可微时空波的相位将观测状态与其时间间隔Δt关联；推导标准WFB梯度，并基于波响应Laplacian提出空间曲率校正；在前馈轨迹预测器中进行受控概念验证。

Result: 含运动特征时，真实间隔STD-WFB相对原始FFN基线降低ADE 20.4%；在去除预计算速度/加速度时间泄漏的纯位置评估中，真实间隔WFB相对原始FFN降低ADE 10.4%，且与参数匹配的ReLU控制相当，比显式Δt匹配FFN低2.1%；乱序间隔WFB取得最低平均ADE。

Conclusion: WFB被证实是一种可行的结构化前馈学习框架；现有证据支持波表示的有效性，但增益不能归因于间隔对齐，为后续架构研究奠定了清晰基础。

Abstract: Conventional neural networks learn predominantly through affine transformations followed by nonlinear activations, while elapsed time is often treated as an auxiliary feature or assumed to be uniformly sampled. This paper introduces Wave Function Backpropagation (WFB), a wave-parameterized learning formulation in which neural responses are represented by learnable amplitude, wavenumber, angular frequency, and phase. The formulation associates an observed state with its temporal interval Delta t through the phase of a differentiable spatiotemporal wave. We derive standard WFB gradients and a spatial-curvature correction based on the Laplacian of the wave response. WFB is instantiated in a deliberately feed-forward trajectory predictor to provide a controlled proof of concept; sequence learning is outside the scope of the present evaluation. With motion features, STD-WFB using real intervals reduces average displacement error (ADE) by 20.4% relative to the original FFN baseline. In a new position-only evaluation that removes temporal leakage through precomputed velocity and acceleration, real-interval WFB reduces ADE by 10.4% relative to the original FFN and remains competitive with parameter-matched ReLU controls, obtaining 2.1% lower mean ADE than the matched FFN with explicit Delta t. Shuffled-interval WFB attains the lowest mean ADE, indicating that the present evidence supports the effectiveness of the wave representation but does not attribute the gain to interval alignment. These results establish WFB as a viable structured feed-forward learning formulation and define a clear basis for subsequent architectural studies.

</details>


### [291] [CoVer: Conflict-Aware Claim Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00508)
*Shuning Zhang,Dai Shi,Bohao Chu,Hui Wang,Yuwei Chuai,Yifan Wang,Jingruo Chen,Simin Li,Xin Yi,Hewu Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出ContraNote数据集和CoVer事实裁决框架，用于解决社交媒体事实核查中证据级与聚合级的冲突验证问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 社交媒体事实核查长期面临证据级和聚合级冲突挑战，其中错误的证据可能伪装成权威新闻来源，干扰最终判决结果。

Method: 构建ContraNote数据集（基于X社区笔记系统，含33,686篇帖子用于证据级冲突解决，54,474个实例用于聚合级优先级排序）；提出CoVer框架，采用三阶段流水线：证据模式规范化、事实共识与支持验证，优先处理证据而非噪声。

Result: CoVer在ContraNote上达到86.0%准确率、68.0%宏F1和64.5平衡准确率（冲突任务）；88.5%准确率、88.5宏F1和89.2平衡准确率（优先级任务）；在CONFACT-HumC和CONFACT-ModC上分别达到88.4%和89.4%准确率，优于现有基线。

Conclusion: CoVer框架通过优先处理证据而非噪声的策略，在跨数据集上展现出强健的性能，有效应对社交媒体事实核查中的双重冲突挑战。

Abstract: Social media fact-checking has long been challenged by evidence-level and aggregation-level conflicts, where erroneous evidence mimics authoritative news sources. To capture this challenge and support conflict verification tasks, we present ContraNote, a large-scale real-world dataset curated from X's Community Notes system. It includes 33,686 posts for evaluating evidence-level conflict resolution, and 54,474 instances for evaluating aggregation-level prioritization. Additionally, we propose CoVer, a factual adjudication framework with three-stage pipelines: evidence schema normalization, factual consensus and support verification. This prioritizes evidence over noise to prevent it from compromising the final verdict. Technical evaluations show that CoVer achieves strong performance compared with state-of-the-art baselines across ContraNote (86.0% Acc., 68.0% mac. F1, 64.5 bal. Acc. on Conflict; and 88.5% Acc., 88.5 mac. F1 and 89.2 bal. Acc. on Prioritization), CONFACT-HumC (88.4% Acc.) and CONFACT-ModC (89.4% Acc.).

</details>


### [292] [When the Algorithm Becomes the Brand Crisis: A Sociotechnical Theory of Distributed Responsibility and Accountable Transparency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00510)
*Mohammad Saleh Torkestani,Taha Mansouri*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个社会技术过程理论，用以解释当AI系统、开发者、部署者、供应商与用户之间存在分布式技术因果、客户控制和治理责任时，利益相关者如何归因责任。该理论区分AI/算法事件、AI相关的组织危机与组织丑闻，并提出事件配置→行为者归因→能力/诚信/公平/关系评估→公开道德化（可能升级为丑闻）的过程链条。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统品牌危机模型无法充分解释AI系统的失败、误用和误导所产生的责任归属问题，因为技术因果、客户控制与治理责任分布在AI系统、开发者、部署者、供应商和用户等多个主体之间。

Method: 采用概念性论文方法，基于结构化、联邦式范围的综合综述，对经过验证的学术和一手来源进行整合分析，构建社会技术过程理论。

Result: 提出了AI/算法事件与AI相关组织危机及丑闻的三层区分；揭示事件配置塑造主体特定归因，归因影响能力、诚信、公平和关系评估；引入"可问责的透明性"作为响应配置（包括及时通知、可理解的说明、角色责任承认、补救、纠正证据和追索）；证据支持有条件、近端的推论（责备、信任、满意度、企业评价和沟通可信度），而非长久的声誉、品牌权益或市场表现。

Conclusion: 该理论调和了相互矛盾的发现：算法参与在某些情境下可缓冲负面品牌反应，而机器人和聊天机器人故障则可能将责任转嫁给关联企业。研究仅支持关于责备、信任等近端结果的条件性、探究性推断，不支持关于长期声誉或市场绩效的强主张。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence systems increasingly enact market-facing promises through chatbots, recommendation systems, automated decisions, and generative interfaces. Their failures, misuse, and misrepresentation raise a question that conventional brand-crisis models do not fully specify: how do stakeholders assign responsibility when technical causation, customer-facing control, and governance duties are distributed across an AI system, developer, deployer, vendor, and user? This conceptual paper develops a sociotechnical process theory from a structured, federated scoping synthesis of verified academic and primary sources. It distinguishes an AI/algorithmic incident from an AI-related organisational crisis and, in turn, from an AI-related organisational scandal. The framework proposes that incident configuration shapes actor-specific attribution; attribution informs capability, integrity, fairness, and relationship appraisals; and public moralisation may, but need not, escalate an incident into scandal. The theory offers a reconciliation of findings that algorithm involvement can buffer negative brand reactions in some settings while robot and chatbot failures can redirect responsibility to an associated firm in others. It introduces accountable transparency as a proposed response configuration that combines timely notice, an intelligible account, role-responsibility acknowledgement, remedy, evidence of correction, and recourse. The evidence supports conditional, proximal inferences about blame, trust, satisfaction, firm evaluation, and communication credibility more strongly than claims about durable reputation, brand equity, or market performance.

</details>


### [293] [ISO-RAG: Isoperimetric Noise Control for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00513)
*Siyuan Zhang,Hanchen Wang,Dong Wen,Ying Zhang,Wenjie Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ISO-RAG是一个几何感知的检索增强生成框架，通过将知识图谱投影到双曲庞加莱球中预计算节点等周轮廓，在检索时剪除虚假边并将搜索空间限制在严格局部子图内，从而解决传统图RAG在多跳问答中的语义漂移和高延迟问题。实验表明其在检索召回率和下游精确匹配上分别平均提升10.0%和4.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统稠密检索难以处理多跳问答的复杂推理路径；图基RAG虽能捕捉多步关系，但受全局图遍历中的噪声影响，存在严重语义漂移和高在线延迟问题。

Method: 将底层知识图谱投影到双曲庞加莱球中，预计算节点级的等周轮廓(isoperimetric profiles)，据此在检索阶段剪除虚假边，将搜索空间限制为严格局部子图；利用这种拓扑纯化来调控个性化PageRank(PPR)扩散过程，确保检索精确且低延迟收敛。

Result: 在多跳QA基准测试中，ISO-RAG相比最先进基线在检索召回率上平均提升10.0%，下游精确匹配上平均提升4.3%，实现了优越的准确率-效率权衡，从根本上消除了全局遍历的延迟瓶颈。

Conclusion: ISO-RAG通过结合双曲几何的等周分析与PPR扩散调控，为多跳问答中的图RAG提供了一种更精确且低延迟的检索方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) mitigates large language models (LLMs) hallucinations, yet conventional dense retrieval struggles with the complex reasoning paths of multi-hop question answering (QA). Graph-based RAG captures multi-step relationships but suffers from severe semantic drift and high online latency due to noisy global graph traversals. Thus, we propose ISO-RAG (ISOperimetric Retrieval-Augmented Generation), a geometry-aware RAG framework. By projecting the underlying knowledge graph into a hyperbolic Poincare ball to precompute node-wise isoperimetric profiles, ISO-RAG prunes spurious edges during retrieval, restricting the search space to a strictly localized subgraph. This topological purification regulates Personalized PageRank (PPR) diffusion driving the retrieval process, ensuring exact and low-latency convergence. Experiments on multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ISO-RAG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by average absolute gains of 10.0% in retrieval recall and 4.3% in downstream exact match, achieving a superior accuracy-efficiency trade-off by fundamentally eliminating the latency bottleneck of global traversals. Our source code is available at https://github.com/ZaiizaiZHANG/ISO-RAG.

</details>


### [294] [Feedback-Assisted Trust Propagation over Document Relation Graphs for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.00543)
*Zhuoheng Li,Ying Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出TrustPropRAG框架，通过构建文档关系图并结合少量人工反馈信号，利用多跳传播机制估计文档可靠度（信任分数），从而改进RAG系统的文档检索质量与答案可靠性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RAG系统依赖的外部语料库可能含有过时、矛盾、嘈杂或不可靠的文档，带来可靠性风险。先前工作利用文档关系改善答案可靠性，但可靠性信号无法在直接比较的文档对之外传播，需要有效扩展有限的可靠性信号到整个语料库。

Method: 将文档关系构建为图结构；以有限的人工反馈作为锚点，通过多跳传播估计每个文档的信任分数；将文档关系与用户反馈统一建模为优化问题求解；利用信任分数改进可靠文档的选择，并支持信任感知的答案生成。

Result: TrustPropRAG相较于基线方法在检索质量和精确匹配（EM）指标上均有提升，并且在稀疏和有噪声的反馈条件下依然保持鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 通过图结构上的多跳信任传播，能够以少量昂贵人工反馈为锚点将可靠性信号扩展到整个语料库，有效提升RAG系统的整体可靠性。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems rely on external corpora that may contain outdated, contradictory, noisy, or unreliable documents, introducing reliability risks. Prior work has leveraged document relations to improve the answer reliability of RAG.
